title: Vice President, Digital Workflow, Automation & AI
description:
Vice President, Digital Workflow, Automation & AI

Global | Permanent or 12-month rotational assignment

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will deliver automation and digital workflow change from opportunity identification through to deployment and measured benefit.

  • Identify processes suitable for automation or AI, quantify the opportunity, and build the case.

  • Design the target workflow, including exception handling and the controls that sit around it.

  • Write and agree requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, and support them through build.

  • Design, plan and execute testing, including UAT, and manage defect resolution through to sign-off.

  • Deploy solutions into the business and confirm they are used as intended.

  • Measure and report realised benefit against the original case.

  • Work with the Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions and Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement focus areas where automation depends on process redesign or data capability.

  • Produce project documentation, status reporting and ad hoc analysis as required.

About You

You have 8+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, with hands-on exposure to automation or process improvement.

  • Hands-on experience of automation deployment, workflow design, process improvement or system implementation.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes and where the manual effort genuinely sits.

  • Familiarity with automation and workflow tooling, and a practical view of where AI is and is not appropriate.

  • Project management skills with attention to detail and a proven ability to multi-task.

  • Confident engaging both operational teams and technology partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); familiarity with reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; professional accounting designation is preferred.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Director of Partnerships
description:
About Buzz Solutions

Buzz Solutions builds PowerAI, a computer vision platform that finds hardware defects in utility transmission and distribution infrastructure and delivers those findings straight into the systems where utilities actually make asset decisions. Our customers include Dominion, AEP, NYPA, and Ameren. We integrate today with Esri's ArcGIS and IBM Maximo, and we work alongside capture partners such as Skydio.

We are at the stage where the direct sales motion works and the next order of magnitude has to come from somewhere else. That is what this role is for.

The role

Design and execute our go-to-market partner strategy and execution — and own the revenue it generates. Over the next 18–24 months that means building a repeatable partner motion in the United States, opening Canada as our first international market, and scoping the markets that follow. You will define our partnership categories (and priorities), evaluate partners in each of those categories, sign them, make them technically viable, enable partner sellers and delivery teams to carry Buzz without our hand on their shoulder, and be accountable for the pipeline and closed ARR that results.

This is deliberately a hybrid charter. It requires someone who can sit in a commercial negotiation in the morning, walk an integration architecture with a partner's solutions team in the afternoon, and run a certification workshop for that partner's field engineers the following week. Candidates who can only do one or two of those three will not succeed here. You will be an individual contributor at hire, with an expected path to building a partner organization in year two.

Responsibilities

  • Pipeline and revenue through partnership
    • You carry a partner-sourced and partner-influenced number. This is not a support function that hands leads to account executives and reports on activity. You will work opportunities alongside our direct sellers and alongside partner sellers, from first qualification through close, and you own the forecast for that motion. You will also define the rules of engagement, deal registration, and margin structure that keep the channel from colliding with direct sales and then enforce them.
  • Technical integration and joint solutions design
    • You own the commercial and technical shape of how PowerAI plugs into a partner's world and how it drives joint value. First order of business: turn our existing Esri integration from a working piece of engineering into a formal, listed, jointly sold alliance, then do the same for Maximo, then prioritize what follows against real pipeline rather than a wish list. You'll also own the hyperscaler track — marketplace transactability and co-sell — which is as much a commercial unlock as a technical one. Throughout, you build the reference architectures and joint solution briefs that let a partner's pre-sales team position us credibly without us in the room. You are not expected to write production code. You are expected to hold your own in a conversation about API orchestration, data flow, GIS conflation, and where a given integration will break at enterprise scale — and to know when to pull Product and Engineering into the conversation.
  • Partner enablement and certification
    • A signed agreement is not a partnership. You'll build the layer that turns signatures into revenue: the sales narrative and objection handling a partner rep can deliver without us, the business case and ROI tooling they need to get a utility's capital committee to yes, the demo certification that lets them run their own discovery, and the technical curriculum that lets their engineers implement and support PowerAI deployments. Over time this becomes a tiered certification program and the basis for a services multiplier on every dollar of software we sell
  • International market entry
    • You own how Buzz goes international and in what order — the subject of its own section below. The short version: expansion is partner-led by design, and the sequencing judgment is as much a part of this role as the partnerships themselves.

Qualifications

  • Built a partner ecosystem from near zero at an early-stage or scaling B2B software company — not inherited and grown a mature program. You've done the unglamorous first version: the first agreement template, the first rules of engagement, the first certification deck.
  • Carried and hit a number through partners. You can walk through specific partner-sourced pipeline and closed revenue you were personally accountable for, how it was measured, and the quarters you missed as well as the ones you made.
  • Sold into slow, regulated, procurement-heavy enterprises. Utilities specifically is a strong advantage; adjacent regulated infrastructure — energy, telecom, transportation, public sector — translates. A career selling exclusively to fast-moving commercial buyers does not.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to be credible without an engineer in the room. You can explain how data moves between a capture provider, our platform, and a customer's GIS and EAM; you can spot where an integration will fail at enterprise scale; you know the difference between a demo integration and a supportable one.
  • Built sales and technical enablement material yourself — partner pitch narratives, ROI models, demo certification, delivery curriculum. Written, not commissioned.

  • Comfortable as an individual contributor in an ambiguous, resource-constrained environment. For the first year, you are the partner organization

title: Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description:
Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions

Global | Permanent or 12-month rotational assignment

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will deliver operating model and product change from the problem, through testing, to deployment and adoption.

  • Document current state end to end, identify root causes, and design the target state process.

  • Build the case for change — quantifying effort, risk and benefit in terms the business recognises.

  • Write and agree business requirements with IT, the Transformation Office and the relevant focus areas, and support them through build and delivery.

  • Design, plan and execute testing, including UAT, and manage defect resolution through to sign-off.

  • Contribute operational input to client pitches, POCs and presentations, and translate client requirements into an operational design that can be built and run.

  • Support implementation of fund structures, new client setups, complex client transitions and onboarding on our accounting platforms, alongside Client Integration.

  • Work directly with Operations teams to make sure change is understood, trained out and genuinely adopted.

  • Assess where a redesign or client solution delivered once can be applied more widely, and document the case.

  • Produce project documentation, status reporting and ad hoc analysis as required.

About You

You have 8+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment.

  • Hands-on experience of process improvement, system implementation or project delivery.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes — general ledger, capital activity, fee and waterfall calculations, financial statements and investor reporting.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation.

  • Confident in front of a client, and comfortable explaining operational constraints clearly.

  • Project management skills with attention to detail and a proven ability to multi-task.

  • Confident engaging both operational teams and technology partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); familiarity with reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; professional accounting designation is preferred.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) is at the forefront of global efforts to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer, while delivering quantum-enhanced AI and simulation products to customers today.

Backed by over 25 years of technological excellence, SQC is a full-stack quantum computing company that leverages its proprietary manufacturing process to engineer atomic qubits in silicon with 0.13 nanometer precision. It is the most precise semiconductor manufacturing in the world, enabling systems with world-leading algorithmic fidelity, and a decisive advantage in the global quantum computing race.

Our products are commercially deployed and generating revenue. Watermelon, our quantum-enhanced AI system, is delivering superior results on real-world problems across energy, telecom and finance. Quantum Twins, our simulation platform, provides unparalleled ability to model quantum systems, accelerating molecule and materials discovery.

This is SQC: building the future of computing while delivering quantum impact today.

About the role

We are hiring an AI Engineer into Applied AI, the team that builds agentic capability across SQC's engineering, science, manufacturing and corporate teams, and runs the platform it is built on.

You will embed with a different host team every three to four months, across engineering, research, manufacturing and the corporate functions, and learn how each one actually works, digitally and physically, before you build anything for it. One rotation might be inspection tooling for lithography; the next, tracking devices through fabrication; the next, a corporate workflow nobody has automated. At the frontier of quantum computing, the problems arrive unsolved, often unstated, and with little precedent to copy.

You map the problem and the operating environment, then own what you build. Some of it will be messy. Getting it right takes judgement about data, system design and risk, not just prompting. Alongside the agents, you will teach as you go, so the capability outlasts the rotation. Applied AI sets the sequence of rotations and agrees with each host team what it commits before you arrive.

Based in Sydney, you will work hands-on with physicists, fabrication staff, engineers and corporate teams. This is a role for someone properly deep in applied AI: someone who thinks in loops and graphs, reaches for backpressure and ontologies before a bigger prompt, and already builds with agents as their default way of working.

Role responsibilities

  • Work with the host team to define and deliver agentic capabilities, inside their domain and their constraints
  • Model the domain before you automate it: the ontology, the data, and the state that has to match what is happening on the bench
  • Find the quick wins and the fundamental shifts in how a team operates, prioritise between them, and deliver through the rotation
  • Build, optimise and evaluate production agents
  • Decide what the model does and what code does
  • Design for backpressure, retries and idempotency; your agents sit in front of instruments, fab equipment and inference endpoints, and all of them have limits and bad days
  • Say plainly what an agent will and will not do, including when a problem does not need one
  • Build on the Applied AI platform (inference, MCP and web proxies, the evaluation harness, the agent registry and orchestration), improving it rather than working around it, and taking your share of running it
  • Account for the impact and the cost of what you build, in terms the host team can defend after you have gone
  • Hand over completely: code, runbook, evaluation and ownership to the host team, with no maintenance tail and no system that depends on one person remaining in the room
  • Leave the host team more capable than you found them: the training, the habits and the judgement that outlast the agent

Your experience

Essential

  • 4+ years building and running production software, with responsibility for it after release, and a record of shipping
  • Building, optimising and evaluating production agents or LLM-backed systems, beyond prototypes and demos
  • Strong Python, Go, Rust or C++
  • Agent-first practice: coding agents are already your default way of working
  • Tool use and context design, and the practical business of making an agent reliable rather than impressive (you can pick up our harness, MCP and proxy stack here)
  • Accountability for an inference budget, even for a single agent: you have had to justify the spend and keep it inside a number
  • High autonomy: you have worked embedded in someone else's team, without daily supervision, and been effective there
  • Working directly with people who are not software engineers, and translating what they describe into what they need
  • The judgement to say a problem does not need an agent, and to hold that position with a keen stakeholder
  • Learning an unfamiliar domain quickly enough to be useful in it within weeks
  • Handover as a habit: documentation, runbooks and tests good enough for someone else to own what you built
  • Clear technical writing, and the ability to diagram a system so someone else can follow it

Nice to have

  • Retrieval over messy internal data: documents, wikis, tickets, instrument output
  • Evaluation practice: building the harness, offline and online scoring
  • Data engineering: pipelines, storage and the modelling that has to match a real-world process
  • Enough frontend to give a user something usable
  • Scientific, laboratory or manufacturing environments, and users whose requirements arrive as a problem rather than a specification
  • Consulting, internal platform or enablement work, where the deliverable was someone else's capability
  • On-premise or air-gapped environments, including work with material that cannot leave the building
  • Infrastructure as code and container orchestration (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes)
  • Quantum computing exposure of any kind (no physics degree required)

Equal opportunity

SQC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and encourage applications from candidates who may not meet every listed requirement. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply.

Export controls

This position may require access to export-controlled information or technology. Employment may be subject to applicable export control laws and may require eligibility assessment based on factors such as nationality, citizenship, or residency, and, where necessary, obtaining relevant export licenses or approvals.

About SQC

SQC was founded by renowned physicist and materials scientist Michelle Simmons, who pioneered the field of atomic electronics, including the development of the world’s first single-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of Arm, is a leader in the semiconductor industry and was instrumental in developing the processors that powered the mobile computing revolution.

As a full-stack company with in-house QPU manufacturing, SQC can design, produce and test new quantum chips in under a week, enabling rapid iteration and a decisive advantage in the race to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer.

SQC is a high-accountability environment built on a simple principle: Every Atom Counts. If you’re looking to play a meaningful role in building the next frontier of computing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Coding Quality Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Coding Quality Analyst researches and interprets healthcare correct coding using regulatory requirements and guidance related to CMS, CPT/AMA and other major payer policies. They also use internal business rules to prepare written documentation of findings through medical record review. The Coding Analyst possesses an overall understanding of all coding principles, including facility and physician coding and provides health care payers with a total claim management solution. Typically, 90% of a Coding Analyst's time is spent performing coding and documentation review and 10% spent performing other tasks as assigned.

This position is full-time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 6:00am - 6:00pm. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Conduct coding reviews of medical records and supporting documentation against submitted claims, for individual provider and facility claims, to determine coding and billing accurate for all products
  • Process and/or review claims in a timely manner utilizing client specific coding and billing requirements that meet or exceed production and quality goals
  • Participate in process improvement activities and encourage ownership of and group participation in improvement initiatives
  • Analyze medical documents to evaluate potential issues of fraud and abuse
  • Document coding review findings within investigative case tracking system and maintains thorough and objective documentation of findings
  • Serve as a coding resource and provide coding expertise and guidance to entire investigation team
  • Identify and recommend opportunities for cost savings and improving outcomes
  • Coordinate activities with varying levels of leadership including the investigative team, legal counsel, internal and external customers, law enforcement and regulatory agencies, and medical professionals through effective verbal and written communications as needed
  • Research and interpret correct coding guidelines and internal business rules to respond to customer inquiries, and monitors CMS and major payer coding and reimbursement policies
  • Must be able to take and pass Coding Assessment

  • Education Reimbursement

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

  • Must have one or more of the following coding credentials: RHIA, RHIT, CCS-P, CCS, CPC, or COC

title: Java Backend Engineering Team Lead (Portugal)
description:
Are you a problem-solver with a background in software development? Do you want to be a part of an innovative team that use their technical skills to make a positive impact? Then this role could be for you!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

For this position, we are happily looking for candidates currently based in Portugal.

The Job

Our Java Engineering Team Lead is responsible for leading and developing a team of talented software engineers and creating and maintaining the software that allows our platform to function. Other responsibilities include:

  • Lead and develop the individuals in your team.
  • The maintenance and development of new features on our software platform.
  • Our team works in an agile way and you will be part of the rituals and practices.
  • Coordination of the work that the software engineering team need to do.
  • Applying software engineering principles to the design, development, maintenance, testing, and evaluation of our software.
  • Ensuring that the software you develop is secure and safe when it comes to data protection.
  • You document your work and make sure that your documentation is clear and understandable for future use by others.

About You

You have in-depth development experience using Java and building software from the ground up. You’re a logical thinker and a natural problem solver who wants to use your technical skillset to make an impact.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience focused on JVM languages
  • 3+ years of formal leadership experience managing a team of Java backend engineers, including responsibility for conducting team performance reviews
  • Experience within Microservices and AWS
  • You have extensive experience working with the Spring framework, as well as various other Java backend tools and frameworks
  • Experience or knowledge of Salesforce CRM would be a plus
  • You don’t want to just write code, you want to build scalable systems with quality
  • You are based in Portugal
  • You have excellent English skills

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Technical Challenge | Final interview with the Tech Team

The Rewards

The gross monthly salary bracket for this position is €3,660 - €6,100 (x14). We will offer you a salary in this bracket depending on your level of experience and how it relates to your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
  • A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website tiko.org or contact our Global Recruiter. We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures.

title: Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
description:
Anti-Cheat is Riot’s first defense against cheaters that don’t want to play fair. As a cross-discipline team of former cheaters, kernel developers, machine learning engineers, data analysts, and software engineers, they make products like Vanguard to detect and ban the bad guys across all of Riot’s competitive titles and platforms, staying vigilant to whatever shape they’ll take in response. From beaming bots to scorching scripters, anti-cheat enables Riot’s game teams to take on competitive genres and design rewarding systems that would otherwise be too vulnerable to fraudsters and cheaters. As a Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist on Anti-Cheat, you will lead modeling strategy across the team's portfolio of competitive integrity products. This includes establishing architecture, setting standards, and ultimately building the weaponry that enables Riot to stay one step ahead of cheaters and botters. The work will be high-complexity, with tangible antagonists seeking to iteratively understand the boundaries of any classifiers, almost as quick as they are deployed, and your work will directly serve players of the highest devotion by identifying these actors in all of their many environments, ensuring that the time it takes to earn rank in Riot’s competitive queues is time well-spent. You will report to the Senior Manager of Anti-Cheat Data and Analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Use all of Anti-Cheat’s resources to help design, build, and maintain AI/ML pipelines from end-to-end, creating an iterative, ever-evolving series of classifiers, capable of adapting in perpetuity as attackers learn from its actions.
  • Innovate in the anomaly detection space by creating proven, trusted player outcomes from novel and even theoretical modelling approaches.
  • Leverage Riot’s centralized ML infrastructure where possible, upgrade it where necessary, and ensure that any realized technical capabilities can be capitalized on by other teams and products.
  • Independently analyze and develop prototypes for emerging challenges in the anti-cheat space, including challenges of cost efficacy.
  • Refine modeling and feature invention strategy across projects; improve architecture trade-offs, signal extraction techniques, and quality standards for complex data sources.
  • Develop mission-critical machine learning and artificial intelligence systems from scratch, including gathering requirements and designing scalable, production-ready architecture that significantly impacts the team and product.
  • Reduce ambiguity in complex problem spaces by leading technical discovery and prototyping efforts that have a strategic impact on the team.
  • Establish recruiting practices across multiple teams; serve as a trusted interviewer for related roles.
  • Mentor junior staff by sharing your reasoning behind design decisions and result interpretations.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, Math, or related Computer Science/Quantitative field with 3+ years of industry experience (including Postdoc), or equivalent experience (i.e., M.S. with 4-6+ years of relevant experience, or B.S. with 6-8+ years of relevant experience).
  • 2+ years of experience working directly in anti-cheat, anti-fraud, or anti-virus spaces.
  • Working knowledge of production ML systems to engage credibly on model serving, CI/CD for ML, observability, and cost tradeoffs, and write the code daily.
  • History of working at the boundary between research and production, where interesting problems require both scientific rigor and engineering pragmatism.
  • Experience establishing evaluation practices across AI/ML projects in partnership with product data scientists; guide experiment design for measuring model impact and set technical evaluation standards.
  • Deep understanding of traditional machine learning models, with familiarity in deep learning technologies and their applications.
  • History of working with complex or unconventional data sources where off-the-shelf feature engineering doesn’t apply.
  • Comfort representing ML capabilities in cross-disciplinary forums and translating technical tradeoffs for product, design, and leadership audiences.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience building iterative machine classifiers for behavioral anomalies in competitive video games.
  • Hands-on experience in threat detection and classification for risk, fraud, insurance, security, sports, or gaming spaces.
  • Experience bridging research and production, like translating papers or prototypes into reliable shipped systems.
  • Passion for player experience, games, or creative technology.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

  • Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
  • Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
  • Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
  • Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

title: SVP, Engineering
description:
About the company

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

As Senior Vice President of Engineering, you will lead Covera Health's Engineering and Platform/IT organizations, with direct ownership of our technology architecture, engineering standards, and technical execution. You will lead a technology organization of approximately 30 people, including Engineering and AI, and play an active role in the technical decisions that shape our products and platforms.

Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, you will serve as a deeply technical and operational partner to a strategically focused technology executive. You will own day-to-day engineering execution, architecture, technical quality, and reliability, making decisions independently while working closely with the CPTO on broader product and technology strategy.

You will lead a small but mighty team, leveraging modern AI-powered development practices and state-of-the-art tools to accelerate development, improve efficiency, and deliver high-quality solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will stay close to the work, participating in architecture and design reviews, working through complex data platform challenges, and helping teams resolve critical production issues.

As a senior technology leader with strong product instincts, you will connect technology decisions to customer and business needs. You will serve as a critical bridge between Engineering and teams across the company, ensuring technical decisions support the products we're building and the problems we're solving for customers and patients.

In this role, you will be expected to:

  • Lead a technology organization of approximately 30 people across Engineering, AI, and Platform/IT, remaining closely involved in architecture, technical decisions, and engineering execution.
  • Partner with the CPTO to turn product and company strategy into technical execution, independently owning engineering decisions, architecture, technical quality, and day-to-day delivery.

  • Own technical architecture and engineering standards across application development, cloud infrastructure, data platforms and pipelines, integrations, and enterprise technology. Stay actively involved in design reviews and complex technical decisions.

  • Set and maintain a high engineering bar, actively reviewing architecture and technical approaches to ensure solutions balance performance, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and speed.Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional technology talent while building a technically strong team that values ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence.
  • Build a culture where engineers take ownership, make sound technical decisions, and remain focused on delivering meaningful product and business outcomes.Ensure Covera's technology organization can support increasingly complex data and AI-driven products while meeting the privacy, security, reliability, and quality requirements of healthcare.
  • Communicate technical decisions, priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Remain actively involved in diagnosing and resolving complex technical challenges, including data pipeline issues, architectural decisions, system performance, and critical production incidents.

Requirements:

  • 15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology experience, including deep technical experience building and operating complex software systems and leading engineering teams.
  • Experience leading engineering teams and engineering managers while remaining actively involved in technical architecture, design, and execution.
  • Demonstrated success building technically strong, high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, and high engineering standards..
  • Strong product instincts and demonstrated ability to connect technology strategy and execution to product, customer, and business needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with Product leadership and operate effectively at the intersection of product and engineering.
  • Deep technical expertise and strong architectural judgment, with the ability and desire to remain actively involved in design reviews, technical problem-solving, and critical engineering decisions.
  • Experience building, scaling, and operating large-scale, data-intensive production systems and platforms.
  • Deep technical knowledge of modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms and pipelines, integrations, security, reliability, and data architecture.
  • Experience improving engineering quality, reliability, and delivery through strong technical practices, effective tooling, and practical team leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to make complex cross-functional decisions, resolve competing priorities, and create alignment across multiple teams and functions.
  • Experience working with ML/AI engineering teams or overseeing products and platforms incorporating AI/ML capabilities.
  • Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional engineering leaders and talent.
  • Experience operating in fast-paced startup or growth-stage environments.
  • Excellent executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience building or leading modern, data-intensive technology platforms, with a strong understanding of complex data pipelines, distributed systems, and production reliability.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance technical depth with leadership responsibilities, remaining close to engineering work while guiding teams and making broader technology decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience at a healthcare technology or data company building modern software platforms or technically complex products using clinical, imaging, or claims data.
  • Experience with healthcare or clinical data environments, including familiarity with HL7 and/or DICOM.
  • Experience with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Spark, or similar technologies.

  • Experience transitioning from a highly technical engineering environment into a leadership role at a startup or growth-stage company.
  • Experience developing engineering depth and technical leadership at a large-scale technology company, followed by engineering leadership experience in a smaller, product-focused organization.

title: Staff Hardware Quality Engineer
description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview

  • Drive quality engineering initiatives to improve manufacturing processes, product quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations, ensuring effective corrective actions are implemented and driven to closure.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing defects, rework, and Hours Per Unit (HPU).
  • Develop and maintain quality requirements, procedures, and documentation to support consistent manufacturing processes.
  • Establish, monitor, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify quality trends and drive continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Test, and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence.

Responsibilities

Continuous Improvement

  • Review travelers, routers, and build records in ERP/MES.
  • Ensure traceability, configuration, and documentation are complete and accurate.
  • Enforce workmanship standards (IPC, internal specs).
  • Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations through closure.
  • Develop and maintain quality documentation, requirements, and procedures.
  • Develop, maintain, track, and trend key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Drive Hours Per Unit (HPU) and manufacturing defect reduction initiatives.

Nonconformance & Disposition

  • Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming material.
  • Support MRB and disposition activities.
  • Drive immediate containment on the floor.

Production Support

  • Act as first responder to quality issues during builds.
  • Interface directly with Manufacturing, Test, and Engineering.
  • Ensure no hardware progresses with unresolved quality issues.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in quality engineering, manufacturing quality, or related manufacturing engineering roles.
  • Experience identifying, investigating, and resolving hardware manufacturing quality issues.
  • Demonstrated experience leading RCCA investigations through closure.
  • Experience with HPU and/or manufacturing defect reduction initiatives.
  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering.
  • Ability to read drawings, schematics, and specifications (GD&T preferred).
  • Experience with ERP/MES systems for build tracking and sign-off.
  • Familiarity with IPC standards (J-STD-001, IPC-A-610).

Preferred Requirements

  • Six Sigma experience or certification.
  • Experience in aerospace/defense or high-reliability hardware.
  • Experience in multiple production domains (R&D, T2P, LRIP, FRP).
  • AS9100 environment experience, experience performing FAI (AS9102).
  • Strong MRB / nonconformance handling experience.


Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices
Salary Range: $155,000 - $230,000 per year

title: Sterile Processing Tech - Educator/Quality Control
description:
Works under the supervision of the Manager-OR Support. This position is responsible for ensuring that all surgical supplies, instruments and equipment are properly inventoried, decontaminated, assembled, inspected, packaged, sterilized, stored, distributed and tracked in a quality/timely manner throughout the hospital and clinics. Works independently with little supervision. Qualified to train others and serves as a resource related to Sterile Processing Procedure. Performs appropriate quality control testing and record keeping as recommended. Maintains current registry/certification in Sterile Processing.

  • Cleans, disinfects and sterilizes soiled instruments, equipment, case carts and utensils per manufactures recommendations.
  • Checks for cleanliness, proper function, lubricates and assembles various instruments, equipment, and scopes used in Surgery/Clinics.
  • Assembles instruments/selects appropriate packaging and prepare sets for sterilization/disinfecting.
  • Selects/performs appropriate method of sterilization and biological testing to determine efficacy of the recommended process.
  • Maintains, properly documents and verifies various records for sterilization.
  • Cleans equipment for patient use.
  • Anticipates instrument needs for cases due to surgeon and procedure preference cards.
  • Answers telephone, takes messages, and pulls case carts as needed.
  • Trains and checks off competencies of new staff.
  • Other duties as assigned


Education

  • H.S. Diploma - Required
  • 3 months of full time orientation prior to working independently. - Required
  • Background in medical field. - Preferred


Work Experience


Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Registered Central Services Technician (CRCST) - Obtainment of certification is preferred at 6 months, but required within 1 year of hire date. Position is contingent upon maintaining registry; continuation of certification annually. - Required within 1 Year


Travel Requirements

  • Must be able to travel between various system facilities and off-site locations as needed. - Required
Skills and Abilities

Essential Technical/Motor Skills

  • Speaking clearly.
  • Able to communicate by voice with co-workers, representatives, customers.
  • Calibrate equipment.
  • Precise hand/eye coordination with surgical instrumentation.
  • Able to assemble surgical instrumentation.
  • Manipulate small items and equipment.
  • Must possess fine motor skills to handle micro instrumentation.
  • Demonstrate great attention to detail-oriented work.
  • Answer telephone.
  • Ability to learn keyboard skills.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Strong work ethic, team player, supportive, able to work under pressure, flexible, focused.
  • Must have positive attitude and outgoing personality.
  • Self- motivated and can work independently with little or no supervision.

Essential Physical Requirements

  • Moving carts, instruments, equipment, supplies, etc.
  • Assembling instrumentation, supplies, etc.
  • Standing for long periods of time, up to 4 hours or more at a stretch.
  • Operation of instrumentation and equipment.
  • Walking, filling case carts. Pushing and pulling carts and other equipment.
  • Able to lift and carry instrument sets and other equipment of up to 60 pounds.
  • Able to reach above head to put instrument sets on shelf.
  • Able to safely remove instrument sets from shelves without damage.
  • Able to reach, climb on stool, stoop, kneel down.
  • Ability to take departmental calls with a 30-minute response time.

Essential Mental Abilities

  • Manipulate numbers.
  • Differentiate and count instruments.
  • Ability to interpret data from various sources in the department.
  • Able to comprehend surgical procedures, instrumentation, sequence of events.
  • Short and long term memory.
  • Concentration and alertness for extended periods of time.
  • Follow rules and instructions.
  • Able to go from situation to situation or area to area in department.
  • Follow policies and procedures of department with minimal to no supervision.
  • Organizational skills.

Essential Sensory Requirements

  • Visual skills i.e. able to distinguish one instrument from another.
  • Tactile, feel, distinguish colors.
  • Hearing, i.e., another person wearing a mask

Exposure to Hazards

  • Blood, body fluids, chemical compounds, and toxic chemicals for disinfecting.
  • Sticks and cuts from sharp instruments and blades
  • Wet floors.
  • Pathogens from cleaning and disinfecting instrumentation and equipment

Other Skills and Abilities

Derfor søger vi en projektplanner/porteføljekonsulent, som kan bidrage til at skabe struktur og fremdrift i vores volumen- og strategiske infrastrukturprojekter.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der er nyuddannet, eller som har op til fem års erfaring og ønsker at udvikle dig inden for projekt- og porteføljestyring.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt team

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst porteføljeteam i afdelingen Portefølje og PMO, som hører hjemme i Energinet Systemansvar og har lokation i Fredericia. Her arbejder vi med de første faser af Energinets volumen- og strategiske projekter og med at skabe overblik, prioritering og balance på tværs af en voksende projektportefølje.

Porteføljeteamet består foruden dig af fire porteføljekonsulenter, en dataanalytiker og to plannere. Sammen arbejder vi med prioritering og balancering på porteføljeniveau samt fremdrift, opfølgning og risikoafdækning på projektniveau. Vi lægger vægt på tæt samarbejde, høj faglighed og løbende videndeling.

En rolle med både projekt- og porteføljeperspektiv

Din rolle bliver todelt. Du får ansvar som planner på udvalgte infrastrukturprojekter, hvor du følger op på planer, deadlines, risici og leverancer. Samtidig bidrager du sammen med teamets porteføljekonsulenter til at skabe overblik over og understøtte styringen af den samlede projektportefølje.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med projektledere og andre nøglepersoner. Her bliver din opgave at sikre et solidt planlægningsgrundlag, identificere behov for justeringer og formidle status klart og rettidigt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Koordinere og følge op med projektledere og projektteams
  • Følge op på tidsplaner, milepæle og leverancer
  • Udarbejde statusrapportering til relevante interessenter
  • Identificere behov for planjusteringer og følge op på aftalte handlinger
  • Gennemføre risikoanalyser og bidrage til risikostyring
  • Indsamle og strukturere data til kapacitets- og ressourceplanlægning
  • Vedligeholde og udvikle værktøjer og processer til projektprioritering
  • Understøtte implementeringen af nye processer og værktøjer
  • Bidrage til bedre arbejdsgange og større systematik i planlægningen

Opgaverne varierer. Nogle kræver fordybelse og analyse, mens andre handler om at facilitere workshops, samle interessenter og sikre tydelig koordinering.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse på minimum kandidatniveau (cand.merc, ingeniør eller lignende). Du kan både være nyuddannet eller have op til fem års relevant erfaring.

Vi forventer desuden, at du:

  • Har interesse for projektplanlægning, koordinering og opfølgning
  • Arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik i komplekse opgaver
  • Kommunikerer klart og samarbejder godt med forskellige fagligheder
  • Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer til planlægning og rapportering
  • Er nysgerrig, proaktiv og motiveret for at lære
  • Trives med en varieret hverdag, hvor prioriteringer og opgaver kan ændre sig

Erfaring fra en lignende stilling er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig, tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til teamets fælles leverancer.

”Planner- og porteføljefunktionerne er afgørende for, at vi kan levere vores store anlægsprojekter til tiden og i den rette kvalitet. I takt med at projekterne bliver mere komplekse, får vi behov for at styrke både nye og eksisterende opgaver i afdelingen. For at lykkes i rollen skal du være åben, lyttende og villig til at lære. Vi arbejder som ét team, og videndeling og kvalitet i vores leverancer er afgørende for vores succes,” fortæller Director, Morten Byskov Jacobsen.

Vi tilbyder stor fleksibilitet i hverdagen, herunder mulighed for hjemmearbejde, et højt fagligt niveau og gode muligheder for både personlig og professionel udvikling.

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?

Vi beder dig ikke om en traditionel ansøgning. Til gengæld ser vi frem til at modtage dit målrettede CV med en kort motivation for at søge stillingen senest 15. oktober. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 21. og 22. oktober, og 2. samtale i Fredericia 27. og 28. oktober.

Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Director, Morten Byskov Jacobsen på tlf. +45 2929 3263 tirsdage og fredage mellem 9 og 10, dog ikke i uge 42.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

title: Software Engineer III
description:
The Software Engineer III is a key technical contributor within Oceaneering Technologies (OTECH), responsible for driving software development efforts that support one‑of‑a‑kind underwater systems built for U.S. Navy and other DoW customers. Engineers at this level apply deep understanding of the software lifecycle to design system architectures, lead or significantly contribute to project software activities, and ensure delivered solutions satisfy electrical, mechanical, and operational (CONOPS) needs while collaborating closely with engineering leads, project managers, and external customers.


Beyond feature leadership, this role executes hands‑on systems software work across Linux‑based distributed and embedded environments—implementing system services and application components; building hardware/software interfaces and device drivers; enabling data‑processing functions; and delivering robust communications capabilities. Typical development spans native Linux and containerized deployments (e.g., Docker/Podman) with orchestration via Kubernetes, and leverages DDS‑based publish/subscribe messaging for real‑time, mission‑critical data exchange—consistent with OTECH integration‑lab practices and container/DDS orchestration patterns.


Engineers will participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements implementation, software design, coding, unit and integration testing, debugging, peer reviews, configuration management, and technical documentation. The role benefits from a systems‑programming foundation (memory/resource management, multithreading/concurrency, IPC, networking, and efficient data structures) and facility with modern toolchains and build systems (GCC/Clang, Cargo, CMake), debugging and analysis tools (GDB, sanitizers), and structured data formats (JSON, XML). Work products are supported by CI/CD pipelines and automated testing to ensure reliability and repeatability; engineers frequently contribute to test harnesses and lab workflows that validate containerized services and DDS participants under failure‑recovery and health‑check scenarios.


Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to see the big picture, and a capacity to devise innovative solutions when conventional approaches fall short. Engineers are expected to mentor junior developers, support proposal and design trade studies, and participate in software testing across factory floor, offsite, and offshore environments—developing solutions that integrate seamlessly with sensors, SBC‑based control systems, and mission operations while meeting documentation and CDRL acceptance criteria consistent with OTECH standards.

  • Apply working knowledge of software lifecycle to develop and begin leading software efforts.
  • Implement decisions for designing and maintaining software architecture.
  • Actively interface with other engineering leads, program managers and external customers.
  • Key contributor to creation, maintenance and acceptance of project CDRL’s. This includes requirements management, software documentation, unit testing, software safety testing, and software qualification testing.
  • Contribute to trade studies for hardware such as navigation units, board stacks, and power monitors.
  • Support software testing on the factory floor, offsite, and offshore.
  • Perform analysis of user requirements, concept of operations documents, and high-level system architectures to develop system requirements specifications.
  • Guide system development and implementation planning through preparation of concept of operations, interfaces control documents, hazard analysis, and test plans and procedures.
  • Displays excellent technical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to look at the “big picture” in system design.
  • Demonstrates ability to devise innovative solutions to problems when conventional solutions are insufficient.
  • Prepares reports and presents results to management and client.
  • Schedules can be demanding throughout the year and occasional work outside normal working hours should be anticipated.
  • Mentorship of junior team members.

Essential Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field (or commensurate experience).
  • 5+ years of practical software engineering experience.
  • Foundational understanding of Linux system programming.
  • Proficiency in at least one core systems language: C, C++, or Rust.
  • Understanding of memory and resource management, multithreading/concurrency, and inter‑process communication (IPC).
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and structured data handling.
  • Ability to participate in all phases of the SDLC: requirements implementation, design, coding, unit and integration testing, debugging, peer reviews, configuration management, and documentation.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software, systems, hardware, test, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and present engineering concepts effectively.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoW Security Clearance.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing underwater vehicle or robotic software frameworks and extending framework capabilities.
  • Experience working on DoW software programs.
  • Experience with Linux or bare‑metal firmware development.
  • Experience developing system services, application components, hardware/software interfaces, or data‑processing functions for Linux‑based distributed or embedded systems.
  • Familiarity with Linux system programming fundamentals (memory/resource management, IPC, multithreading, networking, data structures).
  • Experience with microservices architectures, containerization, and orchestration (Docker/Podman, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and DDS‑based publish/subscribe messaging.
  • Experience with Rust or Python for systems scripting, tooling, or automation.
  • Familiarity with GCC/Clang, Cargo, CMake, build systems, and command‑line development workflows.
  • Experience with debugging tools such as GDB and sanitizers.
  • Experience with microprocessors and SBC‑based control systems interfacing with sensors and hardware (cameras, navigation sensors, valve packs, etc.).
  • Ability to implement and debug communication protocols including UDP/multicast, TCP, serial, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Ability to set up basic bench‑testing environments (power, communications links, analog devices).
  • Proficiency with lab measurement tools such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
  • Experience with Jira, Git, and modern development workflows.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software, systems, hardware, test, and cybersecurity engineering teams.
  • Experience with UI/UX design.

Additional

  • Additional duties as assigned.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Employee benefits vary by role, however, may include Health and Wellness, Mental Health, Retirement Savings, Life and Disability, Paid Maternity and Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, Tuition Reimbursement, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Compensation $118,600.00 - $177,800.00

title: Chief Engineer
description:

Manages all engineering/maintenance operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Accountable for managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance and energy conservation. Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements. Leads the emergency response team for all facility issues.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 2 years experience in the engineering and maintenance or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Property Operations and Engineering Budgets

• Supervises Engineering in the absence of the Director of Engineering.

• Assists in managing the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, electrical and life safety systems.

• Maintains and operates equipment at optimum effectiveness, efficiency and safety.

• Assists in effectively planning, scheduling and evaluating preventative maintenance programs.

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

Managing Profitability

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.

title: Manutentore
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day’s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TV's and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.

Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.

License or Certification: Driver’s License
