title: Voksenaktiveringsmedarbejder til Udrejsecenter Avnstrup
description:
Vil du arbejde med både systematik og relationer – og være med til at bidrage til en indsats, der gennem kompetence- og resurseafklarende forløb gør en reel forskel for mennesker i en sårbar livssituation? Så skal du slå til og byde ind på stillingen som voksenaktiveringsmedarbejder på Udrejsecenter Avnstrup i Hvalsø.

Som voksenaktiveringsmedarbejder på Udrejsecenter Avnstrup bliver du en vigtig del af at skabe aktiviteter, fællesskab og nye muligheder for asylansøgere - i tæt samarbejde med både asylansøgere, kollegaer og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Avnstrup er et Røde Kors-drevet udrejsecenter for afviste asylansøgere. Centret huser børnefamilier og enlige kvinder uden børn.

I vores faglige tilgang til arbejde med afviste asylansøgere har vi fokus på at støtte beboerne i at bevare deres kompetencer og motivation for fremtiden. Opgaven er præget af kompleksitet og dilemmaer, da centrets beboere befinder sig i en livssituation, hvor uvished om fremtiden, mismod og ventetidsbelastninger fylder meget.

Læs mere om center Avnstrup her.


Om opgaven

Opgaven med voksenaktivering er forankret i asylafdelingens strategiske mål om at inddrage asylansøgere som en vigtig resurse i aktiviteter og opgaver på centret - gennem aktiveringsindsats - og bidrage til en tryg og udviklende hverdag for beboerne på centret.

Opgaven er præget af vigtige administrative og dokumentationsmæssige opgaver, der sikrer et solidt fundament for arbejdet med voksne beboere på Udrejsecenter Avnstrup. Vi har løbende fokus på kompetence- og ressourceafklaring samt udvikling og opfølgning på aktiveringstilbud i henhold til gældende bekendtgørelse og lovgivning på asylområdet. Her er et udpluk af konkrete opgaver i funktionen i dag:

  • Helhedstilbud tilbudt voksne beboere +18 år
  • Oprettelse af nye aktiveringstilbud i overensstemmelse med bekendtgørelse og lovgivning på asylområdet
  • Understøtte beboernes læringsproces gennem meningsfulde praktikker
  • Tæt samarbejde med øvrige faggrupper på centret som f.eks. socialrådgivere, voksenundervisere, netværksmedarbejdere, praktiske og tekniske medarbejdere, sundhedspersonale
  • Opsøgende arbejde i lokalsamfundet

Det er vores vedvarende ambitionen at bevæge os endnu tættere på beboerne gennem øget involvering i aktiviteter og større tilstedeværelse i lokalsamfundet.

Der er med andre ord tale om en rolle, hvor du både skal kunne navigere i struktur og systematik – og have lyst til at indgå i tæt relation med beboere, gennem samtaler og aktiviteter.

Om dig

Du har en relevant uddannelse og erfaring fra socialt- eller integrationsarbejde med udsatte grupper i et multikulturelt miljø.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har indsigt eller interesse i beskæftigelse- og kompetenceudvikling
  • Har interesse for og gerne kendskab til opgaveløsning i en politisk ledet organisation
  • Ønsker at inddrage den enkelte beboer i din opgaveløsning på aktiveringsområdet
  • Kan skabe tillid og tryghed i mødet med beboerne og er samtidigt stærk i konflikthåndtering
  • Kan navigere i en mangfoldig kontekst
  • Er struktureret, grundig og procesorienteret
  • Er skarp i klar skriftlig formidling

Hos os får du et meningsfyldt arbejde på en arbejdsplads med et stærkt humanitært værdigrundlag. Du vil have rig mulighed for personlig og fagligudvikling, tværfagligt samarbejde og et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi sammen gør en forskel for vores medmennesker – hver dag.

Ræk ud efter muligheden for at arbejde i verdens største humanitære organisation - send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!



Generelle ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat efter overenskomst med HK/SL (staten)

Arbejdstid: 32 timer om ugen
Kørekort: Nødvendigt
Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027
Arbejdssted: Avnstrupvej 1, 4330 Hvalsø
Referencer: Ved tilbud om ansættelse skal du fremvise en privat straffeattest, og vi indhenter børneattest.
Ansøgningsfrist: 10. november 2026

title: Sognepræst i Øster Hassing Pastorat (genopslag), Aalborg Nordre Provsti, Aalborg Stift
description:
Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Øster Hassing Pastorat, Aalborg Nordre Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Til stillingen er knyttet en forpligtelse som kirkebogsfører og begravelsesmyndighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Øster Hassing Pastorat og hvordan kirkelivet m.v. er i Øster Hassing-Gåser Sogn, kan vi anbefale, at du orienterer dig på sognets hjemmeside:

Link til sognets hjemmeside:

Embedsbeskrivelsen kan du også læse på Aalborg Stifts hjemmeside: Her kan du læse om provstiet og sognet, og om hvilke tanker menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse af lov om ansættelse i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 676 af 13/7/2026)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i folkekirken.

Der er til stillingen knyttet et tillæg på kr. 32.800, - årligt (grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012)

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Bredgade 2A, 9362 Gandrup.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 5.227,00, excl. procentreguleringen pr. 1. august 2026

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Thomas Reinholdt Rasmussen inden menighedsrådet afholder orienteringsmøde.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Aalborg Stift pr. mail til: KMAAL-ANSOEGNING@KM.DK, og ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

title: Property Operations Associate
description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Location: 70 Pine Street, New York City, NY 10005
Time Commitment: Full-Time
Anticipated Schedule: Open availability is required, including weekends, holidays, and overnights.

The Role

The Property Operations Associate (Hospitality) role is an on-site facilitator of everything that the Kasa guest will experience during their stay. As a Property Operations Associate you are an important part of the East market, supporting efficient and successful operations for 70 Pine. You will be the face of Kasa during the guest’s stay, interacting with guests face to face, providing assistance and recommendations and address any concerns that arise. You will be knowledgeable of property operations and be an extension of the Guest Experience team. Through regular in-person unit inspections, you are responsible for ensuring that all public spaces are clean, safe, and well-maintained, including common areas and individual units, to Kasa brand standards, setting the tone of the property and are ready in time for check-in.
Like many operations roles, there is no “typical day” but you will collaborate daily with Kasa teams and partners to drive results. You will identify, prioritize, and execute cost-effective property improvements aligned with Kasa brand standards. You will identify, prioritize, and execute cost-effective property improvements aligned with Kasa brand standards. Daily tasks will consist of, but are not limited to: welcoming guests, facilitating guest relocations, planning + strategizing for next-day operations, enhancing VIP experience, hosting guest engagement events, and providing guests with local area recommendations.
A typical schedule for this role is based on business needs in your market, sometimes including nights and weekends and holidays, as we are in the hospitality industry. While you are not 'on-call 24/7' for this job, during emergencies, you will get a call and if you're available, we compensate above state requirements to a minimum of 2 hours Overtime, on defined days off or after working hours.

Unleash your career potential at Kasa

We're building a tech-enabled global hospitality brand that unleashes the potential of liveable space. Hospitality is at the core of who we are, and we are committed to providing our teams the same care we give our guests, neighbors, and partners.

Required Attributes

  • Think Like an Owner: Think like an owner at all times by taking accountability for all facets of unit/building performance; enhance partner satisfaction through creation of value by maximizing operating profit per unit.
  • Tech Savvy: Proficient with modern technology tools and effectively uses them to complete daily work.
  • Handy: Comfortable with using a toolkit and able to devise clever solutions to common minor repairs and maintenance tasks.
  • Quality Control Leader: Establish and implement streamlined processes that ensure adherence to high-quality standards through identification of proactive improvements and effective collaboration with external partners.
  • Reliable: Takes pride in arriving to work on time and welcomes the opportunity to work nights and weekends.
  • Collaborative: Works effectively with leadership and peers to meet goals and contribute to ideas that will deliver operational and experiential improvements for the department.
  • Smooth Operator: Approach problem resolution with confidence, empathy, and creativity to swiftly and successfully resolve guest-stated and unstated needs.
  • Change Agent: Supports tactical execution of change management efforts to implement new processes, tools, or technology including, but not limited to communication plans and training development.
  • Process Minded: Effectively executes established processes with precision and surfaces process deficiencies which negatively impact the guest experience.
Don’t meet all of the qualifications? We want you to consider all of your skills and experiences - both professional and personal- that would make you successful in this role. Although some qualifications are essential, others can be attained with time. We believe diverse perspectives, upbringings, and knowledge contribute to our strong company culture and we encourage you to apply.

Expected Results

  • Role Objective 1: Drive quality outcomes through increased guest satisfaction and company metrics.
  • Role Objective 2: Complete tasks that drive productivity within the operation.

Benefits

  • Kasa Travel Credit: We love to travel! Kasa employees get an allowance of free stays with us in any of our locations, plus a discount on any night for friends and family.

  • The Pay: The starting base pay range for this role is $26.00 and is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity, bonus, perks, benefits, and Kasa Travel Credits.

  • Paid Time Off: Full-time hourly Kasa employees accrue paid time off at a generous rate that increases with tenure.

  • Health Coverage: We’ve invested in comprehensive health insurance options to help when you need it most, including a company-sponsored plan with fertility coverage.

Kasa is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Kasa is an E-Verify participant. We will verify the identity and employment eligibility of all persons hired to work in the United States by matching information employees provide on the Form I-9 against records available to the Social Security Administration (SSA) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). You may find more information here and here.

Kasa does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or People & Talent team.

A Note on Recruiting & Job Scams

The Kasa Talent Acquisition team will only communicate from email addresses that use the URLs and . We will not use apps such as Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, or Google Hangouts for communicating with you. We will never ask you to send us money or technology to work for our company. If you believe you are a scam victim, please review your local government consumer protections guidance and reach out to them directly. US-based applicants may refer to this article from consumer.ftc.gov for more details.

title: Part-Time Leasing Consultant - ReNew Avery Park
description:
About Trinity Property Consultants

At Trinity Property Consultants, your expertise fuels our mission. Guided by our values of innovation, teamwork, excellence, and empowerment, we’ve been a leader in the multifamily industry for over 25 years and proudly manage properties for a nationally ranked NMHC’s Apartment Owner. We are building more than great places to live – we’re creating vibrant communities and meaningful careers.

Compensation: $20 to $23 hourly, depending on experience, plus lease commissions and lease renewal bonuses.

Schedule: Monday, Friday, and Saturday. Business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. and Saturday,10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

The Opportunity

As a Leasing Consultant, you will be the face of the property, providing exceptional customer service while driving leasing goals and creating a seamless experience for prospective and current residents. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in multifamily property management while helping shape a welcoming, thriving community.

What You’ll Own

Leasing & Sales

  • Assist in completing market surveys and execute marketing strategies to maintain strong occupancy.
  • Process rental applications accurately and efficiently.
  • Guide residents through move-in, ensuring a smooth experience.

Resident Experience & Service

  • Provide superior customer service, responding promptly and professionally to resident inquiries or concerns.
  • Process maintenance requests and work with the team to ensure timely resolution.
  • Maintain resident files with completeness and accuracy.

Operational & Administrative Performance

  • Maintain daily updates of unit availability and community calendars.
  • Perform regular inspections to ensure all units meet Trinity’s move-in ready standards.
  • Support property management with administrative duties, phone support, and other tasks as needed.
  • Conduct move-out inspections and assist with property turnover procedures.
  • Handle resident collections in accordance with Trinity’s standards.

What You Bring

  • Customer Focus: Passion for providing a high-quality, personalized experience for residents.
  • Sales Drive: Consistently achieve leasing objectives while upholding the highest standards of professionalism.
  • Organization & Efficiency: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize wisely, and maintain accurate records.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with residents, prospects, and the team.
  • Problem Solving: Able to handle high-stress situations and resolve conflicts constructively.

Qualifications

  • Experience: At least 1 year in a customer service or sales role; multifamily leasing experience preferred.

  • Tech Proficiency: Intermediate skills in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with Yardi, Entrata, EliseAI, Celeri and social media is a bonus.

Requirements

Availability & Travel

This position will require availability for nights, weekends, and holidays as needed. Active participation in team functions and regional or company activities is expected.

Physical Demands

This position necessitates regular periods of sitting, standing, walking, as well as use of hands and arms. Occasional climbing may be required. Extended use of computers or telephones is also necessary. The role may require lifting up to 25 pounds independently, and occasionally up to 50 pounds with assistance. The ability to respond promptly to both visual and auditory alarms is essential. Candidates must be able to work both indoors and outdoors under various weather conditions, including rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, and sleet.

We Take Care of You

  • Volunteer Time Off: Up to 16 hours annually (8 for personal volunteer activities, 8 for company-sponsored events).
  • Perks: Professional development, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, and more.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Trinity Property Consultants is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful workplace where all individuals can thrive irrespective of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability or other protected classes.

Ready to Join Us?

Explore what it’s like to grow your career with a company that values people as much as performance. Learn more and apply today!

title: Hospital Admissions Coordinator
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology, to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8-hour shifts between the business hours of 7am-6pm. Schedule to be determined upon hire.

Location: This role is Office-Based in MA.

  • If you live in MA, you will enjoy the flexibility of a remote/office-based* role as you take on some tough challenges
  • Office-based schedule to be determined by manager upon hire
  • Will be required to work onsite 5 days/week for approximately first 60 days for training; training likely to be onsite at various Atrius locations, locations to be determined upon hire

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates surgical bookings and hospital admissions for multiple clinicians either within the same or across multiple specialties and/or departments
  • Understands and effectively maneuvers the surgical booking process, understanding and following the requirements for each hospital, insurance provider and clinician as well as applicable Atrius Health booking guidelines Juggles and prioritize various scheduling needs effectively
  • Schedules patients for hospital admissions and surgical procedures
  • Coordinates and books operating room time and surgeon's time
  • Handles any needed rescheduling due to patient or facility conflicts
  • May work with other HACS and/or Atrius Health departments to resolve scheduling or booking conflicts
  • Interacts with patients throughout the booking process, responding to requests and providing information in a timely and compassionate manner
  • Ensures patients understand all their pre- and post-operative appointments as well as any necessary testing prior to surgery (e.g., lab or radiology work)
  • Ensures necessary written material accurately reflects these appointments and includes any directions or special instructions in correspondence
  • Accurately relays information between patients and clinicians, often dealing with high levels of patient frustration or anxiety
  • Completes outside referral documents and obtains prior authorization for admission where applicable
  • Maintains and utilizes a thorough understanding and knowledge base of the different payors and the coverage they provide for surgeries
  • Ensures various requirements and procedures needed are met so that procedures can occur with minimal errors from an administrative standpoint
  • Keeps current with the changes in insurance company policies and procedures
  • Ensures that all necessary documents and preparatory activities have been selected and forwards all pertinent information to the hospital prior to the patient's admission
  • Works with clinicians and primary care physicians to ensure appropriate pre-operative testing is done and facilitates medical clearance for the needed procedure
  • Proactively ensures necessary information for admissions is available and processed correctly
  • Maintains data and creates documents in electronic tracking system
  • May draft and type routine correspondence
  • Provides back-up coverage for other clinical support positions within the assigned department when appropriate
  • Sends electronic spreadsheets and updates to internal and external clients
  • Conducts written or verbal follow-up procedures
  • May send hospital booking information to the coding and compliance department to ensure that all relevant revenue is captured
  • May fax or batch materials for legal tracking purposes
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Accesses only the minimum necessary protected health information (PHI) for the performance of job duties
  • Actively protects the confidentiality and privacy of all protected health information they access in all its forms (written, verbal, and electronic, etc.) taking reasonable precautions to prohibit unauthorized access
  • Complies with all Atrius Health and departmental privacy policies, procedures and protocols
  • Follows HIPAA privacy guidelines without deviation when handling protected health information

What are the reasons to consider working for UnitedHealth Group? Put it all together - competitive base pay, a full and comprehensive benefit program, performance rewards, and a management team who demonstrates their commitment to your success. Some of our offerings include:

  • Paid Time Off which you start to accrue with your first pay period plus 8 Paid Holidays
  • Medical Plan options along with participation in a Health Spending Account or a Health Saving account
  • Dental, Vision, Life& AD&D Insurance along with Short-term disability and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • 401(k) Savings Plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Education Reimbursement
  • Employee Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Voluntary Benefits (pet insurance, legal insurance, LTC Insurance, etc.)

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 2+ years of administrative experience in a medical or healthcare setting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous EPIC experience
  • Previous surgical scheduling experience

Soft Skills:

  • Must be professional with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be detail oriented and a self-starter
  • Strong task coordination skills with proven ability to multi-task needed
  • Ability to handle unexpected situations calmly and effectively
  • Must be able to deal effectively with high levels of anxiety and patient emotion surrounding surgical procedures and hospital admissions
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail needed to avoid issues with scheduling both routine and emergency procedures
  • Knowledge of various types of insurance coverage is desirable

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $18.00 to $32.00 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. title: Machine Shop Assistant
description:
About Nimble

Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.

We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids.

Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including Fei-Fei Li (Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab), Marc Raibert (founder of Boston Dynamics), and Sebastian Thrun (founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles).

Let’s be legendary.

Link: Nimble Closes $106 Million Series C Funding Round, Scales Fully Autonomous Fulfillment with FedEx
Link: FedEx Announces Expansion of FedEx Fulfillment With Nimble Alliance
Why Join Nimble?
At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce.
Nimble's Core Values:
Be relentlessly resourceful - Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.
Be legendary - Be the very best and do work that inspires.
Be humble - Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.
Be dependable - Take ownership and deliver with high agency.

Role

As a Machine Shop Assistant, you’ll set up and run CNC and manual equipment to produce precision parts for Nimble’s engineering and production teams. You’ll work directly from engineering drawings, check your own work, and help keep the shop running at a high standard. This role is open to experienced CNC operators and recent machining program graduates.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate CNC mills and lathes, plus manual lathes and milling machines, to produce parts to print
  • Read and interpret blueprints and engineering drawings, including GD&T callouts
  • Set work and tool offsets, and adjust offsets and cutter compensation to hold tolerance
  • Inspect parts with analog and digital measuring tools and verify accuracy before parts leave the machine
  • Complete production logs accurately and track part counts as jobs progress
  • Flag quality issues, tooling wear, or drawing questions to the shop lead or engineering
  • Perform routine machine maintenance, including cleaning and scheduled service intervals
  • Keep the work area clean, organized, and safe

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience as a CNC operator, or completion of a machining/CNC program with hands-on machine time
  • Experience setting up CNC and/or manual lathes and mills
  • Experience with analog and digital measuring tools
  • Ability to read blueprints, with working knowledge of GD&T
  • Experience using cutter compensation and adjusting machine offsets independently (preferred for recent graduates)
  • Accurate record-keeping and part tracking
  • Ability to follow instructions meticulously and check parts for accuracy
  • Ability to perform equipment maintenance and service intervals
  • Available for swing shift (1:00pm–8:30pm) and weekends
  • Able to work extended hours and additional weekends as needed
  • Able to work on-site in San Francisco

Compensation

The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $19.61 - $25/hourly. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this position will also receive generous equity for this position.
Culture:
We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!
Nimble Robotics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state, federal or local laws.
Nimble's Benefits
Unlimited Flexible Time Off
Enjoy the time you need to travel, rejuvenate, and connect with friends and family.
Health Insurance
Nimble provides medical, dental, and vision insurance through several premier plans and options to support you and your family.
Paid Parental Leave
Enjoy paid bonding time following a birth.
Commuter Benefits
Take the stress out of commuting with access to fully paid parking spots.
Referral Bonus
Get a cash bonus for any friend or colleagues that you refer to us that we end up hiring.
401k
Contribute towards a 401k for retirement planning.
Equity
Be an owner in Nimble through our equity program

title: Kirkegårdskonsulent til Haderslev Stift
description:
Haderslev Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent

Haderslev Stift søger en kirkegårdskonsulent med tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset i 4 år og udløber den 31. december 2030.

Stillingen er en bibeskæftigelse.

Profil

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet landskabsarkitekt fra Det Biovidenskabelige Fakultet for Fødevarer, Veterinærmedicin og Naturressourcer, Kunstakademiets Arkitektskole, Århus Arkitektskole eller har en tilsvarende godkendt udenlandsk uddannelse.

Vi forventer, at du har erfaring med kirkegårde eller lignende anlæg.

Opgaver

Opgaverne indebærer råd og vejledning til stift, provsti eller menighedsråd om folkekirkens kirkegårde, kirkegårdens bygninger og kirkegårdens samspil med omgivelserne.

Kirkegårdskonsulenten forventes blandt andet at kunne udtale sig om:

  • anlæggelse, udvidelse og nedlæggelse af kirkegårde

  • ændring og regulering af kirkegårdens indretning

  • bevarings- og udviklingsplaner

  • beplantning og fjernelse af træer

  • tilgængelighed og arbejdsmiljø

  • driftsforhold

  • bygninger på kirkegården

  • parkeringspladser til brug for kirken eller kirkegården

  • kirkegårdens kulturhistoriske og landskabelige værdier

  • kirkegårdens samspil med kirken og omgivelserne

Kirkegårdskonsulenten rådgiver ikke generelt om plan- og landzonelovgivning.

Som kirkegårdskonsulent skal du efter anmodning afgive erklæring i sager, der vedrører ovenstående.

Du vil også skulle yde råd og vejledning til menighedsråd og kirkegårdsbestyrelser, som beder om det.

Kirkegårdskonsulenten deltager desuden også i stiftets konsulentrunder, hvor vi bl.a. besøger kirkegårde i stiftet, hvor et menighedsråd har ønsker eller planer om et projekt. Ved konsulentrunderne drøftes projektet med menighedsrådet, og kirkegårdskonsulenten sætter sin faglighed i spil sammen med stiftets øvrige konsulenter. Der afholdes ca. 4 konsulentrunder pr. år.

Kirkegårdskonsulenten har desuden en særlig rolle ved kategoriseringen af umistelige kirkegårde.

Konsulenten udpeger de kirkegårde, som efter konsulentens vurdering bør kategoriseres som umistelige, og sender en udtalelse til stiftsøvrigheden.

Det praktiske

Som kirkegårdskonsulent virker du som rådgiver for de kirkelige myndigheder efter reglerne i:

  • Kirkeministeriets bekendtgørelse nr. 955 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Kirkeministeriets cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter

  • Vejledning nr. 9789 af 6. oktober 2009 om folkekirkens konsulenter

Det er vigtigt at være opmærksom på, at du som kirkegårdskonsulent ikke må påtage dig projekteringsopgaver for menighedsråd inden for det stift, du er ansat, medmindre stiftet undtagelsesvis godkender det.

Honorar

Honoraret udgør pr. 1. januar 2026:

  • Rådgivningssager i henhold til § 8 i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.236 kr. pr. time

  • Erklæringssager i henhold til § 7, stk. 1, i cirkulære nr. 9779 af 6. oktober 2009 om fællesinstruks for folkekirkens konsulenter: 1.854 kr. pr. erklæring

Honoraret tillægges feriegodtgørelse på 12,5%, mens der ikke skal tillægges moms.

Satserne reguleres årligt pr. 1. januar.

Ansøgning

CV og ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til Haderslev Stift på kmhad@km.dk.

Vi ser gerne, at din ansøgning ledsages af eksempler på relevante referencer eller tidligere gennemførte projekter, der dokumenterer erfaring med rådgivning inden for de opgaveområder, som er beskrevet i opslaget.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du ringe til kontorchef Lars Chr. Kjærgaard på . 73 52 45 93 eller stiftsfuldmægtig Lone Petri Kristensen på . 73 52 45 98 i uge 42 og 43.

Ansøgningsfristen udløber den 1. november 2026 kl. 12.00.

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 20. november 2026 alternativt den 23. november 2026.

title: FLEX Director, Product Manager - Access Controls
description:
This is a temporary position.

JOB SUMMARY

Marriott is transforming its arrivals experience and looking for a Director of Product Management – Guest Access to lead a durable, cross-functional team accountable for the operational side of access controls. This role owns outcomes related to lock reliability, access failure recovery, lock health visibility, vendor accountability, and owner confidence—ensuring digital access scales safely across thousands of properties without increasing operational burden or risk.

Beyond stabilizing today’s access ecosystem, this role is responsible for helping Marriott define, shape, and prove the “lock of the future.” Innovation is treated as disciplined product discovery grounded in real property constraints, owner economics, and operational viability.

The Director ensures that future access capabilities reduce operational complexity, improve reliability and predictability at scale, remain supportable across diverse geographies and vendors, and strengthen security, trust, and owner confidence.

Why This Role Matters

This role ensures Marriott can scale digital access responsibly while defining the lock of the future, where innovation strengthens trust, reduces operational risk, and enables a modern arrival experience across the global portfolio.

CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience/certification
  • 8+ years of product management experience with operationally critical or platform systems
  • Proven experience leading empowered Agile product teams
  • Background in platforms, reliability, observability, or operational tooling
  • Ability to balance innovation with execution and risk management
  • Experience influencing across Engineering, Operations, Vendors, and Executive stakeholders

Preferred

  • Experience in access controls and lock ecosystems

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Outcomes Owned by This Role

  • Operationally reliable and predictable guest access
  • Failures that are understandable, diagnosable, and recoverable
  • A shift from reactive support to proactive monitoring
  • Clear vendor accountability through transparent standards and scorecards
  • Sustainable innovation that advances the next generation of access controls

Product Leadership

  • Own the problem of space, product strategy, and outcomes for Access Controls as experienced by hotels, associates, and owners.
  • Lead a durable, empowered Agile team accountable for business and operational outcomes, not feature delivery.
  • Provide clear context and success measures while enabling teams to discover the best solutions.
  • Balance guest experience, operational reality, property diversity, and owner risk tolerance.

Operational Reliability & No-Surprises Access

  • Own access reliability at scale across registration, delivery, and unlock performance.
  • Ensure access failures surface clear, actionable causes to hotel staff.
  • Improve diagnostics and recovery paths.
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Platform, and Security teams on resilience and observability.

Proactive Lock Health & Incident Prevention

  • Lead product strategy for lock health telemetry including battery, firmware, and time drift.

Access Failure Recovery & Supportability

  • Design fast, intuitive recovery paths without defaulting guests to the front desk.

  • Treat supportability as a first-class product requirement.

Lock Vendor Strategy, Standards & Accountability

  • Own the Lock Vendor Scorecard as a product capability.
  • Define standards for performance, telemetry, certification, and incident response.

Owner Confidence & Transparency

  • Provide clear visibility into access performance and failure causes for owners.
  • Partner with Risk, Legal, Fraud, and Finance to manage exposure.

Innovation – Defining the Lock of the Future

title: Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement
description:
Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement

Global | Permanent or 12-month rotational assignment

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will deliver data, reporting and platform change from requirement definition through testing to deployment and adoption.

  • Define and document Operations’ data and reporting requirements, and agree them with IT and the Transformation Office.

  • Support platform change through build, and own the Operations-side test strategy including UAT and defect resolution.

  • Build the data and reporting outputs needed to evidence a problem and measure the benefit of a change.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues, tracing them to source rather than correcting downstream.

  • Support implementation of platform change across fund structures, new client setups and transitions.

  • Work with the Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions and Digital Workflow, Automation & AI focus areas where delivery depends on data or reporting capability.

  • Work directly with Operations teams to make sure change is understood, trained out and genuinely adopted.

  • Produce project documentation, status reporting and ad hoc analysis as required.

About You

You have 8+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, with hands-on exposure to data, reporting or platform work.

  • Hands-on experience of reporting build, data analysis, system implementation or project delivery.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes and the data that underpins them.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate large data sets and evidence a recommendation.

  • Project management skills with attention to detail and a proven ability to multi-task.

  • Confident engaging both operational teams and technology partners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); familiarity with reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; professional accounting designation is preferred.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Clinical Enterprise Plan (CEP) Program Manager
description:
The IT Health Program Manager provides strategic and operational program leadership for enterprise initiatives within UCSF Health's Clinical Enterprise Plan (CEP), with primary responsibility for the Next Generation Operating Platform (NGOP). The role connects enterprise strategy, governance, funding, prioritization, and Health IT delivery across a complex portfolio of interdependent initiatives. The Program Manager establishes the integrated program structure, roadmap, governance cadence, decision framework, financial oversight, and executive reporting needed to translate NGOP priorities into coordinated, measurable outcomes. Responsibilities include managing cross-functional dependencies, risks, resource constraints, and delivery commitments while ensuring NGOP-generated technology needs are routed through and aligned with established Health IT portfolio governance.

The Program Manager serves as the central integration point among the NGOP executive sponsor, operational co-chairs and leaders, Health IT leadership, portfolio leaders, Finance, clinical and business stakeholders, and project managers assigned to individual initiatives. The role facilitates executive decision-making, maintains clear accountability for outcomes, and ensures that individual projects remain coordinated to the broader NGOP roadmap, funding strategy, and enterprise objectives.

As the CEP / NGOP Program Manager, you will lead a highly visible enterprise program focused on transforming the operating platform that supports UCSF Health's strategic priorities. NGOP is one of the strategic pillars within CEP and is expected to generate and advance initiatives spanning areas such as revenue cycle, enterprise efficiency, workforce enablement, technology platforms, contracting, and other cross-enterprise opportunities. Individual initiatives may have dedicated project managers; this role operates at the program level to integrate those efforts, manage the overall roadmap, and maintain alignment across governance bodies.

This role reports directly to the Director of the Health IT Project Management Office and partners closely with the NGOP executive sponsor, operational leadership, Health IT Executive Steering, enterprise portfolio leaders, Finance, and initiative owners. The Program Manager ensures that NGOP priorities and investments are translated into executable work while preserving the decision rights, prioritization processes, resource allocation practices, and delivery accountability of Health IT portfolio governance.

This role requires a deep understanding of institutional, medical center, and systemwide priorities and the ability to lead complex enterprise programs in areas where governance, funding, operating models, and delivery pathways may still be evolving. The incumbent will apply expert program management judgment to create structure in ambiguity, synthesize information across disciplines, surface enterprise trade-offs, and drive decisions through the appropriate governance channels.

CEP is emerging as the mechanism for setting enterprise priorities, funding investments, and driving transformational outcomes across UCSF Health. Health IT maintains established portfolio structures responsible for governance, prioritization, roadmap management, resource planning, and delivery accountability. The CEP / NGOP Program Manager will help create a clear line of sight from enterprise strategy and investment decisions through portfolio prioritization and initiative execution, reducing governance duplication and strengthening accountability for outcomes.

NGOP is expected to operate as a source of enterprise priorities and funded initiatives while working through established Health IT governance for technology delivery. The Program Manager will help define and operationalize how NGOP priorities, funding requests, portfolio capacity, and project execution interact, including the coordination of capital, CEP, and operating funding considerations. The role will maintain transparency regarding roadmap, spend, benefits, capacity constraints, dependencies, and decisions requiring escalation.

As a key member of the UCSF Health IT PMO, the Program Manager will apply disciplined program management practices while working across clinical, operational, financial, administrative, and technology domains. Success requires strong executive communication, facilitation, financial acumen, governance design, benefits orientation, and the ability to influence outcomes across a highly matrixed organization without direct authority.

Explicit Strategic Outcomes for this role include:

  • An integrated NGOP roadmap that connects CEP priorities, approved investments, Health IT portfolio delivery, and measurable enterprise outcomes.

  • Transparent governance and decision-making for priorities, funding, resource capacity, risks, dependencies, and escalations across NGOP initiatives.

  • Disciplined tracking of financial and operational benefits, including revenue cycle improvement, cost savings, efficiency, and other outcomes established by NGOP executive leadership.

The Program Manager will establish a repeatable operating model for NGOP that supports executive governance while enabling individual initiative teams to execute effectively. This includes coordinating roadmap and spend reviews, maintaining integrated program reporting, clarifying decision rights, and ensuring that new technology requests move through the appropriate Health IT portfolio and enterprise governance pathways. The role will continuously identify opportunities to simplify governance, improve visibility, and strengthen the connection between enterprise strategy and delivery execution.

Department Overview

The IT Health Project Management Office (PMO) provides centralized leadership and delivery support for a diverse portfolio of technology initiatives across UCSF. The PMO partners with clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders to plan and execute projects that advance patient care, research, and academic excellence. Through standardized methodologies, tools, and best practices, the PMO promotes consistent, high-quality project delivery aligned with organizational priorities.

The PMO manages projects of varying size, scope, and complexity, including large-scale, cross-functional initiatives with significant organizational impact. The team emphasizes strong stakeholder engagement, disciplined execution, and proactive risk management while maintaining flexibility to meet the evolving needs of a complex academic health environment. By fostering collaboration, transparency, and accountability, the PMO plays a critical role in enabling strategic outcomes and improving operational efficiency across the enterprise.

The IT Program Manager must be able to adhere and emulate the Health IT culture and core values as stated below:

“People First: Patients are healthier and families happier with clinical systems to support them. Our solutions enable providers and staff to pioneer care, train the next generation of clinical leaders, and secure UCSF’s future. We use talent, creativity, and diverse skillsets to tackle tough problems. We strive to be proactive, and make time to innovate, appreciate and connect. When something big is needed, we deliver.

Health IT Core Values include:

Judgment: Makes wise decisions, identifies root causes, thinks strategically, and prioritizes what to do now and what can be improved later.

Communication: Listens well, is concise and articulate in speech and writing, treats people with respect independent of their status, and maintains calm poise in stressful situations.

Impact: Accomplishes amazing amounts of important work, colleagues can rely upon you, focuses on results,

exhibits bias-to-action, and avoids analysis-paralysis

Innovation: Finds practical solutions to hard problems, suggests better approaches and new ideas that prove useful, and stays nimble by minimizing complexity and finding time to simplify.

Collaboration: Understands that work cannot be accomplished solely as an individual contributor; works through others to develop holistic solutions that meet our customer needs and the goals of the organization.

title: Material Flow Analyst (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MATERIAL FLOW ANALYST (STARSHIP)

Material Flow Analysts are focused on using data to support effective inventory management and efficient material flow at Starbase. They improve, maintain, and monitor the Materials Management toolset to assist operations with daily production support functions and continuous improvement. Material Flow Analysts possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, as well as a solid understanding of material flow fundamentals including inventory control, storage strategies, part routing, packaging concepts, lineside replenishment and materials management systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support inventory accuracy: Monitor inventory data daily via the cycle counting program to ensure a high level of accuracy and immediate reaction to process failures or incorrect behaviors
  • Drive continuous improvement: Use data to identify opportunities for process and systems improvement and lead efforts to implement changes that result in improved safety, inventory accuracy, delivery and/or productivity
  • Support production: Work closely with leaders, production coordinators and specialists to ensure that parts are flowing through the process and available on the lineside for production. Proactively identify and resolve part shortages or inventory discrepancies to prevent production delays
  • Report on metrics: Conduct frequent reviews of area metrics to support leadership in tracking performance and identify trends for improvement. Prepare and present clear, data-driven reports with actionable insights
  • Collaborate on critical projects: Support successful project completion by providing data to enable design decisions, owning key task completion, monitoring progress and ensuring on-time completion

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree; OR high school diploma or equivalency certificate AND 3+ years of experience in inventory analytics
  • 1+ years of experience in operations, manufacturing, or supply chain

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proficient in use of SQL in operations analysis
  • Experience building and using business intelligence tools such PowerBI or Tableau
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially advanced Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas) for data aggregation and analysis
  • Ability to analyze data and check for accuracy/errors based on process and systems knowledge
  • Experience with inventory management and production systems (MRP/ERP systems)
  • Demonstrated capability to manage projects with tight timelines and ambiguous problem statements
  • Understanding of Supply Chain and Inventory Control fundamentals
  • Superior attention to details
  • Experience sharing information effectively and ability to influence decisions
  • Experience with lean, six sigma or related operational efficiency principles
  • Ability to work autonomously or as a team in a highly demanding and fast paced environment
  • Excellent written and communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones
  • This position requires being onsite – remote work not considered

The Power & Recovery Boiler Reliability Outage Coordinator is responsible for the reliability, inspection, and outage execution of all steam‑producing and recovery‑related assets, including power boilers, recovery boilers, bark boilers, HRSG, black liquor evaporators, high pressure piping (650psi and above) and electrostatic precipitators. This role ensures safe, efficient, and cost‑effective outage performance while driving long‑term reliability improvements across the mill’s power and recovery systems.

The manager leads outage strategy, develops detailed work scopes, oversees contractor execution, and ensures compliance with corporate reliability standards, orange book standards, manufacturing alerts, environmental regulations, insurance requirements, and pressure‑vessel codes.

The Job You Will Perform:

Outage Leadership & Execution

  • Lead all scheduled and forced outages for boilers, ESPs, associated systems, and evaporator annual outages.
  • Develop outage work scopes including inspections, NDE, pressure‑part repairs, evaporator cleaning/inspection, ESP rebuilds, and critical path planning.
  • Coordinate multi‑disciplinary teams including operations, maintenance, contractors, OEMs, and corporate engineering.
  • Work with the area teams to develop a detailed integrated schedule.
  • Manage outage schedules, resource loading, daily progress reporting, and critical path control.
  • Oversee contractor performance, safety compliance, and quality assurance.

Reliability Engineering & Asset Health

  • Perform and oversee inspections of boilers, evaporators, and precipitators, documenting condition, degradation mechanisms, and repair recommendations.
  • Diagnose reliability issues such as fouling, plugging, corrosion, tube failures, ESP performance degradation, and evaporator capacity loss.
  • Integrate findings into long‑range reliability plans and capital planning.
  • Champion predictive and preventive maintenance improvements, including RCM‑based diagnostics and inspection interval optimization.
  • Maintain quarterly boiler leak reports for corporate

Environmental & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure ESP reliability and performance meet environmental permit requirements.
  • Support compliance with NBIC, ASME, state boiler codes, and mill environmental standards.
  • Lead outage activities that directly impact emissions, steam balance, and chemical recovery efficiency.

Financial & Project Management

  • Manage outage budgets, procurement, contractor cost tracking, and financial forecasting.
  • Prepare and deliver post‑outage reports, lessons learned, and reliability improvement plans.
  • Support unscheduled downtime events with rapid technical guidance and repair coordination.

The Skills You Will Bring:

Required

  • A team player with 10+ years of experience in boiler, evaporator, or power‑plant maintenance, inspection, or outage management.
  • Strong knowledge of boiler pressure‑part systems, evaporator operation, ESP systems, and NDE methods.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex outages with contractors and OEM field representatives.
  • Proficiency with scheduling tools (MS Project).
  • Strong communication and leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with recovery boiler operations or pulp/paper mill power systems.
  • RCM, RCA, or reliability engineering background.
  • Knowledge of NBIC, ASME codes, and pressure‑vessel inspection standards.
  • Experience with PI‑based condition monitoring or degradation detection systems.

title: Partner Field Trainer
description:
Partner Field Trainer

Location: Remote, US (50–75% travel required)

Why This Role

If you love teaching and you know how to earn the respect of a room full of installers, this role puts you in front of some of the best HVAC contractors in North America. You’ll be the person who makes sure every Quilt Certified Partner can sell, install and service our system with confidence, and you’ll see your work pay off every time a crew nails an install on the first visit. You’ll also have a direct line back to our product and training teams, so what you see in the field actually shapes what we build next.

Why Quilt

Heating and cooling is going through its biggest shift in decades. Over 80 million US homes will move from burning fuel to electric heat pumps, pushed along by rebates, regulation and homeowners who want lower bills and a better product. That’s one of the largest replacement cycles in any market, and the incumbents are showing up with the same beige boxes and clunky remotes they’ve sold for 100 years.

We built something better. Quilt makes beautifully designed, AI-optimized heat pump systems with software that makes it easier for dealers to sell, install and service. We sell only through HVAC contractors, with ~160 Quilt Certified Partners across the US and Canada today, and everything we build starts with helping those partners grow their top line and run a more efficient business.

We’re also building the first true consumer brand in HVAC, and we’re doing it alongside the brands our partners have spent years, and often generations, earning in their communities. Homeowners trust the name on their local contractor’s truck, and we believe that name matters more than ours. So rather than competing with our partners for the customer, everything we build is meant to make them look better at the kitchen table.

Our Mission

Quilt’s mission is to move humanity off fossil fuels. Homes produce about 20% of US warming emissions (more than cars), and most of that comes from burning fuel for heat. If that matters to you, you’ll fit right in here. If you’re here because you love seeing the impact of your work every day and selling a product that actually matters, you’ll fit right in too.

The Role

As a Partner Field Trainer, you’ll teach Quilt’s HVAC partners how to sell, install, commission, and service our system. You’ll spend most of your time in the field running hands-on sessions at partner locations and training events, plus virtual sessions in between. Working with Quilt’s training team, you’ll deliver our established curriculum, help partners get certified, and bring back what you learn in the field to make the training better.

This role is a great fit for someone who loves teaching, knows how to connect with tradespeople, and can explain technical concepts clearly to installers and salespeople at every experience level.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver Training: Lead sales and technical training sessions covering Quilt product knowledge, system design, installation best practices, commissioning, troubleshooting, and the Quilt selling experience, for both new partner onboarding and ongoing education.
  • Train in the Field: Travel to partner locations, regional training events, and trade shows to deliver hands-on training and conduct ride-alongs with installation crews (average travel: 50–75%).
  • Run Virtual Sessions: Host webinars and remote training sessions for partners between in-person visits.
  • Support Certification: Guide partners through Quilt’s certification process and track their progress and completions in our Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Support Partners After Training: Answer partner questions, help troubleshoot installation and product issues, and point partners to the right resources.
  • Help Update Materials: Work with the training team to keep guides, videos, and course content accurate as products and software are updated, and suggest improvements based on what you see in the field.
  • Share Field Feedback: Report common partner questions, installation challenges, and training gaps to the training team so programs and products keep improving.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical training, field training, or enablement, ideally in HVAC, home services, clean energy, or building trades.
  • Strong technical aptitude. You can learn product and installation details quickly and explain them clearly.
  • Excellent facilitation skills, whether leading a hands-on workshop, a virtual webinar, or a sales training session. You know how to connect with tradespeople.
  • Comfortable using an LMS (e.g., Docebo, Lessonly, Litmos, Absorb, or similar) to track training and certifications.
  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage your own travel schedule and work independently in the field.
  • Curiosity about where home energy is headed. You don’t need to be a climate expert, but you should be excited to teach the product leading the shift to heat pumps.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel extensively (averaging 50–75%) to partner locations, training events, and trade shows.

Don’t meet 100% of the requirements? That’s okay, apply anyway! If you’re excited about this role and think you could bring something unique to the team, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match perfectly.

Nice to Have

  • HVAC industry knowledge or technical background (heat pumps, ducted and ductless systems, refrigeration fundamentals).
  • Hands-on installation or service experience.
  • Experience creating or editing training videos and written guides.
  • Background in residential construction, home performance, or building science.
  • NATE certification or other HVAC industry credentials.

What’s In It for You

  • Compensation: $100,000 base plus up to 20% bonus tied to hitting team installation targets.
  • Ownership in what you build: Meaningful stock options, so you share in the upside as the partner network grows.
  • Skills that keep getting more valuable: You’ll become one of the deepest experts on next-generation heat pump systems and the software behind them, right as the whole industry moves toward heat pumps.
  • Your feedback shapes the product: What you hear from installers goes straight to our product and training teams, and you’ll see it show up in what we build.
  • Room to grow: Grow with Quilt’s partner training team as the network expands across North America.
  • Benefits: Top-tier health, dental, and vision insurance.

About Quilt

We are a growing team of ambitious people who truly care about the impact of their work. We are on a mission to accelerate a species-level human transition. For over a million years, we’ve been burning things to stay warm. It’s time to move to a better way of living.

We welcome teammates of all races, ethnicities, genders, identities, abilities, and backgrounds, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to shape the future of climate tech.

title: Sognepræst i Frederiksværk-Vinderød Pastorat,  Frederiksværk Provsti, Helsingør Stift
description:
En stilling som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Frederiksværk-Vinderød Pastorat, Frederiksværk Provsti, er ledig til besættelse den 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

På stiftets hjemmeside under ledige stillinger kan du læse embedsbeskrivelsen fra menighedsrådet. Her kan du læse om pastoratet og om, hvilke tanker menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Frederiksværk-Vinderød Pastorat og hvordan kirkelivet m.v. er i sognet, anbefales det, at du orienterer dig på sognets hjemmeside: Velkommen | Frederiksværk Vinderød

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse om menighedsråds medvirken ved ansættelse i præste- og provstestillinger m.m. (BEK nr. 1815 af 29/12/2025)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i Folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Kirkevej 7, Frederiksværk.

Tjenesteboligen vil blive vurderet inden indflytning, og boligbidraget vil blive fastsat ud fra denne vurdering.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte Helsingør Stiftsadministration for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskoppen.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Sundheds- og Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til Biskoppen over Helsingør Stift pr. mail til: kmhel@km.dk, og ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

title: Experienced P&C Field Services Technician
description:
WSP is currently initiating a search for a POWER Testing and Energization (PTE) Experienced P&C Field Services Technician based in Wisconsin or Minnesota. Successful applicants will be involved in projects with our PTE Team and be part of a growing organization that solves problems and supports client needs in electrical testing and commissioning for utility substations, industrial, and bulk electrical power systems.

This Opportunity

  • Supports a wide range of testing and commissioning activities through application of client testing standards, industry standards (IEEE, NETA, NFPA, NESC), and manufacturer recommendations
  • Works under limited supervision, independently executing moderately complex assignments, and contributing to regulatory compliance, safety adherence, and data integrity across active job sites
  • Provides day-to-day support to field teams, helps resolve challenges on-site, and mentors junior technicians to promote quality, efficiency, and safe work practices
  • As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery, power generation, and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition—and we need your help.

Your Impact

  • Perform assigned testing and commissioning tasks for Protection and Control systems on high voltage substations
  • Perform on-site hands-on protective relay testing using relay test sets such as Omicron CMC 256/356 or Doble F6150. Examples of relays to be tested are SEL-311L, SEL-387, SEL-487, SEL-421, SEL-351S, GE L90, GE D60 among others
  • Use field forms, digital data tools, and mobile applications to document site activities
  • Perform equipment cleaning, inventory control, and calibration as directed
  • Support the Project Lead or Field Supervisor on projects
  • Escalate complex technical problems or unexpected field conditions to the site lead or project manager
  • Participate in daily safety briefings and ensure compliance with health and safety protocols
    Communicate progress, field observations, and potential delays to the project team
  • May review the work of less experienced technicians for quality and accuracy, providing informal guidance as needed
  • Maintain attention to detail when filling out logs, photo documentation, and label entries
    Collaborate with other technicians to maintain workflow, safety, and quality standards
  • Assist in monitoring subcontractor performance and activities and report observations to field leadership
  • Perform clerical responsibilities such as timecards, expense reports, and project reports
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in the electrical testing industry, including experience in medium and high voltage circuit breakers, power transformers, instrument transformers, and substation protection and controls testing
  • Demonstrable expertise on transmission, generation, and distribution relays (SEL, Basler, Beckwith, and GE families) and protective schemes
  • Technical skills related to protective relays include relay calibration utilizing test sets/measuring devices such as Omicron CMC 256/356 and Doble F6150, control scheme testing, testing of the sensing CT/PT circuits, ability to upload settings to microprocessor relays, and static & dynamic testing of microprocessor-based protective relays
  • Proven experience with electrical field testing standards, practices, and procedures, such as NETA, IEEE, and NFPA applicable standards
  • Demonstrable knowledge of testing electrical distribution, generation, and transmission projects with voltage levels ranging from 15 kV to 500 kV, including protective relays and circuit breakers
  • Experience using technical software such as ProTesT, Protection Suite, ENOSERV RTS, Omicron Test Universe, and AcSELerator Quickset for testing purposes and data review
  • Experience with reading and understanding electrical drawings
  • Ability to identify routine field challenges and equipment issues, responding within established procedures and escalating atypical conditions
  • Skilled in preparing field logs, sketches, and digital reports
  • Physical stamina to work in outdoor and physically demanding conditions
  • Experience collaborating with contractors, technicians, and engineers
  • Demonstrated commitment to field safety, quality, and regulatory compliance
  • Good interpersonal and verbal communication skills for field team collaboration
  • Capable of critical thinking and problem-solving skills to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from inspection and testing results
  • Capability to support a wide variety of tasks in dynamic or changing environments
  • Ability to follow procedures, meet deadlines, and maintain accountability in the field
  • Commitment to continued learning and development in technical field services
  • Understanding of confidentiality and ethical behavior in technical environments
  • Competent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment
  • Reliable, punctual, with the ability to work independently or with a team
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies
  • Willingness and physical ability to lift up to 35 pounds individually, and up to 100 pounds with assistance
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, basic color differentiation, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must be willing to travel (up to 80%)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Technology degree in a similar discipline
  • Experience in testing and troubleshooting electromechanical relays
  • Experience in testing and commissioning electrical equipment on high voltage substations such as CTs, CCVTs, PLC systems, and DC systems, including batteries and battery chargers
  • Current OSHA 30-hour or 40-hour HAZWOPER certification
