title: Technical Solutions Consultant, Crypto
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Technical Solutions Consultants are responsible for the technical relationship of Stripe Crypto's largest and most complex users. We lead cross-functional efforts across Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams—balancing our users' business needs with technical constraints—and act as trusted partners and consultants who help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize their technical operations, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you'll do

As a Technical Solutions Consultant for Crypto, you will own the technical relationship for Stripe's most strategic crypto-native users: high-growth companies building on Stripe's crypto and stablecoin products, including Bridge and Privy. You will be the technical expert your accounts trust and rely on—developing deep relationships with their key stakeholders, mobilizing cross-functional teams across Stripe to resolve their most complex technical challenges, and proactively identifying opportunities that help them succeed and scale.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for a set of strategic crypto accounts; build durable relationships with their Engineering, Payments Operations, and Product stakeholders.
  • Lead complex technical troubleshooting and incident response for assigned accounts; own communications and remediation until resolution, collaborating with Product, Support, and Engineering when needed.
  • Partner closely with GTM and other user-facing teams to deliver a coordinated experience across your accounts, pairing technical ownership with commercial strategy.
  • Translate customer and developer needs into actionable product feedback: aggregate patterns across accounts, size the business impact, surface it to Product and Engineering, and follow through to completion.
  • Develop and maintain account-specific operational runbooks, escalation paths, and success metrics (uptime, latency, transaction throughput, settlement timelines).
  • Proactively review your accounts' implementations to identify improvements and surface potential issues—across areas like performance, reliability, and compliance workflows—before they impact the user's experience, and flag growth opportunities to partner teams.
  • Deliver regular business and technical reviews with customers (quarterly reviews, post-mortems, roadmap previews) and drive action items to closure.
  • Create and maintain user-facing technical documentation, sample code, and troubleshooting guides that reduce friction and enable self-service.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and process improvements that reduce operational friction, improve SLAs, and scale TSC coverage and effectiveness.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in enterprise-level, client-facing technical roles such as Technical Account Management, Technical Solutions Consulting, or Solutions Engineering.
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs and webhooks, and the ability to explain API concepts, integration patterns, and troubleshooting steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Working familiarity with stablecoins and blockchain fundamentals, including chains, wallets, on-chain transaction lifecycle, and on/off-ramps, with genuine enthusiasm for going deeper.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and demonstrated experience partnering with engineering teams to resolve production incidents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder management. You can hold both business-level and deeply technical conversations, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience owning complex projects across multiple teams, including timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment and prioritizing between reactive and proactive account work.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing crypto, stablecoin, or blockchain systems, including blockchain APIs and integrating digital assets with traditional financial systems.
  • Background in payments, fintech, or cross-border money movement, including how traditional rails and stablecoin rails interoperate.
  • Comfort with observability tooling for diagnosing production issues, such as Datadog or a comparable platform for log search, dashboards, monitors, and distributed traces.
  • Experience with tools like Postman and cURL, light scripting in Python or Node.js, basic SQL, and AI coding agents for debugging and root-cause investigation.
  • An operations-savvy mindset, with a track record of removing process friction and replacing one-off workarounds with scalable processes.
  • Strong product sense and comfort translating customer business objectives into technical implementations and product feedback.

Perform preventive maintenance on tools and equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Assure each day’s activities and problems that occur are communicated to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display proficiency in any one of the following categories, above average skills in two more of the following categories and basic skills in the remaining categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building management. Display solid knowledge and skill in the safe use of hand and power tools and other materials required to perform repair and maintenance tasks. Display basic ability to repair or replace PVC copper pipe (including soldering). Troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment (e.g., pump and motor replacement), plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical equipment including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TV's and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related duties. Assist with surface preparation and painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Display working knowledge of all engineering computer programs related to preventative maintenance, energy management, and other systems, including devices that interact with such programs. Perform mid-level troubleshooting of hotel Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems. Display the ability to train and mentor other engineers (e.g., Engineer I). Display ability to perform Engineer on Duty responsibilities, including readings and rounds.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent and vocational or technical background.

Related Work Experience: Experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation, and painting.

At least 2 years of hotel engineering/maintenance experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: Valid Driver’s License

Universal Chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) Certification

Must meet applicable state and federal certification and/or licensing requirements.

title: Rengøringsassistent / Servicemedarbejder til erhvervskunder. Fuldtid 30 timer +.

title: Bank Internal Audit Head - Remote - up to 200k
description:
We are looking for an Internal Audit Head for our Fintech client

Salary: up to 200k

Schedule: Monday to Friday, dayshift

Set-up: Remote
Industry: Fintech

The Head of Internal Audit is responsible for the overall audit project management activities of the bank and ensures the operations of the bank complies to the major regulations by implementing thorough assessments.

Responsibilities:

Prioritize internal audit processes based on risk assessments
Plan, develop, and scope the audit test plan
Performs independent and reliable assessments of the effectiveness of the banks risk management activities and its internal control-environment.
Review internal processes
Evaluate and examine the effectiveness and adequacy of the internal control systems
Reviews processes of external partners
Monitor exceptions and reports and provide feedback to partner facing teams.
Systems/ IT audit
Board reporting
Responsible for resolving material issues and giving relevant recommendations to the Senior
Management,
Reporting Audit Results
Ensure adequate AML coverage
Review of AML CTR and STR

As per regulation, this position will report directly to the independent Risk and Audit Committee of the Bank. The position will be independent of the Management but will work closely with the management of the bank in the
implementation of the responsibilities.

Required skills and qualifications:
This position requires expertise in control functions, while also understanding the implications of these functions on business operations to ensure the functions are implemented in a client friendly manner.
The specific areas of expertise seen in the candidate will include:
Leadership of internal audit functions
Definition of an Audit plan
Definition of audit timetable
Oversight of audit functions
Management of internal and external reviews
Experience in policy development. Clear and concise writing.
Technical expertise in audit activities, including the following:
Expertise in Auditing and Accounting Principles: Comprehensive knowledge of auditing standards, accounting principles, and financial reporting is crucial.
Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with banking laws, regulations, and compliance
requirements. This involves understanding both local regulations and international standards such as the Basel Accords.
Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and manage risks across all areas of the bank, including credit, market, operational, and liquidity risks.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills to evaluate data, assess control environments, and make recommendations based on findings.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively report findings to the bank's management and board, and to liaise with regulatory bodies. Ability to work closely with partners to complete audit assessments.
Leadership and Management Skills: Ability to lead and manage the internal audit team, including planning and assigning work, mentoring staff, and evaluating performance.

Must have:

At least 10 years of Internal Auditing experience, preferably from the Banking/Fintech industry
At least 5 years of Senior Management experience in Internal Auditing

title: Technical Solutions Specialist, Chemical Management
description:
HSI is seeking a Technical Solutions Specialist I to join our Chemical Management team. This role combines advanced technical support, data management, system administration, and limited back-end responsibilities to help customers successfully manage and maintain their environments.

As a key technical resource, you will work closely with customers, Product, Development, and internal teams to troubleshoot complex issues, support data-related requests, perform system updates, and help ensure a positive customer experience. You'll spend significant time working with customer data using Excel, SQL, and internal platform tools to investigate issues, complete updates, and support reporting needs.

This position is ideal for a recent Computer Science graduate, junior developer, or early-career technical professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working with data, and collaborating across teams. While some programming knowledge is required, this is not a full-time software development role.

What You'll Do

  • Advanced Technical Support
    • Provide advanced technical support for HSI's Chemical Management platform.
    • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application, configuration, and system issues.
    • Serve as a technical resource during customer escalations and support engagements.
    • Document issues, findings, and resolutions while partnering with Product and Development teams on defect investigation and resolution.
    • Determine which customer requests can be completed directly and which require escalation to Development.
  • Data Management & System Administration
    • Perform customer data-management activities including bulk imports, site assignments, catalog updates, and safety data sheet inventory maintenance.
    • Work extensively in Microsoft Excel to analyze, validate, manipulate, and prepare customer data for imports, exports, reporting, and system updates.
    • Review and troubleshoot data discrepancies, formatting issues, mapping errors, and data quality concerns.
    • Support data audits and validation efforts to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
    • Assist with user administration, system configuration, and customer environment maintenance.
  • SQL & Back-End Support
    • Execute approved SQL queries and scripts to support customer requests, reporting needs, and operational activities.
    • Work within approved back-end access and security protocols to complete lower-risk system and data-management tasks.
    • Analyze system behavior and investigate technical issues using SQL and other diagnostic tools.
    • Support reporting requests through data retrieval and analysis.
    • Maintain documentation related to data structures, processes, and support procedures.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner closely with Product and Development teams to resolve system issues and support platform enhancements.
    • Contribute feedback and observations to improve platform supportability and the customer experience.
    • Assist with testing and validation of platform updates and enhancements.
    • Participate in technical projects related to data imports, reporting, system administration, and platform optimization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Development, Programming, or a closely related technical field. An Information Technology or related degree may be considered when combined with meaningful programming coursework, SQL training, or relevant technical certifications.
  • 3+ years of experience providing technical support to SaaS applications or enterprise software solutions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including working with large datasets, formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, filtering, sorting, data validation, and data analysis.
  • Experience performing data imports, exports, data validation, data cleanup, data mapping, or other customer data-management activities.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience consulting with customers, end users, or internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and support system configuration needs.
  • Understanding of programming fundamentals and experience with languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or C++.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work responsibly with databases, scripts, access controls, and established security procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Chemical Management, EHS, or LMS platforms.
  • Experience with APIs, REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, and system integrations.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customer implementations.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, or information architecture initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Product and Development teams.

Benefits

  • Fully Remote Work: Work where you're most productive—we trust you.
  • Unlimited PTO: Recharge when you need to—we support work-life balance.
  • Career Growth: Unlimited access to our Learning & Development library, including our own HSI LMS content.
  • Well-Being First: Full medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage.
  • Secure Your Future: Generous $1:$1 401(k) company match—your future is important to us.
  • This position has an annual salary range of $65K-$75K. Placement within the range will depend on experience, qualifications, and other business considerations.

Application Process: To ensure a fair and consistent hiring process, all candidates must apply through our online application system. Due to the volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond to individual inquiries regarding application status or consideration for the role. Candidates whose qualifications closely match our requirements will be contacted directly by our recruiting team.

title: Sognepræst (kbf) i Ørre-Sinding og Tjørring Pastorat, Herning Nordre Provsti, Viborg Stift
description:
Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Ørre-Sinding og Tjørring Pastorat, Herning Nordre Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Til stillingen er knyttet en forpligtelse som kirkebogsfører og begravelsesmyndighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

I embedsbeskrivelsen fra menighedsrådet kan du læse om sognet / pastoratet og hvilke tanker, menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede. Embedsbeskrivelsen kan læses på Viborg Stifts hjemmeside , på stiftets sociale medier samt på Præsteforeningens hjemmeside.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Ørre-Sinding og Tjørring Pastorat og hvordan kirkelivet m.v. er i sognene, kan du også orientere dig på sognenes hjemmesider: og .

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse af lov om ansættelse i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 864 af 25/6/2013)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Ørre Byvej 88, Ørre, 7400 Herning.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 3.865. Tjenesteboligen vil blive vurderet inden indflytning, og boligbidraget vil blive fastsat ud fra denne vurdering.

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Henrik Stubkjær, ligeledes inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Viborg Stift pr. mail til: kmvib@km.dk. Ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

description:
At UnitedHealthcare, we're simplifying the health care experience, creating healthier communities and removing barriers to quality care. Ready to make a difference? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Analytic Consultant provides year-round strategic consultative services with an integrated focus on the UnitedHealthcare Value Story by diving deep into the analytics of health plan performance to further support UnitedHealth Group's position as a trusted advisor and carrier of choice.

If you are located in East Region, you will have the flexibility to work remotely* as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Consultants will serve as primary contact and project manager for assigned clients
  • Consultants will create compelling, client-specific insights and content for a variety of client engagements with the assistance of Regional Strategist as necessary
  • Consultant will focus on insights and storytelling. Distillation of compelling and/or actionable insights from data and reporting is required
  • Will present a portion of client engagements based on client needs (internal/external)
  • Mastery and seamless navigation of data, tools, and related resources will be necessary for success in telling a story with actionable insights (connecting the dots)
  • In-depth knowledge of adopted and proposed client solutions
  • Participate and complete colleague feedback reviews on an ongoing basis for the pod
  • Success will be determined by the relevance and depth of insights
  • Share best practices amongst the team
  • Collaborate and cross train team members as needed
  • Collaborate with the broader Account Management Team (AMTs) and other internal business partners to solve complex customer analytic needs and serve as a strategic analytic subject matter expert
  • Communicates information openly and in an articulate and professional manner as a strategic consultative subject matter expert
  • This role must go beyond running reports and focus on the distillation of compelling and/or action insights

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years in a customer-facing role, preferably within a sales, account management, TPA, or consulting environment
  • Knowledgeable of healthcare cost and quality topics, as well as able to speak to emerging industry trends
  • Intermediate or higher skills within Office 365 applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
  • Demonstrated clear and concise written & verbal communication skills; successful virtual presentation experience a plus
  • Demonstrated presentation skills, preferably with a leadership level and higher audience
  • Driver's License and access to a reliable transportation

  • Experience in data analytics, data science, or statistics

  • Travel may be required 20% of the time depending on client needs

No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. title: Trauma Surgeon

Skilled Wound Care, a premier national physician group, is hiring Trauma Surgeons in Rockville, MD to work as wound care physicians and lead wound care initiatives in skilled nursing facilities across the area.

Maybe you’re a Trauma Surgeon ready to step away from in-house call and middle-of-the-night activations for good. Maybe you want a part-time role during your off weeks. Either way, this no-call Trauma Surgeon job offers a high-impact career without the corporate red tape.

In a specialty where your pager can go off at any hour for a level-one activation, we offer a refreshing alternative:

  • The “No-Call” Lifestyle: No nights, no weekends, no 24-hour shifts and no pagers. No overnight trauma activations. This is a true Monday–Friday surgeon job, so your evenings and weekends belong to you and your family.

Trauma Surgeon Responsibilities

Use the latest advancements in wound healing to change lives in communities across Rockville, MD:

  • Surgical and sharp debridement and other bedside procedures
  • Evaluation and treatment of chronic, non-healing and complex wounds, including pressure injuries and post-surgical wounds

Trauma Surgeon Requirements

  • DEA License: Or eligibility to obtain one
  • Open Background: We welcome Trauma and Acute Care Surgeons and surgeons of all backgrounds, as well as Family Medicine and Internal Medicine physicians. No previous wound care experience is required; we provide comprehensive wound care training

Great Place to Work® Certified!

Skilled Wound Care is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place to Work® for the 5th year in a row. The prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Skilled Wound Care. description:
Position Title:

Board Solutions Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Winder & Roll Handling

Pay Rate:

PL17

$125,900 - $167,800

(PL varies by experience)

Multiple factors, including Individual experience, skills and abilities will determine where an employee is ultimately placed in the pay range.

Category/Shift:

Salaried Full-Time

Location:

Remote – Ability to travel up to ~80%

The Job You Will Perform:

The Board Solutions Group works closely with Packaging Solutions of North America (PSNA) to support tactical and strategic initiatives to improve results and drive business strategy to achieve or exceed their targeted performance levels. This involves the use of expertise and leadership gained through years of experience to deliver improvement within the manufacturing system. Board Solutions SME’s work together within all of the PSNA facilities to improve paper machine performance, reduce variability, improve quality and lower manufacturing costs.

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) position is accountable for delivering results on a wide range of assignments, short and long-term, across our mill system. The SME must work well with varied teams and be able to quickly engage employees from all levels of the organization from executive to the shop floor, and influence vendors and contractors.

The Subject Matter Expert position functions as an internal consultant, and is expected to lead the development of projects and produce improvement in the area of expertise anywhere in the company. The duties range widely between safety leadership, troubleshooting, optimization, teaching, deliberate improvement projects, capital projects, process audits, strategic studies, and mentoring.

SME key attributes include:

  • Operates with minimal supervision, independently prioritizing work aligned to business and enterprise needs

  • Leads complex, multi-mill technical initiatives delivering measurable improvements in safety, reliability, quality, cost, and capability

  • Influences outcomes across organizational boundaries, including mill leadership, vendors, and contractors

  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution

Key responsibilities include:

  • Safety leadership in mill, pilot, laboratory, and office environments

  • Diagnosing and resolving high-impact winder and roll handling process issues

  • Recognized resource for technical troubleshooting, non-capital, and capital solutions for winder and roll handling equipment.

  • Developing and implementing capital and process improvement projects

  • Conducting process audits and strategic technical studies

  • Building durable on-site technical capability through the ability to interface, technically develop, and mentor others at mill sites to assist in project development within the area of expertise

  • Communicating technical findings to all organizational levels

  • Ability to drive results and self-manage priorities on multiple simultaneous projects
  • Sharing and proliferation of knowledge and Best Practices through teams and e-forums.

The Qualifications, Skills and Knowledge You Will Bring:

  • Minimum 15 years of paper industry experience in paper manufacturing, engineering, converting, or machine supplier positions

    • Ability to travel up to ~80%

    • Understanding of detailed winder, and roll handling processes, product attributes and equipment
    • Key mechanical and electrical winder troubleshooting skills with knowledge of how different paper grades impact the runnability of a winder

    • Ability to independently scope and deliver complex technical work

    • Demonstrated leadership focused on accountability and results

    • Enterprise-level influence and credibility with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate to groups and individuals at all levels

    • Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and the ability to use organized data based approaches to resolve issues

    • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering is preferred, significant work experience in mechanical, electrical, PLCs and winder and roll handling systems will be considered

The Benefits You Will Enjoy:

International Paper offers a benefits package that includes health, welfare and retirement plans including Medical, Dental, Life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short-term and Long-term Disability, 401(k), Company-funded retirement contributions, Paid Time Off, Education & Development (including Tuition Reimbursement), Student Loan Repayment Assistance, and Voluntary Benefits including insurance for home, auto, vision and pets.

The Career You Will Build:

As a Technology SME, you will operate as a senior technical contributor within International Paper’s Technology Career Ladder, delivering enterprise-level impact through independent execution and influence.

The Impact You Will Make:

We continue to build a better future for people, the planet, and our company! IP has been a good steward of sustainable practices across communities around the world for more than 125 years. Join our team and you’ll see why our team members say they’re Proud to be IP.

International Paper promotes employee well-being by providing safe, caring and inclusive workplaces. We have team members all around the world with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. These are our strengths. We are committed to creating a culture where all individuals are respected, valued, engaged and have an opportunity to do their best work every day. We invite you to bring your uniqueness, creativity, talents, experiences, and safety mindset to be a part of our increasingly inclusive and diverse culture.

The Company You Will Join:

International Paper (NYSE: IP) is the global leader in sustainable packaging solutions. With company headquarters in Memphis, Tennessee, USA, and EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) headquarters in London, UK, we employ more than 65,000 team members and serve customers around the world with operations in more than 30 countries. Together with our customers, we make the world safer and more productive, one sustainable packaging solution at a time. Net sales for 2024 were $18.6 billion. In 2025, International Paper acquired DS Smith creating an industry leader focused on the attractive and growing North American and EMEA regions. title: Afdelingsleder til Dagpenge, Fleksjob og Kontanthjælp
description:
Afdelingsleder til Center for Beskæftigelse i Faxe Kommune Vi søger en leder til en afdeling med stor faglig spændvidde og arbejdsmarkedet som fælles omdrejningspunkt. Afdelingen spænder over dagpenge, kontanthjælp for borgere over 30 år samt fleksjob og ledighedsydelse.

Det er områder med forskellige målgrupper, lovgivning og faglige problemstillinger, men med en fælles opgave i at understøtte borgerens tilknytning til arbejdsmarkedet. Nogle borgere har brug for en kort og præcis indsats, mens andre har en længere vej, og det stiller krav til både faglig dømmekraft, tydelig prioritering og blik for den enkelte.

Stillingen er samtidig en del af fællesledelsen i Center for Beskæftigelse. Det er vigtigt for os at vi åbner vores ledelsesrum for hinanden, fordi lederne ganske vist har hver deres afdelinger, men centrets opgaver hænger tæt sammen, og det mener vi forpligter os til at byde ind i fællesskabet.

Opgaven Beskæftigelsesområdet ændrer sig markant i disse år. Der bliver færre proceskrav, mere kommunalt råderum og større behov for, at vi selv kan stå på mål for de valg, vi træffer.

Det giver mere plads til faglighed, men stiller også tydeligere krav til ledelsen. Vi arbejder derfor med at udvikle en praksis, hvor medarbejderne har et reelt fagligt handlerum, samtidig med at retning, rammer og forventninger er klare.

Som leder skal du være tæt på den faglige praksis uden at overtage den. Du skal interessere dig for de vurderinger, medarbejderne træffer, den måde de arbejder på, og det deres indsats fører til. Data og resultater er en del af det billede, men står ikke alene. Vi bruger dem til at blive klogere på praksis og til at få øje på de steder, hvor vi bør justere kursen.

Der vil også være helt almindelig drift. Frister skal overholdes, myndighedsopgaven skal være i orden, økonomien skal hænge sammen, og medarbejderne skal vide, hvad der forventes af dem. Når noget ikke fungerer, skal der handles på det. Den del af jobbet fylder naturligt, og den er vigtig.

Ledelse i centret Vi forventer, at du tager ansvar for din egen afdeling og samtidig bidrager aktivt og konstruktivt til helheden.

En beslutning ét sted i centret kan hurtigt få betydning et andet sted, og derfor har vi brug for ledere, der opdager de sammenhænge og bringer dem ind i ledergruppen. Det kan være en faglig udfordring, et kapacitetsproblem, en uhensigtsmæssig arbejdsgang eller en idé, der måske kan bruges bredere.

Det falder dig naturligt at bringe udfordringer og spørgsmål ind i ledergruppen, også når du endnu ikke har en løsning. Du engagerer dig både i dine egne og dine kollegers ledelsesopgaver, gør dig umage i den fælles ledelse og bruger tid og opmærksomhed på spørgsmål, som ikke nødvendigvis ligger direkte i din egen afdeling.

Synet på beskæftigelsesindsatsen Der er et fagligt ståsted i stillingen.

Vi betragter tilknytning til arbejdsmarkedet som betydningsfuld for den enkelte og som et centralt mål for beskæftigelsesindsatsen, men det betyder ikke, at alle mennesker skal mødes ens.

Den konkrete faglige vurdering fylder meget hos os. Borgerens situation, mulighederne på arbejdsmarkedet og det, vi ved om virksomme indsatser, skal kunne mødes i en beslutning, der giver mening i den konkrete sag.

Arbejdsmarkedet skal være nærværende i den faglige praksis, også når vejen til job er længere. Det kræver, at vi fastholder blikket for mulighederne for tilknytning til arbejdsfællesskabet og samtidig har respekt for, at borgernes udgangspunkter og veje dertil er forskellige.

Som leder skal du kunne se dig selv i det udgangspunkt og have lyst til at stå på mål for det i den daglige ledelse.

Personaleledelse Du bliver personaleleder, og vi lægger vægt på, at du faktisk har lyst til den del af arbejdet. Du bliver personaleleder for cirka [XX] medarbejdere og får mulighed for at rekruttere en fagkoordinator i starten af din ansættelse.

Du skal kende din organisation godt nok til at vide, hvad der foregår i den, følge medarbejdernes udvikling, tage fat i problemer og skabe tydelighed, når noget bliver uklart.

Nogle gange handler ledelse om at give plads, andre gange om at sætte en klar grænse eller træffe en beslutning, som ikke alle er enige i. Der er ikke én rigtig position, og derfor har vi brug for en leder, der kan vurdere situationen og handle på den.

Det gælder også arbejdsmiljø og trivsel. Vi ser ikke de spørgsmål som noget, der ligger ved siden af driften, men som en del af den måde, man leder en organisation på.

Dit eget lederskab Vi ønsker en leder, der kan stå selvstændigt i rollen og omsætte fælles retning og beslutninger til praksis i egen afdeling.

Der vil være en fælles ramme og nogle fælles beslutninger, men der vil også være et betydeligt ledelsesrum til at finde den bedste vej lokalt. Det indebærer, at du selv tager ansvar for, hvordan retningen konkret bliver omsat sammen med dine medarbejdere og i samspil med resten af organisationen.

Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig på din egen ledelse, kan reflektere over dine valg og er åben for modspil. Vi ser gerne, at du kan justere kursen, når nye perspektiver eller gode argumenter peger på det.

Vi har ikke brug for en leder, der altid har alle svarene på forhånd, men for en leder, der kan balancere åbenhed og handlekraft og vurdere, hvornår der er behov for mere undersøgelse, og hvornår det er tid til at træffe en beslutning.

Du skal også kunne give dine lederkolleger modspil på en saglig og respektfuld måde og være indstillet på at få det samme tilbage.

Udvikling Vi forventer, at de seneste års udvikling på beskæftigelsesområdet fortsætter, og en del af arbejdet bliver derfor løbende at tage stilling til, hvad vi skal holde fast i, hvad vi skal ændre, og hvad vi måske helt skal holde op med.

Det arbejde foregår ikke kun i ledergruppen. Medarbejderne ligger inde med en stor del af den viden, vi har brug for, og deres erfaringer fra mødet med borgere og systemer skal bruges aktivt, når vi ændrer praksis.

Det samme gælder teknologi.

Vi bruger allerede AI og andre digitale løsninger i vores arbejde, og vi kommer til at bruge mere. Vi er mest interesserede i teknologi, når den løser et konkret problem, frigør tid, gør en arbejdsgang enklere, understøtter fagligheden eller giver borgeren en bedre oplevelse.

Du behøver ikke komme med en særlig teknisk baggrund. Det afgørende er, at du er interesseret i mulighederne og kan lede de ændringer, som følger med.

Din baggrund Der er flere veje ind i stillingen.

Du kan have erfaring fra beskæftigelsesområdet, og det vil selvfølgelig være relevant. Du kan også have ledelseserfaring fra et andet fagområde, hvis du har en god forståelse for offentlig drift, myndighedsopgaver og arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation.

Vi vil især lægge mærke til, hvordan du tænker om ledelse. Vi forventer, at du har erfaring med personaleledelse og kan håndtere både den daglige drift og de mere langsigtede udviklingsopgaver.

Du skal kunne arbejde med data og resultater uden at tro, at tallene fortæller hele historien, og du skal kunne skabe retning uden at have behov for at bestemme alle detaljer. Samtidig skal du kunne samarbejde med andre ledere på en måde, hvor den fælles opgave nogle gange får forrang for din egen afdeling.

Kendskab til beskæftigelseslovgivning og arbejdsmarkedet vil være en fordel. Hvis du kommer med en anden baggrund, skal du til gengæld være klar til hurtigt at sætte dig grundigt ind i området.

Arbejdspladsen Center for Beskæftigelse varetager Faxe Kommunes beskæftigelsesindsats.

Vi arbejder med borgere i forskellige situationer og med forskellige afstande til arbejdsmarkedet. Vi samarbejder med virksomheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner og andre dele af kommunen, og en stor del af opgaven løses på tværs.

Som leder bliver du en del af centrets ledergruppe og refererer til centerchefen.

Du får et betydeligt ansvar og et tilsvarende råderum, og vi forventer, at du bruger begge dele. Der vil være ting, som allerede fungerer godt, og som du skal passe på, og der vil være forhold, som vi sammen skal have mod på at ændre.

Det er omtrent den virkelighed, du kommer ind i.

Praktisk Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerchef Troels van Dijk på 23644502 (sms forud er en fordel).

Ansøgningsfristen er mandag d. 9/11

Første samtale afholdes d. 18/11, og anden samtale afholdes d. 25/11.

Vi anvender Praice som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Hvis du bliver indkaldt til samtale, får du tilsendt et link til udfyldelse inden samtalen.

Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
ABS Group is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will design, develop, and operationalize machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that support mission applications and data-driven workflows.

You will help bring AI capabilities into production, build supporting pipelines and model operations workflows, and work across data science, engineering, and cloud teams to deliver scalable, secure, and trustworthy AI solutions. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, and operate AI and machine learning capabilities for production applications and data workflows

  • Build and maintain data and model pipelines that support training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management

  • Partner with data scientists, developers, and cloud engineers to productionize AI solutions

  • Implement MLOps and related engineering practices for model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and version control

  • Support generative AI and large language model implementations, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector-based retrieval patterns

  • Apply AI/ML to adjacent use cases such as test automation, workflow support, and operational optimization

  • Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and operational support for AI systems in secure environments

  • Support responsible AI and model governance practices, including explainability and compliance requirements

  • Document architectures, workflows, and engineering standards for project delivery

What You Will Need

Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:

  • Junior (0 to 4 years)

  • Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

  • Senior (10 to 14 years)

  • Principal (15 or more years)

These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred

  • Relevant professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or related software engineering roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled

  • Experience deploying or supporting machine learning and AI systems in production environments preferred

  • Experience working in cloud-based or hybrid technical environments preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficiency in Python

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn

  • Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD for ML, and model monitoring concepts and practices

  • Exposure to LLMOps, AIOps, RAG, and vector databases

  • Experience building or supporting data pipelines for AI/ML applications

  • Understanding of software engineering and DevSecOps practices for production systems

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical teams and stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting production ML at scale

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services

  • Familiarity with federal, public sector, or regulated AI environments

Location

title: Senior Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description:
Senior Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions

Global | Permanent

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will lead end-to-end operating model and product redesign for a portfolio of Private Assets services, from problem definition through to adoption.

  • Lead the redesign of how a service runs end to end — not patching an existing process, but rebuilding it around what the business and clients actually need.

  • Translate operational pain points into a defined scope, business case and delivery plan.

  • Define the target operating model for a product or service, including roles, handoffs, controls and location strategy.

  • Develop and implement best practice standards across regions, driving consistency and efficiency.

  • Act as the Operations voice in client pitches, POCs and solution design, and hold the line on what is genuinely deliverable.

  • Lead operational solution design for our marquee clients, working alongside Client Services, Product and Client Integration.

  • Own the marquee solution reuse assessment — identifying where a client-specific build could be productised for the wider book, and leading that rollout.

  • Lead complex client transitions and implementations from an Operations standpoint, working alongside the integration team on new client setup.

  • Set out requirements with the Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement and Digital Workflow, Automation & AI focus areas where a redesign or client solution depends on data, platform or automation capability.

  • Coordinate across Operations, Tactical Operations, Marquee Client teams, Financial Statements, Tax, Investor Relations and Client Integration.

  • Lead and mentor focus area resources, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Report on progress, risks and benefits realisation to the relevant leader and senior stakeholders.

About You

You have 12–15 years’ experience in private assets, working at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment.

  • Proven delivery of operating model redesign, process re-engineering or transformation initiatives in financial services.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets accounting and operations, including fund structures and complex calculations.

  • The ability to see a whole service end to end rather than a single desk, and to design for scale across jurisdictions.

  • Significant exposure to large or complex client relationships, with credibility in front of clients and the judgement to distinguish between a reasonable request and an unsustainable commitment.

  • The ability to recognise where a bespoke solution has wider application, and to make the case for productising it.

  • Comfortable working with data, reporting and platform teams and translating operational need into technical requirements.

  • Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Cyber Engineer IV
description:
The Cyber Engineer IV applies working knowledge of cyber security fundamentals to ensure data security for underwater vehicles. The candidate guides engineering efforts across the Systems Engineering V to deploy intelligent Risk Management Frameworks (RMF) to achieve Authority to Operate (ATO) accreditation. The ideal candidate will have cyber security experience in the Department of War (DoW) world. The candidate should possess a tenacious personality that displays excellent technical judgement, attention to detail, and ability to understand “the big picture”.

OTECH produces and maintains unique underwater systems – typically for US Navy and other US Government Department of Defense customers. Our projects are all one-of-a-kind. Projects range from quick burn to lifecycle management of fielded systems. The ideal candidate for this position is a self-starter who is an effective communicator with excellent critical thinking skills.

  • Identify, analyze and mitigate cyber vulnerabilities for complete underwater systems in accordance with required government specifications.
  • Implement the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) RMF in compliance with program requirements such as DoD standards.
  • Implement Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) on various operating systems.
  • Advise on STIG’s applied on customer supplied products.
  • Produce letters of volatility and clearing procedures for in house products, as well as analyzing those produced by vendors.
  • Function as Cyber Engineering Subject Matter Expert (SME) between engineering, project management and the customer.
  • Introduce innovative design concepts to achieve optimal cyber system security.
  • Participate in government audits.
  • Some travel may be required.

Experienced engineers are also expected to take a leadership role within the software group. This includes helping craft and enforce policies and procedures for software development, and mentorship of junior team members.

Essential Qualifications

  • BS degree in Electrical, Computer, Mechanical or Systems Engineering. Commensurate experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of practical experience in Systems, Software, Cyber Engineering or related field.
  • Work experience with US Department of Defense (DoD) or similarly regulated field.
  • Forward leaning personality that is a strong and effective communicator.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Department of Defense Security Clearance.
  • Must be a US citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with STIG and NIST policies, guidelines, and procedures.
  • Experience hardening embedded systems (including Linux variants and bare metal) and network devices.
  • Experience utilizing cyber methodologies to both derive and fulfill system level requirements.
  • Experience with the RMF lifecycle and creation of ATO artifacts such as clearing procedures and letters of volatility.
  • Experience designing and implementing security architectures.
  • Experience segregating classified and unclassified data via system design.
  • Experience with Anti Tamper (AT) technology.
  • Experience with AUV’s, ROV’s, the ocean engineering field or robotic systems.

Additional

  • Additional duties as assigned.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Employee benefits vary by role, however, may include Health and Wellness, Mental Health, Retirement Savings, Life and Disability, Paid Maternity and Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, Tuition Reimbursement, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Compensation $138,000.00 - $207,500.00

description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role…

You will lead our rail estimating function and play a pivotal role in our client facing commercial team as part of our leading ‘Project Management Commercial Management (PMCM) Rail’ Group. Your role will include Estimating, Cost Planning, Procurement and Cost Assurance of projects ranging in size and complexity working for a variety of internal and external clients.

Your principal role will be to deliver cost estimates and lead the development of our rail estimating team.

The role offers an excellent opportunity to broaden and enhance your skills across the various aspects of cost and commercial management across a variety of diverse and challenging environments. You will join a specialist estimating focussed team ranging in Commercial and Project Management experience from early career professionals to colleagues with over two decades of knowledge. Within WSP there will be excellent personal development opportunities and prospects for promotion within WSP.

We require someone with the drive and personality to further develop our estimating function and you will be supported by a Global business with ambitions to expand and enhance our service offering in this area. As a global leader in professional services, we are fully embracing innovation and you will have the opportunity to shape our estimating function so that it is sustainable and utilises emerging digital technology.

We collaborate closely with client teams and with multi-disciplinary project teams and, to deliver most effectively, we utilise WSP offices, Client offices and/or site locations. To deliver programmes of strategic regional and national importance you will need to collaborate closely with clients, their business associates, their suppliers and our internal design teams. You may propose that we develop our service in conjunction with key client partners.

Your Team

You will join a diverse, growing team of Estimators, Cost Managers and Commercial Managers, and other related professionals who work across multiple sectors.

You will be part of our “Project Management and Commercial Management Team” made up of approximately 400 colleagues across the UK. This team provides Estimating/Cost and Commercial Management, Programme and Project Management and Project Controls services to deliver both Rail and Infrastructure projects for public and private clients.

Based in one of our modern WSP offices, we are a diverse and enthusiastic Team of estimators and cost/commercial managers. We are client-focused, proud of the positive feedback we regularly receive for our roles within major schemes and passionate about being the best in our field. Can you make us even better?

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • Rail Estimating experience and knowledge of measurement methods such as the Rail Method of Measurement (RMM1), Method of Measurement for Highway Works (MMHW) and the Civil Engineering Standard Method of Measurement (CESMM4).
  • Relevant educational background
  • Good technical writing, client facing and communication skills
  • Ability to demonstrate applicable knowledge, ability and experience around some Estimating/Cost and Commercial competencies required by relevant professional institutions.
  • Estimating software experience and knowledge in, for example, CostX and CANDY.

  • You have the drive, vision and technology skills to lead the development of a digital service offering
  • Working knowledge/experience of NEC Contracts, other industry standard contract forms and/or bespoke forms of contract.
  • Able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Have previous experience of working in a Rail Systems/Engineering Estimating and/or Commercial Management role in a consultant, contractor, or client organisation.
  • Demonstrable Estimating Cost and Commercial Management experience in the Rail sector and/or experience on civil engineering and highways projects.

title: Lead Producer - RuneScape - 12 month FTC
description:

Are you a lead producer who can walk into a fast-moving, multi-project environment, earn trust quickly, and keep delivery moving from day one?

This is a 12-month maternity cover contract on RuneScape - one of the longest-running and most actively developed MMORPGs in the world. You’ll be joining a team with a lot in of active projects, so the ability to hold complexity without losing clarity is essential. As Lead Producer, you’ll combine hands-on delivery with line management of a small team of producers, working closely with the Principal Producer and game development teams.

This is a role for someone who brings calm to uncertainty, momentum to ambiguity, and knows how to get the best out of the people around them, all while staying close enough to the work to spot problems before they become blockers.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead delivery across a broad range of concurrent projects – owning planning, risk management, scheduling and roadmap visibility, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned throughout.
  • Line manage a small team of producers, including regular 1-on-1s, coaching, performance feedback, and supporting their development as production craft practitioners.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate strategic risks, building contingency plans and scenario modelling to keep delivery on track across multiple workstreams.
  • Drive operational standards across your area – establishing and refining processes and methodologies, and facilitating alignment across departments and stakeholders.
  • Communicate with confidence at all levels, from stakeholder updates through to team facilitation, planning sessions, and cross-functional problem solving.
  • Create stability and momentum – rallying teams through uncertainty, removing blockers, and fostering a culture of clarity, collaboration and accountability.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience in games production is essential - you understand the game development lifecycle and have led delivery in a senior or lead capacity.
  • Recent, hands-on producer delivery experience alongside line management - this role requires both, and the balance between them is a key part of what we’ll be assessing.
  • Demonstrated experience line managing producers, including coaching, performance feedback and developing production craft.
  • Deep expertise in delivery methodologies - you have a broad toolbox and the judgement to match the right approach to the situation.
  • Strong risk management skills, including scenario planning, dependency management, and the ability to communicate complex delivery realities clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Live service or multiplayer game experience is a strong advantage.

title: One Stop Coordinator

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
description:

title: Servicing Representative
description:
About Unlock

Unlock’s mission is to unleash the power of home equity to enrich people’s lives. We do this through a financial solution called a Home Equity Agreement or HEA, an entirely new way to access and utilize home equity. We’re not a lender, so there are no interest charges or monthly payments and homeowners with poor credit or high levels of debt can still qualify. We're beyond passionate about helping our customers build greater financial resiliency. We are mission driven, consumer centric and our products are designed for the way homeowners want to live their lives today - with flexibility and control.

About the role

The Servicing Representative involves resolving customer inquiries, coordinating with title agents, escrow officers, and loan officers to ensure smooth transactions, and managing complex servicing cases such as refinances, property sales, and buyouts. Additionally, the associate will monitor homeowner financial health, support intervention campaigns, and ensure compliance with servicing guidelines. They will also contribute to workflow enhancements, CRM system improvements, and data analysis to optimize processes and customer satisfaction.

What you'll do

  • End-to-end ownership of standard servicing events such as refinances, owner buyouts, and home sales to ensure an exceptional customer experience and accurate recoupment of settlement funds.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve customer inquiries related to mortgage operations and Home Equity Agreements via phone and email.
  • Oversee and enhance workflows, optimizing processes for efficiency, reducing resolution times, and ensuring accurate payoff demands for refinance, property sales, and buyout events.
  • Coordinate and maintain productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, customers, heirs, trustees, title agents, escrow officers, and loan officers.
  • Monitor homeowner financial health, leveraging credit and lien monitoring to support intervention campaigns and financial stability efforts including monitoring mortgage, property tax, and HOA payment status.
  • Ensure compliance with all policies, regulations, and servicing guidelines, including communication protocols for non-performing assets.
  • Utilize data analytics and performance metrics to monitor trends, track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and drive decision-making.
  • Oversee and optimize servicing tools, including CRM, CX platforms, chat, and telephone systems, while contributing to system enhancements and quality control.
  • Implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and service quality, ensuring continuous improvement in servicing operations.

What we're looking for

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1+ years experience in FinTech operations, preferably in mortgage operations, title, escrow, or appraisal.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with a talent for building rapport and effectively communicating complex financial information.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage high volumes of work.
  • Ability to balance customer needs and investor requirements, providing optimal outcomes.
  • A collaborative spirit, both in supporting teammates and in seeking support when necessary.
  • A proactive approach to responsibilities, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and effectively.
  • Experience with Home Equity Agreements or alternatives to traditional mortgages is a plus.
  • Hybrid role: must be able to work onsite at our Tempe, AZ office Mondays and Wednesdays.

What we offer

  • Discretionary time off for rest and recharge
  • Comprehensive health plans covering medical, dental, and vision, fully funded by us
  • 4% employer match to your 401(k) contributions

Target compensation is $32.00 - $34.00 per hour. Actual compensation varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, Unlock’s Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, and paid time off.

Unlock is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Senior Commissioning (Cx) Agent – Subway Rail Systems
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Full-Time Senior Commissioning (Cx) Agent – Subway and Rail Transit Systems for our New York, NY office.

The Senior Commissioning (Cx) Agent is responsible for planning, managing, and executing commissioning activities for subway, metro, light rail, and heavy rail transit infrastructure projects. The role ensures that all rail systems, facilities, equipment, and integrated technologies are designed, installed, tested, and operated in accordance with project requirements, safety standards, operational needs, and regulatory requirements prior to revenue service.

The Senior Cx Agent serves as the technical lead for system verification, validation, testing, startup, and turnover activities and coordinates among owners, designers, contractors, vendors, operators, and regulatory agencies to deliver reliable and safe transit systems.

Your Impact

Commissioning Leadership

  • Lead the development and implementation of project-specific commissioning plans.
  • Establish commissioning objectives, procedures, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
  • Direct commissioning activities throughout design, construction, testing, startup, and operational readiness phases.
  • Manage multidisciplinary commissioning teams including engineers, technicians, and specialty consultants.
  • Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for all commissioning deliverables.

Rail Systems Commissioning

  • Oversee commissioning of:
  • Traction power systems
  • Third rail and overhead catenary systems
  • Signaling and train control systems (CBTC, ATC, ATP, ATO)
  • Communications systems
  • SCADA and control systems
  • Tunnel ventilation systems
  • Fire alarm and life safety systems
  • Emergency power systems
  • Station electrical systems
  • Vertical transportation systems (elevators and escalators)
  • Automatic fare collection systems
  • Platform screen doors
  • Depot and maintenance facility systems

Testing and Validation

  • Develop and manage Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) programs.
  • Develop and execute Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) procedures.
  • Coordinate integrated systems testing and interface verification.
  • Lead operational scenario testing and emergency response simulations.
  • Witness and document startup and performance testing activities.
  • Verify compliance with design specifications, owner requirements, and applicable codes.

Project Management

  • Monitor commissioning schedules and coordinate activities with construction sequencing.
  • Identify commissioning risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Track and resolve deficiencies, punch list items, and non-conformance issues.
  • Prepare commissioning status reports for project stakeholders.
  • Support change management and claims review related to commissioning scope.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serve as primary commissioning liaison among:
    • Transit agencies
    • Design consultants
    • Contractors
    • Equipment suppliers
    • Operations and maintenance personnel
    • Regulatory authorities
  • Facilitate commissioning meetings and technical workshops.
  • Support operational readiness and staff training programs.

Documentation and Turnover

  • Review design documents for commissioning requirements.
  • Develop commissioning specifications and test procedures.
  • Manage commissioning documentation databases.
  • Verify operation and maintenance manuals.
  • Coordinate system turnover and final acceptance.
  • Prepare final commissioning reports and certification documentation.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Systems, Civil, Transportation, or related discipline).
  • 5-7+ years of commissioning, systems integration, or rail transit experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience on major subway, metro, commuter rail, or transit infrastructure projects.
  • Experience leading integrated systems testing and startup activities.
  • Demonstrated experience with transit authority standards and procedures.
  • Rail transit systems engineering.
  • Systems integration and interface management.
  • Transit safety and operational readiness.
  • Electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
  • Building systems commissioning.
  • Transit signaling and train control systems.
  • Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety (RAMS) principles.
  • Construction and project delivery processes.
  • Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project.
  • Commissioning management platforms.
  • SharePoint and document management systems.
  • Transit systems monitoring and SCADA applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP)
  • Masters Degree
  • Certified Commissioning Authority (CxA)
  • Professional Engineer (PE)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP)
  • PMI-RMP (Risk Management Professional)
  • Rail transit safety or systems assurance certifications

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.
