title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own execution of the BU's manufacturing ramps across Fremont and Ipoh; translate business ramp targets and required wafer starts into the manufacturing-readiness actions needed to deliver output at both sites.

  • Determine the full set of requirements for each ramp—equipment capacity and installation timing, operator and engineering resourcing, process readiness, process and equipment qualification, facility readiness, critical materials and consumables, substrates, tooling, and backend capacity—and drive each element to readiness ahead of required wafer starts and production volumes.

  • Own and maintain the integrated readiness schedule linking Fremont's 3-inch fab ramp (high-power CW lasers, high-speed photodiodes) to Ipoh bar fabrication, coating, qualification, assembly, and backend, ensuring downstream capability is ready as Fremont output increases.

  • Own and maintain the capacity model for the Fremont fab and the site—covering tool capacity, utilization, uptime, cycle time, yield, and staffing assumptions—and keep it current with demand, wafer-start plans, and equipment changes to identify bottlenecks early and support capacity investment and ramp decisions.

  • Identify gaps between required capacity and actual readiness; drive cross-functional actions with Fremont and Ipoh factory teams, engineering, procurement, and suppliers to close them.

  • Manage weekly ramp targets and shipment targets at Ipoh; track output against plan, identify shortfalls, and drive the factory recovery actions needed to meet the BU's delivery commitments.

  • Drive equipment delivery, installation, and qualification against ramp timing; manage supplier lead times, expedites, and pull-ins to protect the ramp schedule.

  • Manage critical consumables and constrained materials against the ramp to prevent material-driven shortfalls at either site.

  • Ensure people and processes are ready ahead of volume—operator staffing and training, process qualification, and work-instruction readiness.

  • Drive systems readiness ahead of volume in partnership with IT, engineering, and product data teams—ensure part numbers, BOMs, and routings are created and released in PLM (e.g., Agile) and ERP; MES process flows, operations, and data collection are configured (e.g., CAMSTAR); and labels, lot traceability, and shipping documentation are set up and validated at Fremont, Ipoh, and partner sites, so material can be started, tracked, and shipped without system-driven delays.

  • Lead full manufacturing-chain readiness for major ramps, including the NVIDIA 400mW CoC program for co-packaged optics, ensuring the chain is ready at the volume and timing required by the business.

  • Run weekly cross-site execution reviews; report ramp status, risks, and recovery plans to operations and BU leadership, and drive corrective actions to closure.

  • Generate program schedules and risk-mitigation plans for key ramps; drive milestone agreements and key decisions across engineering, operations, procurement, and factory teams.

  • Escalate constraints with clear, data-backed mitigation options, acting as the single owner accountable for ramp readiness across the manufacturing chain.

Education & Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor or photonics manufacturing operations, with a focus on capacity ramp, operations program management, or industrialization—preferably in a wafer fabrication environment.

  • Minimum 3-5 years leading cross-site and/or contract-manufacturing ramps spanning assembly and fabrication.

  • Demonstrated ownership of equipment installation and qualification, capacity planning, and manufacturing-readiness execution for new-product or volume ramps.

  • BS degree in engineering or a relevant technical field required.

  • MS degree in engineering, industrial engineering, operations/supply chain, or business preferred.

  • PMP or equivalent program management certification preferred.

Skills

  • Strong program management skills—able to own an integrated, cross-functional, cross-site readiness schedule and drive multiple parallel workstreams to closure.

  • Solid understanding of wafer fab and backend (assembly/test) process flows and equipment/process qualification.

  • Familiarity with MES (e.g., CAMSTAR) and PDM/PLM systems (e.g., Agile).

  • Working knowledge of capacity modeling and operations analytics; expertise in MS Excel; familiarity with PowerBI; MySQL / MS Access a plus.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; data-driven in identifying and closing capacity and readiness gaps.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Be concise, consistent, and persistent in each daily communication across sites.

  • Preferred language skill—proficiency in spoken and written Mandarin.

  • May include travel to Malaysia (Ipoh), China, and Taiwan—15-25%.

Working Conditions

  • On-site job function.

Safety Requirements

All employees are required to follow the site EHS procedures and Coherent Corp. Corporate EHS standards.

Quality and Environmental Responsibilities

Depending on location, this position may be responsible for the execution and maintenance of the ISO 9000, 9001, 14001 and/or other applicable standards that may apply to the relevant roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and Environmental Management System.

Culture Commitment

Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.:

Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust

Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.


If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talentacquisition@coherent.com.

VALIDATION & VERIFICATION ENGINEER, AVIATION ENGINEERING - EL SEGUNDO, CA

  • Develop embedded systems test bench and perform on processor in the loop testing for multiple software components
  • Develop verification testing tools and automation, qualify the test stand and develop qualification procedures for the same
  • Develop and maintain the software certification plans and artifacts.
  • Code and Test vector generation and testing using MathWorks tools set per DO-331 requirements.
  • Conduct multi-disciplinary design reviews including PDR, CDR through different phases of development through to production readiness and certification.
  • Work with the DER and systems group towards successful completion of SOI audits.
  • Advocate and train the Skyryse teams to follow and contribute to the processes.

  • Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline
  • 3+ years experience in software engineering in certification of software and systems
  • Experience in developing software test and verification documents
  • Experience with tools similar to dSPACE
  • Experienced in Python, C, C++, MATLAB
  • Working knowledge of CAN, RTD, Serial Communication, ARINC 429 and UART

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master of Science degree in electrical, computer science, mechanical or aerospace engineering discipline
  • Experience in design, develop, verify and certify display software per DO-178C
  • Experience with certification of software, systems, and subsystems working with DER/FAA
  • Experience in developing, writing, and reviewing certification documentation such as software certification plans, compliance reports, and etc.
  • Working experience in DO-178C and other aerospace regulations/processes/standard
  • Experience in verifying and certifying Fly-by-wire operational flight software using model based development conforming DO-331
  • Experience with LDRA or Vector CAST
  • Experience with Object Code Verification
  • Self starter with ability to work independently with minimal supervision to influence organization

title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets, accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

You'll join Arc's Infrastructure Engineering team and own the data and evaluation of ML infrastructure for Arc's virtual cell models. You'll start with two systems: our Model Performance Dashboard, which benchmarks those models, and the pipeline that turns single-cell data into their training sets. You'll set the technical direction for both and connect them, so every new dataset version is judged by what it does to the models. Later in your first year, the role widens into the engineering that makes the ML team's training and evaluation run fast and at scale, lab-in-the-loop infrastructure, validation frameworks for agent-written software, and Arc's rules for what research data we bring in, keep and share. The role consolidates ownership that is split across several teams today.

Why this position could be the best job you’ve ever had

  • You will contribute to building a virtual cell. Your evals show which data makes Arc's models better, and the answer shapes which experiments Arc's labs run next.
  • You will own the platform end to end, and you work directly with the ML researchers and scientists who rely on it.

About you

  • You finish what you own, and you fix what's broken without being asked.
  • You're curious about the biology, enough to learn single-cell perturbation data and argue about what an eval should measure.
  • You're steady when priorities shift. Research is high-risk, so you test ideas early and change course when the evidence says to.
  • You don't wait on scarce expert time. If proving a dataset's value means running the model evals yourself, you run them.

In this position you will

  • Own how Arc measures the performance of its virtual cell models, starting with the backend of our Model Performance Dashboard, which you'll take over within your first two months.
  • Decide with the ML team which evaluation tools they need, then design and build them so researchers can evaluate and compare models themselves, and measure what each dataset version does to model performance.
  • Redesign the pipeline that turns single-cell data into training sets for our virtual cell models, then run it with AI agents: agents find, process and curate datasets, and automated quality checks, not manual review, decide whether a dataset version is ready for model training.
  • Own the lab-in-the-loop infrastructure that turns model performance results into the case for what Arc's labs should test next, working directly with the science leads who design those experiments.
  • Build or buy validation frameworks (tests, evals, QC gates, policies) that let agent-written code and apps ship without line-by-line human review. Start with our team, where you'll also own how we work with coding agents, then extend them to apps that scientists across Arc build themselves.
  • Own the engineering that makes the ML team's training and evaluation run fast, reliably and at scale. The ML team owns the research and the models. Once a model is ready to push, it enters the train-and-eval CI system you own, which feeds our Model Performance Dashboard. You'll also make multi-node training a supported path, track down distributed-training failures, and measure and raise throughput and GPU utilization (MFU) on clusters that Arc IT operates.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience.
  • You've owned a production data or ML platform that researchers depend on, end to end (pipelines, storage, versioning), and set its technical direction.
  • You design and build systems with AI tools and agents, and you make their output verifiable with evals, QC gates or tests before anyone relies on it.
  • You've learned an unfamiliar technical domain well enough to make design calls in it.
  • You work directly with stakeholders to find requirements, with no PM in between.
  • You make the people around you better through code review, pairing and writing patterns down.
  • You've diagnosed and fixed performance problems in Python or PyTorch systems with profilers and measurements: GPU utilization, memory, data loading.
  • Work onsite in our Palo Alto office at least 3 days a week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You've worked with single-cell or perturbation data (AnnData/h5ad).
  • You've built or run model evaluations: benchmarks, eval harnesses, PyTorch/GPU inference.
  • You've run multi-node distributed training (DDP/FSDP, NCCL, SLURM) or raised a training job's throughput. This is a plus, not a requirement: we care more that you learn it fast with agents and show the numbers moved.
  • You've led an effort with one or two other engineers.

The base salary range for this position is $191,000 to $237,000. These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits. This position is also eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus, with the amount dependent on individual and institute performance factors.

In addition to the Base Salary and Annual Bonus above, you will be eligible to participate in the Institute’s Compound Cash Grant Program (the “CCGP”). The CCGP is a program designed to offer multi-year cash grants providing for a fixed dollar amount paid out in semi-annual installments to reward employees for staying and contributing to the Institute. As soon as reasonably practical after your start date, you will receive a grant letter describing the terms of your award under the CCGP.

title: Composites Technician (COPV)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

COMPOSITES TECHNICIAN (COPV)

The Starship COPV Composites Technician manufactures flight-critical composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) used to store high-pressure gases on Starship and Super Heavy. This is a hands-on production role: preparing metallic liners, filament-winding the composite overwrap, curing, and trimming, finishing, and assembling COPV hardware to engineering drawings and process specifications.

This position is onsite at a SpaceX production facility supporting Starship COPV manufacturing. The successful candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working from travelers and work instructions, and able to produce consistent, high-quality composite work in a fast-paced flight-hardware environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepare metallic COPV liners and bond interfaces for overwrap, including grit blast, hand abrasion, and power abrasion
  • Manufacture COPVs by filament winding composite fiber onto liners, including hoop and helical winding patterns, fiber tension, and resin application (wet winding and/or towpreg)
  • Set up, operate, and tend filament winding equipment; load liners, verify winding programs, and monitor fiber path, bandwidth, and resin wet-out during the wrap
  • Mix, handle, and apply resins and adhesives per process specification, including pot life, mix ratio, and material traceability
  • Cure COPV overwraps and bonded assemblies in ovens or autoclaves, including thermocouple placement and process monitoring
  • Trim and finish composite and composite-metallic COPV assemblies to drawing requirements
  • Assemble COPV hardware, including setup, bonding, and fastener installation at bosses, fittings, and related structure
  • Complete basic layouts on parts and assemblies to establish reference points and verify dimensions using calipers, micrometers, precision scales, and torque wrenches
  • Follow travelers, work instructions, and standard operating procedures; record work and nonconformances as required
  • Maintain FOD control, material traceability, and a clean, organized work area in a high-rate production environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 1+ years of experience working with in a manufacturing environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience manufacturing composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) or other filament-wound pressure-critical hardware
  • Experience operating CNC or programmable filament winding machines
  • Experience controlling hoop and helical wind patterns, fiber tension, bandwidth, and resin content
  • Experience drilling, reaming, honing, and/or countersinking close-tolerance holes, and installing fasteners with the correct tool for the job (drill motor, power screwdriver, C-squeeze, ratchet wrench, nut runner, rivet gun and bucking bar, etc.)
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, including drawing symbols, flag notes, and general notes
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and to work from travelers and SOPs (standard operating procedures)
  • Experience with oven or autoclave cure cycles and thermocouple placement
  • Experience building flight hardware or other pressure-critical composite structures
  • Attention to detail and accuracy while working in a fast-paced production environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Standing for long periods, climbing ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching are generally required to perform the functions of this position
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces around winding equipment, tooling, and vessel hardware
  • Must be able to work shift hours (6:00am – 4:30pm Mon – Fri) including overtime, weekends, and holidays based on site operational needs
  • Must be able to travel up to 10% of the time
  • This role is onsite and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:

Composites Technician/Level 1: $20.00 - $24.50/hour

Composites Technician/Level 2: $23.50 - $29.00/hour

Composites Technician/Level 3: $27.50 - $35.00/hour

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Lead Graphic Designer
description:
Pretty Isn’t Good Enough: Your portfolio proves you know how to take a marketing idea and turn it into design that grabs attention, communicates the message fast, and gets people to act. You know how to lead and mentor a team of designers, raise the visual bar, and keep projects moving without sacrificing quality.

Most importantly, you understand this:

Great design isn’t just decoration. It’s salesmanship in pixels.

If that sounds like you, and you’re excited by the idea of raising the creative standard across a fast-growing health and wellness brand, you might just be the Lead Graphic Designer AlgaeCal is looking for.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

Here’s what you’ll be up to in this busy role:

  • Helping talented designers become even better. You’ll set the standard, give clear feedback, and make sure the work keeps improving.
  • Making sure every piece of creative is on-brand, easy to understand, and built to get a result. Because at AlgaeCal, “looks nice” is never the finish line.
  • Taking the lead on major campaigns, product launches, website projects, and other big creative initiatives from the first idea right through to the finished work.
  • Reviewing creative before it goes out the door and making sure the feedback process is clear, useful, and fast. No vague comments. No endless revision loops.
  • Setting clear goals for the design team so everyone knows what great looks like, what matters most, and where their time should be going.
  • Meeting regularly with your designers to coach them, support them, challenge them, and help them grow.
  • Working closely with our Project Management Team to keep priorities straight, workloads realistic, and deadlines on track without letting quality slip.
  • Looking at how our creative actually performs and asking the important questions. Did it get attention? Did people understand it? Did it work?
  • Keeping up with new design trends, tools, and AI technology, then using the good stuff and ignoring the gimmicks.

This job might be for you if you’ve got…

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience and a portfolio that makes us say “holy smokes we HAVE to talk!”
  • Proven experience mentoring designers. You know how to give useful feedback, raise the bar, and get great work out of people without becoming the creative tyrant no one wants to work with.
  • Serious Adobe Creative Suite skills, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects. Premiere Pro is a nice bonus. You’ll also need to know Figma inside out and back to front.
  • A strong background in digital marketing and e-commerce. You’re not just a designer. You understand that your work has to help sell. Sales pages, emails, paid ads, landing pages, funnels... none of this should be foreign territory. If you need to Google “CTR,” this probably isn’t the job for you.
  • The ability to design across pretty much everything we throw at you, including ads, websites, email, social, print, packaging, presentations, and other marketing collateral.
  • Experience using AI creative tools to work faster, explore ideas, and improve output without making everything look like it was made by AI.
  • E-commerce, Amazon, or marketplace experience gets you bonus points.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to meet you.

Qualities That Make You An Ideal Teammate

At AlgaeCal we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble, you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
  • You’re hungry to learn more
  • You’re people smart, in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?
Let’s discuss your salary during the interview process, but know that we’re a generous team and we know how to reward top talent!

You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • A generous healthcare package
  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
  • Weekly team lunches
  • Casual dress code
  • Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
  • Professional Development: You’ll get the opportunity to attend professional development conferences or workshops that will enhance your skills, expand your network, and drive your career forward with our support! And of course, we’ll cover your fees, accommodation, travel, meals, and any related materials or resources.

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Lead Graphic Designer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

  1. Why are you the best Lead Graphic Designer for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements and experience.
  2. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: http://shorturl.at/lptFT
  3. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
  4. What are the last three books you’ve read?
  5. What do you do for fun?

2. Explain what you’re doing now for a job:

  1. If you don’t have one, explain why.
  2. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.

3. Upload your cover letter, resume, and link to your portfolio

  1. Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read! Include the URL to your portfolio***

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

title: Insulator I
description:
The Industrial Journeyman Insulator position will include several duties. Insulators will apply insulation to pipe, ducts, and equipment as required by specifications. They will also be required to paint equipment and structures for protection and cosmetic purposes, to maintain, mix, and have thorough knowledge of paint and other coating materials so that to ensure the equipment or structure is painted and protected as per contract or specifications

Must Have:

  • NCCER Insulator
  • Minium of 5 Years of Insulator Experience
  • Able to be self sufficient
  • Industrial paint experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Material Installation: Measure, cut, and fit insulation materials (such as fiberglass, mineral wool, calcium silicate, and foam) around complex industrial equipment, vessels, and 45°/90° pipe elbows.
  • Metal Jacketing & Fabrication: Fabricate and secure custom sheet metal covers, elbows, tees, and jacketing using brakes, shears, and rollers.
  • Blueprint Reading: Interpret technical specifications, isometric drawings, and construction blueprints to determine precise material requirements.
  • Maintenance & Removal: Strip away damaged, wet, or old insulation (including coordinating safe removal of hazardous materials like asbestos when certified) during plant turnarounds or routine repairs.
  • Sealing & Finishing: Apply vapor barriers, canvas strips, mastic cements, and tape to seal insulated surfaces against moisture and environmental damage.
  • Safety Compliance: Follow strict OSHA guidelines, wear specialized personal protective equipment (PPE), and operate safely in confined spaces or high scaffolding.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Experience: 5 years of hands-on mechanical insulation experience in heavy industrial or manufacturing environments.
  • Certifications: NCCER (National Center for Construction Education and Research) or NIA (National Insulation Association) training/certifications preferred.

Physical Requirements: High physical stamina, strength to lift up to 50 pounds, and comfort working at heights, on ladders, JLG, Operate Fork Lift, or in cramped spaces

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current Zachry or Zachry ROF'ed employee
  • National Center for Construction Education and Research’s (NCCER) certification for Industrial Journeyman Insulator.
  • Formal/Technical education.
  • Experience working with scaffolding, insulation, and painting.

Physical Requirements

  • Employees will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, and lifting.
  • Will talk and hear to communicate.
  • Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull objects, materials, controls, and tools.
  • May be required to lift, carry, and move up to 50lbs.
  • Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, work off platforms and man lifts, and may occasionally work out on an open structure using the appropriate fall protection requirements.
  • Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to hard hat, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs/muffs, masks/respirators, safety vests, gloves, and leather work boots.

In support of internal and external quality initiatives, the Sr. Quality Improvement Specialist applies extensive knowledge of quality data analysis and/or improvement concepts, EHR reporting methodologies, and data collection and abstraction techniques to substantial projects of large scope and high degrees of complexity.

In support of designated clinical departments, the incumbent will partner with physicians in a team-based approach to drive the program and maintain an open dialogue to achieve identified goals and priorities related to quality and safety. The Sr. Quality Improvement Specialist identifies potential problems in the care delivery process as a result of data monitoring and formulates a workgroup to resolve the issue and ensures new processes are in place to improve the delivery of care.

The portfolio of work assigned to the Sr. Quality Improvement Specialist includes the following areas:

Affiliate Quality Management:

  • Direct annual goal setting and performance and related implementation with data teams and clinical domains

  • Clinical leader who can guide development and collaboration on shared clinical protocols and patient safety & quality activities across UCSF’s Affiliate Network

  • Facilitate and lead stakeholder workgroups in alignment with strategic priorities and under direction of Network & Quality executive leaders

  • Supports the UCSF Network implementation of UCSF’s organizational strategy for optimizing value-based care and quality performance

  • Support mandatory quality reporting administration as needed; guide access to reports for leadership and physicians regarding program status, performance metrics, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Analyze performance data and trends, identifying areas of improvement and developing corrective action plans. Develop summaries and materials as needed to support strategic planning and decision-making.

OTHER FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Sr. Quality Improvement Specialist may be expected onsite 5 days per week unless specified otherwise through an annual telework agreement. title: Enablement Specialist
description:
What We Do
At GoGuardian, we’re helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world’s greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.
What It’s Like to Work at GoGuardian

We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why “I love the people here” is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

The Role

We’re looking for an Enablement Specialist to join our Sales Enablement team, reporting to the Manager, Sales Enablement & GTM Alignment. This role covers a lot of ground. You’ll own a handful of programs yourself and support several others depending on the priorities and seasonal needs of the business. The biggest piece of ownership is onboarding and ramp: you’ll run how new sellers and new sales leaders get up to speed, including the curriculum, the milestones, the certification, and the call on when a seller is ready to be in the field.

The rest of the job is a mix. You’ll build the onboarding path for sales leaders, both the ones we hire and the ones we promote, support our Senior Enablement Partner with product enablement, run enablement intake so requests from across GTM get sorted and prioritized, and own the systems and content setup that keep our enablement easy to find, current, and measurable. What you spend the most time on will change as the business does. You’ll be cross-trained on the important programs and systems that way nothing stops when one person is out or our needs change throughout the year. We’re looking for someone with enablement experience who knows the K-12 buyer and already uses AI to get more done.

What You’ll Do

  • Run sales onboarding from start to finish - curriculum, milestones, certification, and manager check-ins - and be measured on how quickly reps get to their first deal and full productivity
  • Run onboarding cohorts and 30/60/90 check-ins, lead live sessions, and partner with our Senior Sales Coach to support new hires through their first discovery calls, demos, and pitches
  • Build and run onboarding for new sales leaders, including people promoted from within
  • Support our Senior Enablement Partner with product enablement, including launch prep, competitive positioning, demo certification, and follow-up after launch
  • Run enablement intake as one place for requests from sales, marketing, product, and customer success, with clear priorities and response times
  • Own enablement systems and how content is organized including who owns what, tagging, usage reports, and keeping content current
  • Use AI to save time (e.g. keeping certification rubrics updated, automating reports)
  • Report monthly on how enablement is doing - ramp time, certification pass rates, content usage
  • Be the cross-trained backup on core programs and systems so work keeps moving when someone is out or priorities shift

Who You Are

  • 1-3 years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or sales training - or an adjacent background in sales or customer success
  • Experience in the K-12 or EdTech market, with a working understanding of the district buyer
  • A good facilitator who can hold attention on a video call, and a clear writer who can turn a product briefing into something a rep can use on a live call
  • You already use AI to draft, summarize, and automate, and you know where it saves time vs. where someone still needs to check the work
  • Organized enough to run intake for a function with more requests than capacity, and comfortable saying “not this quarter” with a reason attached
  • Systems-minded - you care about clean taxonomy, working links, accurate dashboards, and content that doesn’t get stale
  • Collaborative and low-ego, willing to be the backup rather than the owner when the situation calls for it
  • Experience with enablement platforms (Highspot a plus), Salesforce, and conversation intelligence tools such as Clari or Gong is a plus
  • Eager to take initiative in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Fueled by the opportunity to truly impact the education landscape
  • Something else? Tell us! We want to learn more about you…

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay, complete health insurance, 401(k) matching, and an employee equity plan.
  • Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, wellness days, and a paid year-end holiday break.
  • A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal well being, including work from home funds, fertility &adoption reimbursement, and more…

Plus the intangible:

  • A varied and challenging role in a global and highly innovative high-growth company.
  • Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

The typical base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 per year. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base pay for this position and your pay will be determined by a variety of factors, including your primary work location, skills, qualifications and experience. Additional benefits information is listed on our careers page.

Please share this with your friends or co-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talented people.

title: Skills Trainer (SAGE)
description:
Job Title: Skills Trainer
Department/Program: SAGE
Reports to: Program Director
Work location: Mt. Scott
Job Type: In-Person
FLSA status: Non-exempt/hourly
Salary: $25.47/hr. - $28.08/hr. (Bilingual Spanish $27.76/hr. - $30.60/hr.)

Morrison Child and Family Services: We are a Joint Commission and Sanctuary accredited non-profit organization that provides a comprehensive array of services to children, adolescents, and their families. As an agency, Morrison, its team members, and clients commit to the following values of trauma-informed care:

  • Nonviolence - being safe and doing the right thing
  • Emotional Intelligence - managing our feelings so we don’t hurt ourselves or others
  • Social Learning - respecting and sharing ideas of our teams
  • Democracy - shared decision making whenever possible
  • Open Communication - saying what we mean and not being mean when we say it
  • Social Responsibility - everyone makes a contribution to the organizational culture
  • Growth and Change - creating hope for our clients and ourselves

Job Summary:

The Skills Trainer provides intensive specialized skill-based mental health services for adolescents, and their families as they transition from residential treatment back to the community.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identifies and evaluates community resources for programs and activities, and connects youth and families to them
  • Integrates youths’ needs for dignity, nurturance, choice, self-management, and privacy into activities of daily living.
  • Assists clients in identifying and developing their strengths through activities and other experiences.
  • Recognizes personal strengths and limitations, feelings and needs.
  • Sets appropriate boundaries and limits using clear and respectful communication.
  • Uses scheduled supervision constructively, seeks feedback to improve performance, and accepts and utilizes feedback to improve outcomes.
  • Shares decision making whenever possible. Uses a collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • Is present and punctual for scheduled shifts and/or meetings.
  • Works well within a team environment, sharing workload, responsibilities, credit, and opportunities.
  • Uses scheduled supervision constructively, responds nondefensively and applies supervisory feedback.
  • Is aware of Morrison Compliance Program including Compliance Officer, Compliance Standards of Conduct, and Employee Compliance Hotline. Understands Compliance Standards of Conduct and signs attestation document. Completes all assigned compliance, HIPAA, client privacy, and fraud, waste, and abuse training. Knows how to report any client privacy or fraud, waste, or abuse concerns.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to developing a thorough knowledge and application of the Sanctuary model and other organizational policies & practices.
  • Participate in staff development, in-services, and training related to workplace effectiveness; model professional behaviors and implement improvements to business practices with awareness of their impact in a trauma-informed behavioral healthcare organization.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

Competencies:

  • Understands mental health assessment, treatment, case management, and service terminology.
  • Verbally and non-verbally de-escalates crisis situations in a manner that protects dignity and integrity.
  • Establishes and maintains effective relationships within a team environment by promoting and maintaining professional conduct, negotiating and resolving conflict, acknowledging individual differences, and supporting team members.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize professional limitations and seeks supervision when appropriate.
  • Acknowledges and respects the diversity of all individuals and demonstrate openness to providing culturally responsive care and treatment to clients and their families.
  • Follows safe medication administration practices by adhering to prescribed medication use, including doses and documentation. Seeks consultation to address medication concerns and availability.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and skill in assessing suicide risk factors and facilitating screening and triage.
  • Acts efficiently and quickly in response to medical emergencies and performs CPR and first aid as needed, following all crisis policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates sufficient knowledge to support clients experiencing a mental health crisis including de-escalation techniques and facilitating access to appropriate crisis services.
  • Understands and complies with mandatory reporting requirements. Use developmentally appropriate and trauma informed approach to follow agency protocol for assessment and intervention.
  • Verbally, and using physical restraint techniques when necessary, de-escalates crisis situations following agency protocol in a manner that protects dignity and integrity

Required Position Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 2 years of experience working with youth and/or families
  • Meets QMHA requirements under State of Oregon Administrative Rules
  • Basic computer skills using word processing, spreadsheets, databases and email

Preferred Position Qualifications:

  • Bilingual in Spanish, both written and spoken. Must clear a language proficiency test for Spanish
  • Bachelor’s degree in a social service or field or equivalent education, training and experience
  • Direct experience with children and/or adolescents in a residential or mental health setting

Other Requirements:

  • Shifts may require day, evening and weekend hours
  • Provides emergency first aid, as needed, and maintains a current standard first aid/CPR certification
  • Able to pass a comprehensive criminal history background investigation

For positions that require driving:

  • Must hold valid driver’s license— Oregon or Washington within 30 days of hire
  • Personal transportation allowing for frequent, regular travel within the Portland metropolitan area in a timely manner.
  • Proof of personal auto liability coverage ($100,000/$100,000 must be maintained), and a driving record that meets corporate driving requirements.

Working Conditions:

Environment: Work is done in clinical offices, community settings, including Morrison Residential, administration buildings, public locations, and social service sites. Breaks and meals are subject to interruption. Universal Precautions and remaining alert to the environment are critical to address the potential for violent behavior, exposure to disease, biohazards, noise, and contaminants.

Mental demands: Work assigned is diverse and may involve addressing new and unique circumstances. The work might be unpredictable and disrupts planned tasks, requiring flexible time management.

Physical demands: Ability to remain calm and emotionally available serving youth, adults and or families who have experienced trauma. Proficient with office equipment and physical movement. Ability to perform physical interventions if needed in accordance with program and training. Physical dexterity for reaching, stooping, and repetitive wrist and hand motions.

All Morrison programs and services are accredited by The Joint Commission, a nationally recognized standard-setting and accreditation body for health care. Morrison is also certified as a trauma-informed organization by the Sanctuary Institute. Certification recognizes our dedication to providing a trauma-informed culture and environment for children, families and staff through implementing Sanctuary values, commitments, and tools.
We are an Affirmative Action Plan Employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. In compliance with our Affirmative Action Plan, Morrison uses E-Verify to determine employment eligibility after an offer is accepted.
Applications will be reviewed as received. Morrison reserves the right to make a hiring decision at any point during the posting period.
Morrison employees are offered a variety of benefits including Medical, Vision, Dental, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employer-Paid Life, Accidental Death and Dismemberment and Long-Term Disability, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

title: Senior AI Pricing Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Senior AI Pricing Analyst leads the development and execution of strategic pricing approaches for AI-enabled products, solutions, and services. This role uses market intelligence, financial analysis, competitive research, customer insights, and advanced pricing models to recommend pricing structures that align with business goals, client value, and profitability targets. The incumbent collaborates across sales, finance, product, and delivery teams to evaluate opportunities, quantify value-based pricing, and guide pricing strategy for new offerings and existing portfolios. This position also applies AI-enabled analytics and automation to improve pricing effectiveness, support faster decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in revenue and margin performance.

Job Duties:

  • Develops and maintains pricing strategies for AI-enabled products, solutions, and services to support revenue growth, profitability, and market competitiveness
  • Builds, analyzes, and refines pricing models using financial data, market trends, customer insights, cost structures, and competitive intelligence
  • Conducts market research and benchmarking to assess pricing trends, competitor positioning, and demand drivers across target industries and offerings
  • Partners with sales, finance, product, delivery, and leadership teams to evaluate deal pricing, proposal pricing, and new offering strategies
  • Supports value-based pricing by quantifying business impact, ROI, and client outcomes associated with AI and advanced technology solutions
  • Analyzes historical pricing performance, win/loss data, margins, and revenue trends to identify optimization opportunities and improve pricing effectiveness
  • Develops financial scenarios, forecasts, and sensitivity analyses to support pricing recommendations and business decisions
  • Creates pricing guidance, tools, templates, and best practices to improve consistency, speed, and scalability of pricing decisions
  • Monitors pricing exceptions, discounting patterns, and commercial terms to ensure alignment with profitability goals and risk considerations
  • Presents pricing recommendations, findings, and strategic insights to stakeholders and senior leadership in a clear and actionable manner
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to support launch readiness for new AI offerings, including packaging, positioning, and monetization strategy
  • Applies automation, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to improve pricing processes, reporting, and decision support capabilities
  • Maintains awareness of industry trends, emerging AI solution models, and evolving commercial practices to inform pricing strategy
  • Assists with special projects and strategic analyses
  • Other duties as required

  • N/A

Education:

  • High School diploma or equivalent, required
  • Bachelor’s degree with focus in Finance, Accounting, and STEM, preferred

Experience:

  • Five (5) to seven (7) years of experience in pricing analysis, financial analysis, revenue management, or commercial strategy, required
  • Experience developing pricing models, financial scenarios, margin analysis, and forecasting to support strategic pricing decisions, required
  • Experience conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, and value-based pricing analysis for products or services, required
  • Experience partnering with sales, finance, product, and business leaders to support deal pricing, proposal pricing, and pricing strategy, required
  • Experience applying advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled insights to improve pricing processes, decision support, and reporting, preferred
  • Experience supporting professional services, technology, AI, or government services pricing environments, preferred


Certifications/Licensure:

  • Certified Pricing Professional (CPP) or similar pricing certification, preferred
  • Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or finance/analytics certification, preferred
  • Certification in data analytics, business intelligence, or AI-related tools and platforms, preferred
  • Lean Six Sigma certification, preferred

Software:

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and data manipulation, required
  • Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms, required
  • Experience with SQL, pricing databases, or analytics tools used to extract, structure, and analyze large data sets, preferred
  • Experience with ERP, CRM, proposal, or financial systems that support pricing, forecasting, and commercial analysis, preferred
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, or machine learning tools that enhance pricing insights and decision support, preferred


Language:

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable pricing recommendations
  • Strong understanding of pricing strategy, financial drivers, margin management, and commercial decision-making
  • Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, and value-based assessments to support pricing strategy
  • Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership

Join our team and you'll be able to develop your skills, grow your career, build relationships with your peers and patients, and help us be a source of hope for our friends and neighbors.

Working effectively with the team/work group to accomplish daily team/unit tasks: working proactively to achieve the team/unit goals and facilitate group cohesiveness.

Pages the resuscitation team during cardiac arrests and remains available at the nurse station for further instructions. Facilitates interdepartmental communication by providing information (e.g. phone messages) to appropriate clinicians.

Clerical:

Support-provides clerical/non-clinical support for the provision with patient services under the supervision of the nursing management. Assembles the patient chart with appropriate forms according to policy, providing additional forms as necessary. Prepares charts for patients scheduled for the operating room, special studies/therapies, transfer or discharge. Prepares maintains and files forms and reports in patient charts. title: Arbetshandledare
description:
Tierp är en kommun med en organisation i rätt storlek för dig som vill ha nära till chef, kollegor, politik och kunder. Här finns utrymme för både personlig utveckling och samverkan i organisationen.

Vår kommun erbjuder varierande boendemiljöer, havsnära natur, historia, kultur och god service. Tierp har Stockholm, Uppsala och Gävle inom pendlingsavstånd och erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta delvis på distans.

Våra värderingar är viktiga och tillsammans arbetar vi för att förverkliga våra värdeord: respekt, ansvar, kundfokus, mod och framtidstro.

Arbetsmarknadsenheten, AME, har i uppdrag att stödja kommuninvånare i åldern 18 - 67 år som uppbär försörjningsstöd, med målet att de ska nå arbete eller studier. Målgruppen har olika erfarenheter och behov. NPF diagnoser, psykisk ohälsa, missbruk samt våld i nära relation mm påverkar många och som ligger till grund för individuella planeringar utifrån varje individs behov.

Inom AME genomför vi bedömning av arbetsförmåga i vår verksamhet Verkstan. Vi erbjuder förberedande insatser i Växtverket och Hantverket. Björken och Höga Berget är två av våra caféer med arbetstränings platser samt att vi ger stöd både inför och under studietiden för att skapa hållbara vägar mot egen försörjning. 

Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad. Du ingår i vårt stöttande arbetslag med engagerade kollegor. Verksamheten ska möta upp Aktivitetskravet som trädde i kraft 1 juli. Det innebär att personer som uppbär försörjningsstöd ska ingå i en aktivitet med fokus på arbete.

Du kommer att ingå och vara delaktig i att utveckla ett Serviceteam som har uppdraget att skapa och genomföra meningsfulla och samhällsnyttiga uppdrag inom kommunens verksamheter och kommunala bolag.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som handledare leder och handleder du ett team som utför varierande uppdrag åt kommunens verksamheter. Arbetsuppgifterna kan exempelvis bestå av att köra sopor, rensa ogräs, laga och tillverka enklare snickeri lösningar, reparera möbler och vara behjälplig vid flyttar. Tvätta möbler, textiler, städning och/eller ge service i personalutrymmen är andra möjliga arbetsuppgifter.

Tillsammans med samordnaren kommer du att vara med och utveckla uppdraget för att möta upp behoven. Du ansvarar för att planera och fördela arbetsuppgifterna utifrån teamets behov, förutsättningar och begränsningar samt säkerställer att uppdragen genomförs och slutförs. Du arbetar själv praktiskt tillsammans med teamet och kombinerar det praktiska arbetet med handledning, stöd och coachning. 

Uppdragen varierar utifrån verksamheternas behov och teammedlemmarnas förutsättningar. En viktig del av rollen är att motivera och stötta personer i deras utveckling och väg mot arbete eller studier.

Vi söker dig som har praktisk erfarenhet och kunskap inom enklare snickeri, reparationer och andra vardagliga sysslor. Kunskap om psykisk ohälsa, neuropsykiatriska funktions variationer och arbete med människor i utsatthet är meriterande.

KVALIFIKATIONER
B-körkort

Praktiskt arbete

Kunskap och erfarenhet av praktiskt arbete, till exempel laga möbler, bygga om möbler och hitta olika lösningar för verksamheternas bästa, sätta upp saker, städning, tvättning, mm.

Leda och coacha

Planera, fördela arbetsuppgifter, involvera, genomföra och följa upp.

Skapa ett team med delaktighet och få personerna att utvecklas i sina roller för att närma sig arbetsmarknaden.

Utbildning

Eftergymnasial utbildning som möter upp och är relevant för uppdraget och målgruppens behov är meriterande.

Du har förmågan att arbeta med andra människor; att lyssna, visa empati och respekt. Du är prestigelös och uppmärksammar och belönar andras bidrag.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-11  .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

På Tierps kommun sätter vi våra medarbetares välmående i fokus och erbjuder därför ett friskvårdsbidrag på 3 000 kronor, möjligheten att löneväxla för extra semesterdagar, förmånscykel samt andra attraktiva förmåner. Vi strävar även efter att skapa en arbetsplats med rika utvecklingsmöjligheter.

Mångfald är viktigt för oss, och vi ser våra medarbetares olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter, kunskaper och personligheter som en värdefull resurs som berikar vår kommun.

Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz, måste du kunna visa upp ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller bekräfta att du är undantagen från kravet. Anställning kan endast ske efter att vi har kontrollerat detta, i enlighet med utlänningsförordningen.

Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via Visma Recruit. Vänligen skicka inte ansökan via e-post eller i pappersformat. Om du har skyddad identitet, kontakta den rekryterande chefen direkt och skicka inte in din ansökan digitalt.

Vi avböjer vänligen men bestämt alla erbjudanden om hjälp med annonsering eller rekrytering.

title: Store Administrator
description:
PURPOSE: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all areas of the job. Provides accurate records of store sales and related transactions while supporting store sales and the overall operating plan. Performs store level cash handling and human resources and personnel functions.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for completing the daily reconciliation, accounting, and cash balancing functions (in some areas this may include counting the safe, counting, maintaining and reconciling self check out registers, and preparing the tills and deposits).
  • Monitors cashier accountability and researches and reports problems and shortages to the Service Operations/Customer Service Manager and Store Director, including out of warranty checks, WIC violations, violation of check cashing procedures, cash variances, improper refunds and voids and till balance irregularities, etc.
  • Partners with Division Loss Prevention and front end management team to resolve cash and other shrink issues.
  • Assists the Store Director with billing and invoices.
  • Maintains sales book. Report daily and/or weekly sales information to the Division Office.
  • Performs miscellaneous administrative duties such as ordering money orders, bus passes, lottery, gift cards, postage and change (if applicable). Administrative duties include the use of various computer programs and e-mail systems.
  • Reports attendance problems to the Store Director and appropriate department manager in a timely manner, including attendance or schedule violations.
  • Reviews internal and external applications, conducts screening interviews and coordinates department manager interviews. Administers the job-posting program. Manages pre-employment drug testing and tax credit process. Completes the new hire process, coordinates training and conducts orientation.
  • Coordinates and maintains all aspects of the hiring process including the computer assisted application and hiring process. May attend outside recruiting activities, such as job fairs. Maintains all in-store recruiting materials, applications, policy sign off forms, etc. Retains records related to the interview and hiring process.
  • Orders and assigns uniforms, nametags, and miscellaneous store supplies. Handles outgoing/incoming mail, e-mail, and maintains miscellaneous office files. Updates break room information/communication boards as needed.
  • Serves as liaison between the Human Resources, Payroll, and Benefits Departments. Handles payroll and benefits administration issues and works with Store Director and Human Resources representatives in handling some personnel issues. Reviews associate time records for compliance with Company policies. Submits and processes payroll on a timely basis. Maintains all Time and Attendance reports, Time and Attendance Correction Forms, schedules and personnel records in compliance with Company guidelines.
  • Coordinates, inputs and tracks leave paperwork including disability, military, General Leave, Worker’s Compensation, Family Medical Leave Act and other leaves of absence. Processes appropriate paperwork for return from leave situations, processing reinstatements, termination forms, etc.
  • Maintains Associate HR Records securely and keeps medical files (doctor’s notes, worker’s compensation, FMLA and other medical leave documents etc.) separate from associate personnel files. Ensure that current personnel files are complete and up to date and that they contain applications, policy statements, etc., by conducting in-store file audits. Submits appropriate personnel status and address changes and termination paperwork. Ensures compliance with records retention policy requirements.
  • Ensures that minor associates provide appropriate work certificates prior to beginning work, if any are required, and ensures that they are scheduled and working in compliance with state laws.
  • Ensures compliance with HIPAA and the confidentiality required under federal and state law.
  • May coordinate all safety-related activities, including monthly safety meetings. May coordinate service award programs.
  • Answers and responds to incoming calls appropriately.
  • Supports front end operations.
  • Ensures proper cleanliness and neat appearance of the office area.
  • Responsible for performing all job duties with honesty and integrity, in compliance with Company policies and procedures.

PHYSICAL AND GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must sit for long periods of time, move, bend, stoop, kneel, twist and turn frequently. Ability to reach, lift and maneuver items of varying dimensions and sizes up to approximately 20 lbs. Manual dexterity and good eye-hand coordination are necessary.
  • Strictly adheres to confidentiality requirements. Appropriately prioritizes workload. Thorough knowledge of cash balancing, cash handling, company policies, benefits, scheduling tools, payroll processing procedures, hiring, training and new associate orientation is required. Must work efficiently through organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Requires knowledge of one and two step math calculations (i.e., addition, subtraction, and percent calculations) and basic computer skills.
  • Operates calculator, telephone, computer software and electronic equipment to order products, performs cash balance, plans and performs personnel functions.
  • Must possess good written and verbal communication skills and leadership skills, while demonstrating an understanding of Company Core Values as reflected in personal and professional conduct.
  • Must be friendly, courteous, sensitive and maintain professional demeanor in dealing with customers, co-workers and vendors. Must concentrate and deal with interruptions well, work independently, and take initiative. Good attendance is required. Must comply with appropriate grooming and dress code standards. Mental alertness is necessary to ensure safe and accurate completion of work activities.
  • Must utilize cleaning supplies.
  • May be required to work nights, weekends and holidays. Scheduled hours will vary.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Generally works in a temperature controlled office environment.
  • Occasional travel, including overnight travel, may be required.

title: PA / NP - GI Gastroenterology
description:
Overview

The Gastroenterology outpatient/inpatient care Physician Assistant or Advanced Practice Nurse (APN) assists, monitors, and manages the day-to-day needs of patients as requested by, in conjunction with, and under the supervision of a physician. Performs the duties and responsibilities of a Physician Assistant/Nurse Practitioner according to customary and generally accepted medical standards.

Position is located in Manahawkin, NJ.

Office hours:

M-F 8:30-5:00

No weekends required.

No holidays required.

No on-call requirement.

Very busy GI practice with three GI physicians and three APPs.

Responsibilities

1. Provide medical services under the supervision of a licensed physician, consistent with the PA's education, training and experience. 2. Performs and documents accurate, complete, and relevant history and physical assessments appropriate for the patient's age, gender, and clinical problem. 3. Orders, performs, and interprets laboratory tests and diagnostic studies/procedures in collaboration with physicians and consultants as appropriate. 4. Manages general medical and surgical conditions based on comprehensive knowledge of etiologies, risk factors, pathophysiology, and the indications and contraindications of pharmacologic agents and other treatment modalities. 5. Prescribes medication safely and effectively in accordance with best practices, hospital policy, and NJ regulations, providing patient education as needed. 6. Seeks opportunities to promote Hackensack Meridian Health (HMH) PA practice recognition (locally, nationally, and internationally) through conferences, publications, and presentations. 7. Provides care that is patient- and family-centered, compassionate, and effective for the promotion of health and treatment of disease. 8. Practices as a healthcare provider according to the rules and regulations of the Medical Staff and bylaws as outlined in the delineation of privileges. 9. Applies evidence-based and value-based medicine to systematically analyze and improve patient care practices and outcomes. 10. Evaluates patient/family transition of care planning, considering resource utilization, cost, quality, safety and self-management promotion for chronic conditions. 11. Demonstrates clinical expertise through advanced assessment and procedural skills pertinent to the practice specialty. 12. Translates `best practice' into clinical practice by evaluating current protocols and standards of care. 13. Provides culturally sensitive and educationally appropriate health management education to patients and families. 14. Facilitates consistent, coordinated care and clear communication among all members of the healthcare team through participation in daily interdisciplinary rounds. 15. Serves as an advocate for patients and families, identifying and addressing obstacles to care progression and escalating issues as appropriate. 16. Serves as a clinical resource for the multidisciplinary team by addressing clinical, process, and system improvement opportunities. 17. Participates in organizational and departmental meetings, committees, and workgroups as necessary. 18. Demonstrates the highest level of accountability for professional practice and adheres to ethical principles regarding patient confidentiality, informed consent, and adverse outcomes. 19. Promotes a collaborative work environment supporting the organizational mission, behavior expectations, values, and pillars. 20. Mentors other PAs, precepts students in PA programs and participates in educational programs as a clinical expert. 21. Identifies patient/family educational needs and collaborates to implement appropriate teaching materials. 22. Promotes innovation by integrating new clinical knowledge into practice. 23. Participates in clinical research activities and disseminates findings through practice, education, presentations, and publications. 24. Identifies ethical care issues and coordinates interdisciplinary meetings to resolve them. 25. Comply with HMH and department-specific scope of services, policies and procedures as applicable to role. 26. Adheres to all HMH infection control and safety policies. 27. Other duties and/or projects as assigned. 28. Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: 1. Successful completion of an approved physician's assistant program, accredited by the AMA Council on Medical Education. 2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 3. Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Licenses and Certifications Required: 1. Physician Assistant License. 2. National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants. 3. BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification. 4. AHA Advanced Cardiac Life Support Certification.

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: 1. Graduate of an NLN/AACN accredited nursing program. 2. Master's or Doctorate degree from an accredited Nurse Practitioner program. 3. Maintains clinical competencies through continuing education and clinical practice. 4. Experience in a relevant patient care setting (or as regulations dictate). 5. National Provider Identifier (NPI). 6. Prescriptive authority through CDS and DEA registration according to New Jersey state law. 7. Collaborative agreement with physicians on staff. 8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 9. Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms. Licenses and Certifications Required: 1. NJ State Professional Registered Nurse License. 2. Advance Practice Nurse License. 3. BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification. 4. Board certified by AANP or ANCC. Licenses and Certifications 5. Advanced Cardiac Life Support Certification.

Starting Minimum Rate

Minimum rate of $146,348.80 Annually

title: NetSuite Developer
description:
We are looking for a NetSuite Developer who will become our in-house NetSuite expert and take ownership of our NetSuite OneWorld environment across multiple legal entities.

This role requires hands-on implementation experience, a solid understanding of finance processes, and the ability to independently turn business requirements into a robust system design.

You will work closely with the Finance team, shaping and developing the system, supporting integrations, and helping users get the most out of NetSuite.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Full NetSuite OneWorld configuration, administration, and technical support.
  • End-to-end configuration and support of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes: Purchase Orders, receiving, Vendor Bills, billing, and payments.
  • Design and configuration of PO, Vendor Bill, payment, and other approval workflows and routing, including multi-level approval matrices.
  • Configuration and support of AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, intercompany transactions, multi-currency, and consolidation processes.
  • Design and maintenance of SuiteFlow workflows, automated notifications, approval rules, and escalation processes.
  • Configuration of subsidiaries, departments, locations, users, roles, permissions, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
  • Configuration and customization of forms, fields, records, system settings, Saved Searches, reports, and dashboards.
  • Configuration and support of banking, payment, tax, and third-party integrations.
  • Support of APIs, CSV imports, mass updates, master data, and data migration.
  • Sandbox management, UAT, testing, and deployment of configuration changes to Production.
  • Full Level 1–3 technical support and troubleshooting, including workflow, billing, posting, access, integration, and system issues.
  • Root-cause analysis and implementation of permanent solutions for recurring issues.
  • Continuous system optimization, automation, and improvement of Finance processes.
  • Maintenance of system documentation, configuration records, and user instructions.
  • Coordination with Oracle NetSuite Support and external developers/consultants where required.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience as a NetSuite Administrator, Functional Consultant, or Technical/Functional Specialist.
  • Strong practical experience with NetSuite OneWorld and multi-entity / multi-subsidiary environments.
  • Proven experience in end-to-end NetSuite configuration, not limited to first-line user support.
  • Strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes and PO-to-Payment workflows.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SuiteFlow, approval workflows, and payment routes.
  • Good understanding of Finance processes, including AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, intercompany, multi-currency, and consolidation.
  • Experience with custom forms, fields, records, roles, permissions, Saved Searches, reports, and dashboards.
  • Experience with NetSuite integrations, APIs, CSV imports, mass updates, and data migration.
  • Experience with Sandbox, UAT, testing, and Production deployment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently translate Finance and business requirements into NetSuite configuration and system design.
  • Experience supporting international Finance teams and complex group structures is highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of SuiteScript is an advantage.
  • NetSuite Administrator / SuiteFoundation certification is an advantage.
  • Strong English communication skills.

  • Learning support - courses, English classes, and conferences (up to 100% reimbursement)
  • Unique loyalty program - receive corporate digital miners and earn passive income with no investment
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days + 8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • New career tracks - real opportunities to grow into expert or top management roles
