Why Us

Now is your moment to make a difference in the lives of the underserved.

If there is one unifying characteristic of everyone on our team, it is the deep desire to make a difference by helping society's most vulnerable and often overlooked individuals. Every day we have the distinct honor and responsibility to show up with non-judgmental compassion to provide hope and healing to those who need it most. For those whose calling it is to serve others, now is your moment to join our mission to provide quality care to every patient with compassion, collaboration, and innovation, to live our mantra to “Always Do The Right Thing!”, and to collectively do our part to heal the world, one patient at a time.

Wellpath sees hundreds of thousands of unique individuals in their facilities month over month and a very large percent of those individuals receive direct clinical care, which includes lives saved by Narcan.

We offer ongoing training and development opportunities for licensed and unlicensed healthcare team members, and have best in class clinical resources for training, education, and point of care support.

How you make a difference

The LVN Travel supports the delivery of patient care within assigned correctional healthcare settings as part of a traveling team. This role assists with assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of care under the supervision of Registered Nurses. The position guides patient teaching and clinical activities based on demonstrated competencies and scope of practice. This role adapts to different clinical environments while supporting safe, compliant, and consistent care delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with patient assessment, care planning, and implementation of individualized treatment programs under RN supervision.
  • Administer medications, obtain diagnostic tests, and carry out medical plans according to practitioner orders and protocols.
  • Provide clinical care and respond to health emergencies using established procedures, safety techniques, and standard precautions.
  • Document nursing encounters and communicate patient information to healthcare providers and staff.
  • Support daily clinical operations, including controlled substance counts and assisting with procedures as needed.

Additional Details

Travel LVN opportunities with Wellpath are primarily based in California, with current needs at sites such as Shasta, Placer, San Luis Obispo, and Fresno. Assignments can vary by location, but most shifts are 12-hour days or nights, with some 8-hour options and weekend rotations depending on the site. Candidates must hold an active California nursing license in good standing and have at least three years of nursing experience; correctional experience is preferred but not required. Overall, this role is best suited for nurses who are adaptable, team-oriented, and comfortable stepping into diverse correctional environments to support patient care where it’s needed most. Pay Range: Pay is based on experience. LVN's range from $40-45 per hour and RN's range from: $55-63 per hour

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

  • Graduate from an accredited School of Nursing

Experience

  • One (1) or more years clinic experience required
  • Must be willing and able to travel 100% of the time.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Current licensure as a Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) within the states of practice
  • Current CPR certification

This position is available only to those who reside in the United States.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

We value the contributions of team members with a broad range of experiences, skills, and perspectives and are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all.

We encourage you to apply! If you are excited about a role but your experience doesn’t seem to align perfectly with every element of the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or one of our many other roles.

title: Product Designer
description:
About AuthorClimb

AuthorClimb is the growth desk for self-published authors. We give KDP authors one toolkit to grow their books on Amazon: keyword rank tracking, sales analytics, listing optimization, A+ Content design, category research, and reader review distribution. We're a small, remote-first team headquartered in the Boston area, building for authors who treat their books like a business.

The role

You'll own design across both of AuthorClimb's surfaces: a typography-led, literary marketing site that refuses to look like every other SaaS template, and a data-dense product dashboard where authors track rankings, sales, and reviews. The brand is committed and specific (one house color, bold type, real product views over abstract illustration) and your job is to deepen it, not dilute it. You'll be the only designer, working directly with the founder and engineering, and your decisions will reach production within days.

What you'll do

  • Own product design end to end: problem framing, flows, UI, and final polish

  • Maintain and evolve the design system across the marketing site and the signed-in product

  • Design data-heavy dashboard views (rank charts, sales analytics, review tracking) that stay legible under real-world data

  • Design marketing pages, landing pages, and campaign creative that hold a strong typographic line

  • Work hand-in-hand with engineering: specs and prototypes that translate cleanly to Tailwind-based implementation

  • Hold the accessibility bar: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, reduced-motion paths, and interfaces that work for everyone

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of product design experience with a portfolio that shows shipped work, not just concepts

  • Exceptional typographic and visual craft. Our brand lives or dies on type, hierarchy, and restraint

  • Experience designing dashboards or other data-dense interfaces, including the empty, loading, and overflowing states

  • Systems thinking: you build reusable patterns and know when to break them

  • Comfortable as a team of one: you scope your own work, seek feedback early, and ship without a design org around you

Nice to have

  • Front-end literacy (HTML, CSS, Tailwind) or the ability to fine-tune your own designs in code

  • Brand or editorial design background

  • Motion design used sparingly and well

Compensation & benefits

  • $115,000–$145,000 base salary, depending on experience

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible PTO plus company holidays

  • $1,000 home-office setup budget

  • An annual book stipend, naturally

How we work

We're fully remote across the US, with a home base in the Boston area. The team is small, communication is mostly written and async, and there's no layer between you and the founder. Work ships quickly and gets in front of real authors the same week.

Equal opportunity

AuthorClimb is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

How to apply

Apply through the form on this page. No cover letter required; include your portfolio, and call out one project where you can walk us through the decisions, not just the outcome.

The A's are a baseball team founded in 1901. They have a rich history, having won nine World Series championships and 15 American League pennants. In addition to their success on the field, the A's also have a positive and dynamic work culture. They have been recognized twice as the Front Office Sports, Best Employers in Sports.

This includes sporting events, concerts, corporate functions, private events, and community activities. The role ensures exceptional guest experiences and operational excellence while maintaining safety, compliance, and brand standards.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there.   • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.

title: Product Manager - Industrial Solutions
description:
Product Manager, Industrial Solutions

Job Term: Full-Time

The Opportunity

Picarro is looking for a product-minded builder to join our Industrial Solutions team as a Product Manager. You will define what gets built, why it matters, and how it works. You will own outcomes, not just a backlog.

You will own features end-to-end and shape the roadmap within Picarro’s fastest-growing verticals: continuous fenceline monitoring for chemical manufacturing compliance and industrial workplace monitoring for occupational safety. Both are grounded in the Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) measurement science that makes Picarro instruments the gold standard in precision gas analysis.

You will work across the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, requirements, prototyping, launch, and iteration. The products you ship will directly help companies meet complex environmental and safety obligations. That is the mission.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Set priorities and shape the Industrial Solutions roadmap, balancing near-term customer needs and compliance deadlines with longer-term platform investments. Own features end-to-end, from concept to launch to continuous improvement, and be accountable for the results.

Prototyping & Requirements

Translate customer insights and market needs into crisp, actionable requirements: MRDs, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Build low- and high-fidelity prototypes to test ideas early, gather feedback, and de-risk development before engineering investment scales up.

Customer & Market Discovery

Conduct structured customer interviews, synthesize field data, and maintain a current view of EPA rulemaking, OSHA requirements, and emerging monitoring technologies. Use what you learn to make confident prioritization decisions, even with incomplete information.

Cross-Functional Execution

Serve as the product owner in Agile sprint cycles (planning, backlog grooming, story review, and retrospectives). Partner closely with R&D, engineering, data science, QA, and field teams. Make the tradeoff calls, remove blockers, and keep delivery on track and on spec.

Go-To-Market & Commercial Enablement

Own product positioning, sales enablement materials, and competitive intelligence for your features. Partner with marketing and sales on launch planning and support pre-sales technical discussions with key accounts.

Performance & Iteration

Define success metrics before you build. Track performance post-launch, report results to leadership, and drive a continuous loop of feedback, data, and iteration.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of product management or equivalent experience with direct product ownership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to write sharp requirements and prototype ideas. You close the gap between discovery and delivery.
  • AI-forward mindset with hands-on experience applying AI tools, LLMs, or automation to real product problems.
  • Experience working within Agile/scrum development as a product owner.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Figma, or similar product and design tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to technical and non-technical audiences alike, and able to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% for customer visits, conferences, and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of building and shipping products or features independently, including personal projects, open-source contributions, or internal tools that went beyond your core job responsibilities.
  • Familiarity with EPA continuous fenceline monitoring requirements (such as the HON Rule) or comparable environmental/occupational safety regulatory frameworks.
  • Background in environmental science, chemistry, chemical engineering, or industrial operations, or knowledge of methane leak detection, emissions monitoring, air quality, or precision gas measurement.
  • Experience with cloud-based SaaS or data analytics products for industrial or environmental applications.
  • Proficiency with product analytics tools (Pendo, Amplitude, PostHog, or similar).
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120K to $140K. Our total compensation packages include base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity. Your base salary range and title will be determined based on the location, experience, qualification, skills, knowledge, level, and pay of employees in similar positions.

We offer a comprehensive benefit package including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans
  • Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Employee Referral Program
  • 401K
  • Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)
  • On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

About Picarro:

We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, ecology, and more. Our software and hardware are designed and manufactured in Santa Clara, California and are used in over 90 countries worldwide based on over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology and are unparalleled in their precision, ease of use, and reliability.

JÄRPENS HÄLSOCENTRAL  ligger centralt i Åre kommun. Det betyder att vi är mitt i ett spännande närvårdsområde med varierande vårdbehov, fjäll och natur runt hörnet och en unik arbetsplats. Vi tillhör glesbygd och det medför ett varierande arbete där dagarna kan se olika ut. På hälsocentralen jobbar du tillsammans med cirka 35 medarbetare i olika professioner. Läkargruppen består av 4 specialister, 4 ST-läkare och därtill AT-läkare. Vi har cirka 4500 listade patienter och två enhetschefer i samledarskap. Vi håller högt i tak och värdesätter medarbetarnas tankar och idéer, både kring arbetssätt och sin egen arbetsmiljö med medarbetarnas och patienternas bästa som grund. VI har en god kollegialitet och värdesätter de små sakerna som att äta gemensam lunch, frivilliga personalaktiviteter och annat trevligt som förgyller gemenskapen.

Professioner på hälsocentralen består av läkare, distriktssköterskor, undersköterskor, BVC, MVC, kuratorer och psykologer, dietist, diabetessköterska, fysioterapeuter, arbetsterapeut, rehabkoordinator, fotvårdare, medicinska sekreterare, ekonomiassistent, administrativa assistenter och lokalvårdare. Alla våra professioner bidrar till vår teamkänsla och vi håller alltid öppna dörrar och högt i tak.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
För att ta hand om våra patienter på bästa sätt jobbar vi med separat akutvårdsspår, planerad mottagning, stor tillgänglighet och teambaserad vård i form av Utvidgad primärvård. Vi är öppna för att prova nya arbetssätt och göra förändringar men ser till att genomföra det med tydligt mål och under kontrollerade former.

Hos oss får du gott stöd av kollegor men också möjlighet att ta plats där du känner att du vill tillföra något extra. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att utbilda nya kollegor på arbetsplatsen och du kommer därför vara en del i handledning och undervisning av blivande kollegor. Självklart har du avsatt tid för detta i ditt schema. Vi är måna om att erbjuda individuella lösningar i hur arbetet läggs upp så att du får ut det mesta av både jobb och fritid. I uppdraget ingår jour och beredskap på kvällar och helger i samarbete med våra grannar Åre och Hallens hälsocentraler. Vi samarbetar även i andra frågor och delar viss bemanning mellan hälsocentralerna. Vår hälsocentral ansvarar för läkarkompetens till närliggande särskilda boenden, hemsjukvård och LSS.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har specialistkompetens i allmänmedicin med svensk legitimation. Du har svenska språkkunskaper motsvarande minst nivå C1 enligt Europarådets nivåskala. Vi ser gärna att du har intresse för kunskap och erfarenhet av glesbygdsmedicin. Du är professionell, initiativrik och öppen. Du har en förmåga att  jobba självständigt men fungerar också bra i ett team samt har ett gott bemötande mot både kollegor och patienter.  Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

I Region Jämtland Härjedalen genomsyras vårt arbete av våra kärnvärden: vi skapar värde för de vi är till för, agerar med handlingskraft och strävar efter att alltid upplevas som pålitliga. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en organisation där dessa värden präglar vardagen och där ditt arbete verkligen gör skillnad. 

Som medarbetare får du tillgång till ett brett utbud av förmåner via vår förmånsportal. Vi värnar om din hälsa och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdstimme. På Östersunds sjukhus kan du dessutom träna gratis på gymmet Zefyren och delta i ledarledda pass.  

Urval och tillsättning kan ske löpande under annonseringstiden, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. 

Vi har ett etablerat medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Software Engineer III, DB/Data Assurance
description:
We are seeking an experienced data engineer to join our team! OTECH produces and maintains unique underwater systems – typically for US Navy and other US Government Department of War customers. Our projects are all one-of-a-kind. Projects range from quick burn to lifecycle management of fielded systems. As a data engineer at Oceaneering Technologies (OTECH), you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing data storage systems.

The data engineer will support multiple stakeholders across the project, including software developers, systems engineers, integrated logistics support team members, project managers. The ideal candidate should process strong technical abilities to solve complex data problems, a willingness to learn new technologies/tools, and be comfortable articulating data concepts to stakeholders of varying levels of data proficiency.

This role is responsible for ensuring that database systems and the data flowing through them are accurate, consistent, secure, traceable, and reliable throughout the application lifecycle. The role combines database development with data-quality and verification responsibilities. Typical work includes designing and maintaining relational database schemas, stored procedures, queries, data interfaces, ETL/ELT processes, and validation routines; verifying data integrity across system boundaries; identifying anomalous, incomplete, duplicated, or inconsistent data; and developing automated checks that confirm data conforms to defined schemas, business rules, interface specifications, and quality requirements. The developer should be proficient with DDS, SQL, and database technologies such as PostgreSQL, MariaDB/MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle, along with scripting or development languages such as Python, Java, or C++. Experience with data modeling, schema/version management, transaction processing, indexing, query optimization, and structured data formats such as JSON, XML, or Avro is also valuable.

The assurance portion of the role requires strong knowledge of data verification, validation, provenance, and configuration control. The developer should be able to establish measurable data-quality criteria, implement automated integrity and regression tests, reconcile data between producers and consumers, and provide evidence that stored or transmitted data remains complete and correct. This includes supporting requirements traceability, test automation, logging/auditing, cybersecurity controls, backup and recovery, and root-cause analysis of data-related defects. In a distributed or mission-oriented system, the role may also involve validating data exchanged through messaging middleware, APIs, DDS/Kafka interfaces, containers, and other distributed services. The ideal candidate combines software-development discipline with a verification mindset—understanding not only how to store and transform data, but how to demonstrate that the resulting data can be trusted.

  • Design, build, and maintain batch data pipelines and ingestion workflows.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain cloud‑enabled data infrastructure and storage solutions.
  • Implement ETL/ELT processes to extract, transform, validate, and load data from multiple sources.
  • Automate data workflows for ingestion, transformation, aggregation, and quality enforcement.
  • Build, maintain, and deploy data products and analytics solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., Azure).
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to create dashboards and visualization tools.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, traceability, and security across all systems and interfaces.
  • Implement validation routines, anomaly detection, and automated integrity checks.
  • Support data modeling, schema design, DDS topic development, and database architecture.
  • Monitor system performance and implement optimization strategies for reliability and efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain data compression and storage‑optimization strategies.
  • Contribute to data management CDRL materials and documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non‑technical team members.
  • Support verification, configuration control, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Provide feedback on software and data design choices and integration approaches.

Essential Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related field (or commensurate experience).
  • 5+ years of practical data engineering experience.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency and experience with relational database design.
  • Experience with data ingestion tools and building ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of cloud solutions and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools.
  • Strong problem‑solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW security clearance.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses and large‑scale data systems.
  • Experience with Linux and scripting languages.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, C++, C#, or related languages.
  • Experience with Jira, Git, or similar tools.
  • Experience with NoSQL systems (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j).
  • Experience working with large datasets and distributed data environments.
  • Experience with MBSE/Digital Twin tools (Cameo, Syndeia, PLM/ERP).
  • Familiarity with DDS middleware and distributed messaging systems.
  • Knowledge of data verification, provenance, configuration control, and automated QA/QC.

Additional

Additional duties as assigned.

title: Traffic Project Manager
description:
Transportation Practice

Consistently ranked by Engineering News-Record as a Top 20 transportation firm, Michael Baker International offers clients an integrated team of professionals versed in all aspects of transportation planning, design, permitting, and construction management and inspection. In addition, Michael Baker International is a recognized leader in the practical aspects of operating and maintaining a safe and efficient transportation infrastructure.

What We're Looking For:

Michael Baker International is seeking an experienced Traffic Project Manager to join our growing Transportation team. This position can be based in Tallahassee, Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville, or Panama City, Florida.

Working closely with our Florida and Southeast Transportation leadership teams, the Traffic Project Manager will lead the planning, design, and delivery of traffic engineering projects for FDOT and local agency clients throughout Florida and the Southeast. This leadership role will be responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing project execution, developing staff, and supporting business development efforts to expand Michael Baker's traffic engineering practice.

Our work includes roadway design and rehabilitation, Complete Streets and Active Transportation projects, ADA improvements, traffic operations studies, signing and pavement markings, traffic signals, roadway lighting, and other transportation infrastructure improvements.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with proven project management, team leadership, and client development skills.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage and deliver traffic engineering projects from pursuit through final design and construction support.

  • Serve as Project Manager for FDOT and local agency transportation projects, ensuring successful delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.

  • Lead multidisciplinary project teams, providing technical guidance, project direction, and mentorship to engineers and design staff.

  • Develop engineering designs and oversee the preparation of preliminary and final plan sets using MicroStation and other design tools.

  • Coordinate with roadway, drainage, structures, planning, and environmental teams to ensure integrated project delivery.

  • Manage project budgets, staffing plans, schedules, and resource allocations.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.

  • Support business development initiatives, including identifying opportunities, developing pursuit strategies, and preparing technical proposals and presentations.

  • Lead and participate in client meetings, industry events, and professional organizations to strengthen Michael Baker's presence in Florida.

  • Contribute to sales and growth objectives by helping secure new work with FDOT, municipalities, counties, and other transportation agencies.

  • Assist with contract negotiations, scope development, and fee proposals.

  • Review plans, specifications, and technical documents to ensure compliance with client requirements, industry standards, and company quality expectations.

  • Provide oversight of design technicians and junior engineers to ensure accurate and timely project deliverables.

  • May function as a seller-doer, balancing project delivery responsibilities with client development and revenue growth efforts.

  • Support staff development through coaching, mentoring, performance feedback, and career growth planning.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in Florida required.

  • 8+ years of traffic engineering and transportation design experience.

  • Proven experience managing FDOT and local agency transportation projects.

  • Demonstrated success managing project schedules, budgets, and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience developing and maintaining client relationships and supporting business development activities.

  • Track record of pursuing, winning, and successfully delivering transportation projects.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and team-building skills.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

  • Experience with MicroStation required; familiarity with Civil 3D is a plus.

  • Knowledge of FDOT criteria, standards, and project delivery processes preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Established relationships with FDOT districts, municipalities, counties, and transportation agencies throughout Florida.

  • Experience leading proposal pursuits and capture strategies.

  • Previous supervisory or team management experience.

  • Active participation in professional organizations such as ITE, ASCE, or FES.

Compensation:

The approximate compensation range for this position is $120,000 to $170,000 per year. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

Why Choose Us:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability

title: Lead Night Crew
description:

Reports incidents requiring discipline to the Grocery Manager and Store Director. Communicates with the Grocery Manager and Store Director on night crew activities. Trains and supervises associates in all night crew activities, policies and procedures. Supervises total store on the night crew as directed by the Store Director.

  • Assists the Grocery Manager in planning, organizing regular and seasonal merchandise requirements and special sales needs.

  • Ensures cost, quality and inventory level through verifying orders against invoices, auditing contents of product cases and completing necessary forms and reports accurately.

  • Implements Company and Division operating and merchandising policies and practices. Controls shrink. Prevents damage and sale of unsafe or out of code products. Assists in the reclamation process.

  • Encourages and maintains an atmosphere of enthusiastic customer awareness with an emphasis on fast, friendly, courteous customer service. Handles positive vendor relations.

  • Knowledge and ability to implement emergency procedures in the event of equipment and computer software malfunctions.

  • Must comply with Company policies including grooming standards and dress code.

Work Environment:

  • Exposure to cleaning chemicals.

  • May occasionally be exposed to temperatures of 28˚ Fahrenheit while handling products in a cooler and approximately -20˚ Fahrenheit in a freezer.

Job responsibilities include tasks or duties that could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Engine & Tools - League of Legends
description:
Riot’s mission is to put players at the center of everything we do. We do this by continuing to evolve and deliver new experiences to players with games like Teamfight Tactics, Legends of Runeterra, VALORANT, and League of Legends: Wild Rift. Riot is also expanding into the world of music/multimedia with the release of our animated series Arcane and music from KDA and True Damage. In short - it’s an exciting time to be a Rioter.

As a Principal Software Engineer in League of Legends, you’ll report to your team’s Engineering Manager in our office in Los Angeles. You will drive the architecture and evolution of League’s core game engine, improving the foundational systems and tools used to develop League. You’ll solve complex technical challenges across these systems, improving their reliability, scalability, and performance while reducing iteration time and workflow friction for developers across League.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain software systems with a focus on quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Accelerate the development of the core engine architecture and developer experience.
  • Uphold a high standard of engineering excellence. Participate in code reviews, write unit/integration tests, and contribute to continuous improvement of team practices.
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, producers, and other engineers to understand their workflows, scope, implement, and test features.
  • Write clear documentation and communicate technical details across disciplines.
  • Provide mentorship to junior and senior engineers across the League team.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to resolve live incidents.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of game, game engine and tools development experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience in C++
  • Deep subject matter expertise in building and architecting tools and engine features
  • Experience shipping software at scale that deploys on a range of different platforms
  • Experience collaborating across disciplines (e.g. Design, Art, QA, Production) to create solutions
  • Experience implementing software engineering best practices within your team, including design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, tools improvements, source control management, build processes, and testing
  • Experience applying AI to software development workflows, including using or integrating AI-powered tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality
  • Product sense, pragmatism, and player empathy in making tech decisions
  • BS in Computer Science, or proven understanding of Computer Science fundamentals

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience playing League of Legends
  • Strong interest in AI and its potential to improve game development workflows

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about the experiences of players, this could be the role for you!

We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. title: Field Water Treatment Supervisor
description:
HPC-Industrial, powered by Clean Harbors, is looking for a Field Water Treatment Supervisor to work at a customer location and join our safety-conscious team.

This team member is responsible for the full operational lifecycle and crew management of water treatment equipment, including bag, sand, media, and resin filtration, as well as other treatment methods.

This is a highly mobile, field-based role requiring extensive travel (90% or more) to client and project sites. The Field Water Treatment Supervisor serves as the subject matter expert for system planning, installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and repair. This individual also contributes to organizational knowledge through training and best-practice development while representing HPC-Industrial and building continuous working relationships with clients and customers.

Why Work for HPC-Industrial?

  • Health and safety are our #1 priority, and we live it 3-6-5!
  • Competitive wages.
  • Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment.
  • Group 401(k) with company matching.
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (U.S. only), allowing you to own part of Clean Harbors.
  • Generous paid time off, company-paid training, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Positive and safe work environments.
  • Opportunities for growth and development at every stage of your career.

Planning, Installation, and Commissioning

  • Lead site assessments and develop installation plans for mobile water treatment equipment.
  • Execute equipment installation in accordance with project specifications and engineering drawings.
  • Commission systems and verify performance against target water quality parameters before handoff.

  • Coordinate with project managers, site contacts, and logistics teams to ensure on-schedule deployment.

System Operation and Monitoring

  • Operate high-purity water treatment systems during assigned project periods.
  • Monitor water chemistry parameters, including total dissolved solids (TDS), pH, and flow rates.
  • Adjust system controls and chemical dosing to maintain product water quality within specified limits.

  • Identify and respond promptly to process deviations or alarm conditions.

Troubleshooting and Field Repair

  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and process-related system failures in a field setting.
  • Execute repairs and component replacements using available tools and spare parts.
  • Escalate issues beyond field repair capabilities to engineering or OEM support, providing detailed documentation.

  • Minimize system downtime through rapid, methodical fault isolation.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance tasks according to manufacturer guidelines and internal preventive maintenance schedules.
  • Document all maintenance activities, parts used, and findings in the maintenance management system.
  • Track equipment service intervals and proactively identify upcoming maintenance needs.

  • Maintain the cleanliness and serviceability of all equipment in the field.

Data Collection and Reporting

  • Record operational data, including system performance metrics and water chemistry results, at defined intervals.
  • Maintain accurate, legible field logs and submit reports to operations management regularly.

  • Flag out-of-specification conditions and document corrective actions taken.

Training and Knowledge Transfer

  • Train site personnel, client operators, and junior technicians in water treatment operations.
  • Develop and deliver practical, hands-on instruction covering system operation, water chemistry, and safety procedures.
  • Assess trainee competency and provide constructive feedback.

  • Create or update training materials and standard operating procedures (SOPs) as needed.

Best Practices and Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of operational best practices based on field experience and performance data.
  • Participate in periodic technical reviews and recommend process improvements.

  • Share lessons learned across the field team to improve overall operational standards.

Required Technical Qualifications

  • At least two years of hands-on experience operating or maintaining water treatment systems, including solids removal, media filtration, resin filtration, reverse osmosis (RO), deionization (DI), or similar systems.
  • Working knowledge of water chemistry principles and water quality standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and repair mechanical and process systems in a field environment.
  • Strong documentation habits and attention to data accuracy.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 90% or more, including extended deployments.

What Does It Take to Work at HPC-Industrial?

  • A minimum of five years of experience in the industrial cleaning industry. Prior supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Specific vocational preparation, including classroom safety training, on-the-job training, and essential experience gained through previous employment.
  • English language proficiency sufficient to understand safety training and respond to instructions during emergency situations.
  • Compliance with the company's driving policy when operating a company vehicle or using a personal vehicle for company business.
  • OSHA certification, if required for the position.
  • Knowledge of emergency equipment operation, including fire extinguishers.

title: Senior Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement
description:
Senior Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement

Global | Permanent

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will lead the Operations data, reporting and platform agenda for Private Assets — setting requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, and delivering alongside them.

  • Own the Operations view of the data and reporting roadmap, including data quality, lineage, ownership and reporting capability.

  • Set out Operations’ requirements with IT and the Transformation Office, then deliver alongside them rather than handing over.

  • Lead platform enablement work — ensuring platform change is specified, tested and adopted with Operations in the room throughout.

  • Establish reporting standards and reusable data products rather than one-off extracts.

  • Provide the data and evidence base that other focus areas rely on to quantify a problem and measure a benefit.

  • Coordinate across Operations, IT, the Transformation Office, Tactical Operations and Data Services.

  • Lead and mentor focus area resources, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Report on progress, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to the relevant leader and senior stakeholders.

About You

You have 12–15 years’ experience in private assets or a comparable financial services environment, with substantial exposure to data and platform initiatives.

  • Proven delivery of data, reporting or platform programmes, including requirements definition and UAT ownership.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets accounting and operations, and of the data those processes produce and consume.

  • Practical understanding of data models, lineage, controls and reporting architecture.

  • Credibility with technology partners — able to challenge a design and hold a delivery date.

  • Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

description:
Om jobbet:

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper 37 t/u til en fast stilling med start den 01.11.26 eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

I vuggestuen arbejder vi ud fra dagtilbudsloven og B&U politikken. Du vil blive en del af et stort læringsfællesskab og en faglig dygtig og stabil personalegruppe, hvor vi er sammen om at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for børns udvikling, læring og trivsel. Vi forventer, at du vil kunne bidrage aktivt til opgaven, og sammen med dine kollegaer støtte og hjælpe børnene i at få deltagelsesmuligheder ind i de forskellige børnefællesskaber. Vi forventer du vil kunne bidrage aktivt til løsningen af kerneopgaven – blandt andet via samarbejde med kollegaer, samarbejde med forældre, aktiv deltagelse i dagligdagen og på møder, samt gennem en engageret og imødekommende tilgang til børnene


Din profil:

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper der:

Er imødekommende, smilende, ansvarlig og fleksibel.

Har lyst til at indgå i et samarbejde med forældre og kollegaer omkring børnenes trivsel og udvikling.

Er omstillingsparat og loyal ift. fælles beslutninger.

Er nærværende og følelsesmæssigt tilgængelig. Du tager ansvar for relations arbejdet og kontakter barnet med omsorg og empati.

Er initiativrig og kreativ og at du har blik for og lyst til at følge børnenes spor.

Kan lide at være både ude og inde i al slags vejr.

Tager medansvar for et godt arbejdsmiljø.


Derfor skal du vælge os:
Du vil blive en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi stiller høje faglige krav til os selv i løsningen af kerneopgaven. Vi har ambitioner på alle børns vegne. Vi har et omsorgsfuldt og lærende miljø med nærværende voksne, der er engagerede og reflekterende. Du vil få et godt arbejdsmiljø, som du skal tage medansvar i, og en arbejdsplads hvor der er fokus på udvikling, ærlighed, humor og respekt.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Ansættelsen er en fuldtidsstilling med en gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer. Vi kunne ønske os at du kunne starte d.01.11.26 eller snarest herefter. Der afholdes samtaler løbende.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås hos Pædagogisk leder Kristina Blegholm Foldager mail: fkb@aarhus.dk eller tlf: 40171512


Ansøgning:
Klik på linket ”SØG JOB” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest klokken 24:00 den 27.10.26. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os:
Vuggestuen Jægergårdsgade er en vuggestue med 48-52 børn, 13 pædagogiske medarbejdere, en køkkenleder, ungarbejder og en pædagogisk leder, vi er placeret på Frederiksbjerg i Aarhus C. Vi er en del af Frederiksbjerg Dagtilbud, som i alt består af 8 afdelinger. Vores børn er fordelt på 4 stuer, med børn fra ca. 9 mdr. til 3 år.

title: Trading Coach - WFH - Up to 40k with commission
description:
We are looking for a Coach in Trading

Job Title: Trader Coach
﻿Set up: WFH
﻿﻿Monthly Salary: PHP40,000 per month with commission
﻿Workday: Monday to Friday, Shifting schedule

Job Description:

Position Overview:

A Trader Coach is responsible for providing guidance, support, and mentorship to individuals or teams of traders to enhance their trading skills, develop effective strategies, and manage risk in financial markets. Trader Coaches help traders improve their decision-making abilities, emotional resilience, and overall performance in various trading environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Mentorship and Training: Provide one-on-one or group coaching sessions to traders, helping them understand trading principles, technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and trading psychology. Assist in the development of personalized trading plans.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate traders' performance by analyzing their trading history, risk management practices, and overall strategies. Identify areas for improvement and develop action plans to address weaknesses.
  • Risk Management: Educate traders on effective risk management techniques, including position sizing, stop-loss orders, and portfolio diversification, to minimize losses and protect capital.
  • Trading Psychology: Address traders' emotional challenges such as fear, greed, and overtrading. Teach strategies to maintain discipline and emotional stability during market fluctuations.
  • Market Research: Stay up to date with market developments, news, and trends to provide traders with relevant information and insights. Share market analysis and potential trading opportunities.
  • Strategy Development: Collaborate with traders to design and refine trading strategies tailored to their risk tolerance, goals, and preferred asset classes (e.g., stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, commodities).
  • Technical Analysis: Teach traders how to use technical indicators, charts, and patterns to make informed trading decisions. Help traders spot potential entry and exit points.
  • Record Keeping: Encourage traders to maintain meticulous records of their trades, including entry and exit points, profit and loss figures, and trade commentary. Analyze these records for continuous improvement.
  • Compliance and Regulation: Ensure that traders are aware of and comply with relevant financial regulations and exchange rules to maintain ethical and legal trading practices.
  • Feedback and Support: Provide constructive feedback and support to traders on an ongoing basis. Encourage open communication and a growth-oriented mindset.
  • Goal Setting: Assist traders in setting realistic and achievable trading goals. Monitor progress toward these goals and adjust strategies as needed.
  • Education and Skill Development: Stay updated with industry best practices, trading technologies, and educational resources. Share knowledge with traders to enhance their skills.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a successful trader, preferably in various financial markets.
  • Strong knowledge of technical and fundamental analysis.
  • Excellent understanding of risk management principles.
  • Proficiency in trading platforms and software.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Patience, empathy, and the ability to motivate and inspire traders.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with trading regulations and compliance.
  • Continuous learning mindset to keep up with evolving market trends.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Chartered Market Technician, Certified Financial Technician) may be advantageous.
  • A Trader Coach plays a crucial role in helping traders achieve their financial goals while minimizing risks. This position requires a deep understanding of trading principles, psychological factors, and market dynamics to guide traders toward success

title: Controls Technician
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

CONTROLS TECHNICIAN

The controls technician supports building and maintaining our data and control systems. These systems include different data collection and control hardware, wiring, interface harnesses, and many types of sensors. The goal of the data and control systems team is to meet test needs for safe, low-cost, and reliable access to space.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform complex technical assignments involving instrumentation and data acquisition/processing systems
  • Maintain, calibrate, configure, monitor, test, troubleshoot, install, and repair instrumentation, process controls, data acquisition systems, and electrical systems
  • Investigate, diagnose, correct, and document instrumentation or system malfunctions
  • Analyze results of calibrations and processed data, and assist in the interpretation of test data
  • Adjust, repair, or replace faulty components of test setups and equipment
  • Lay out, build, test, troubleshoot, repair, and modify developmental and production electrical and electronic units, assemblies, components, parts, equipment, and systems
  • Configure the data acquisition hardware
  • Perform wire terminations to a variety of instruments and verify sensor health: pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, limits, and flow meters
  • Install connectors, connector pins, terminals, and lugs
  • Perform continuity checks, locate and correct wiring errors using measuring instruments such as ohmmeters and sequential continuity checkers
  • Adjust, calibrate, align, and modify circuitry and components, and record effects on unit performance
  • Read and interpret planning documents, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, drawings, manuals, blueprints, and engineering sketches
  • Perform layout and wiring of electrical panels
  • Collaborate with design engineers to troubleshoot failures and issues derived from test data
  • Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate degree in instrumentation, control technology, electrical systems, or other electrical field (3+ years of professional experience working with controls or electrical systems will be considered in lieu of a degree)
  • 2+ years of experience working with instrumentation such as pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, flow meters, multimeters, or oscilloscopes

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working with any of the following instrumentation: resistance temperature devices (RTDs), silicon diode temperature devices, strain gauges, load cells, displacement transducers, pressure transducers, thermocouple, and flow meters (turbine, coriolis, and ultrasonic)
  • Basic knowledge of Wheatstone bridge theory, ability to apply Ohm's law, and an understanding of direct current (DC) electronics
  • Operational knowledge of an oscilloscope and multi-meter, soldering wires and connectors, operation of various crimping tools, wire stripping, continuity testing, pinning out a military type connector, routing and tie wrapping cables, drilling and tapping holes, and building junction boxes
  • System-level troubleshooting skills and the ability to logically solve instrumentation system problems and determine corrective action
  • Experience with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and motor starters, and knowledge in troubleshooting
  • Knowledge in signal conditioning concepts for various types of sensors, to include the following: thermocouple Types K, S, and E; TC bonding concepts: resistance weld on and adhesive bond on types; TC probes through thermowell sheaths; cold junction compensation concepts
  • Background should include experience with the following devices: DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) installations, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts
  • Working knowledge of transducers, operational amplifiers, and the knowledge of measurement techniques for temperature, pressure, flow, displacement, vibration, and the application of strain gauges is also highly desired. Ability to identify required data, data acquisition plans, and test parameters, and set up equipment to conform to these specifications
  • Working knowledge of multiple bus architectures (Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI)/Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe), PCI eXtensions for Instrumentation (PXI)/PXI Express (PXIe), General Purpose Interface Bus (GPIB), Serial, Universal Serial Bus (USB), etc.) and data communication technologies
  • Demonstrated capabilities in the development of comprehensive project plans that include all tasks, stage/gate milestones, and reviews necessary to successfully develop and implement solutions
  • Intermediate skill level using Windows Operating Systems
  • Intermediate skill level using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, OneNote)
  • Knowledge in data acquisition concepts, hardware, and interfacing (Signal Conditioning eXtensions for Instrumentation (SCXI) and PCI eXtensions for Instrumentation (PXI) based)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain
  • Must be available for overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required
  • Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise
  • Stand: Up to 10 hours per day
  • Sit: Up to 10 hours per day
  • Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day
  • Overhead reach: Up to 10 hours per day
  • Walk: Up to 10 hours per day
  • Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day
  • Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day
  • Kneel/Crouch: Up to 10 hours per day
  • Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day
  • Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day
  • Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Deputy Director, AI Development (Tech Strategy & Architecture) (3-year Contract)
description:
What the role is

Artificial intelligence is creating new opportunities to enhance productivity, strengthen risk management and enable new forms of financial services. To support the responsible adoption of AI across the financial sector, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) works with financial institutions, AI firms, FinTechs, technology providers, academia and public-sector partners to develop the capabilities, partnerships and enabling frameworks needed to translate advances in AI into meaningful industry outcomes.

Within MAS, the Financial Infrastructure & Artificial Intelligence Office (FIA) leads initiatives that strengthen the foundations for AI innovation in financial services. This includes ecosystem development, strategic partnerships, data and digital infrastructure, industry capability building, and national-level initiatives that support the safe, trusted and effective use of AI across the financial sector.

What you will be working on

This role focuses on shaping the long-term technology strategy and architecture needed to support AI innovation across Singapore's financial sector. Working with financial institutions, AI firms, technology providers, academia and public-sector partners, you will assess emerging technologies, identify future infrastructure needs, and develop strategic roadmaps that support the responsible adoption of AI.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Technology Strategy: Assess emerging AI, data and digital infrastructure technologies and their implications for the financial sector

  • Future-State Architecture: Develop strategic roadmaps and reference architectures for future financial-sector capabilities

  • Industry Standards & Interoperability: Advance approaches to interoperability, digital identity, data exchange and trusted AI adoption

  • Industry Engagement: Engage financial institutions, technology firms, researchers and public-sector agencies to build consensus on future technology priorities

  • Strategic Advisory: Provide technical input to industry-development, policy and national AI initiatives

What we are looking for

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in technology strategy, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, technology consulting, innovation, or related fields within financial services, technology, consulting or the public sector

  • Strong understanding of AI, data and digital technologies, including emerging trends, capabilities and their implications for financial services

  • Ability to assess emerging technologies and translate technical developments into industry strategies, infrastructure priorities and practical recommendations

  • Experience developing technology roadmaps, target-state architectures, digital transformation strategies or large-scale technology initiatives

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate technology opportunities, trade-offs and risks from both business and policy perspectives

  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders across industry, technology providers, academia and government agencies

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong writing skills, with experience preparing strategy papers, briefing materials and presentations for senior management

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments.

This is a 3-year contract. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

title: Sr AI Engineer (Emerging AI)
description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit

Job Application Deadline: 11/30/2026

The Opportunity

As a Sr AI Engineer, you'll build and own the platform that power our agentic solutions at DAT. Freight is an uncertain business, and the models we ship reduce that uncertainty: rate forecasts, load-to-truck matching, document extraction, fraud signals, and the agentic workflows our brokers and carriers use to move freight faster. None of that reaches a customer without a platform that makes training, serving, evaluating, and monitoring models routine instead of heroic.

You'll help build the platform, from the model gateway and inference layer through feature and vector storage, evaluation harnesses, production observability, agentic framework (A2A) all on a spine based on secure access and utilization. This is a highly visible role for an engineer who wants their work multiplied across every AI team in the company.

What You'll Do

  • Platform Ownership: Design, build, and operate the shared services that engineers and business users use to ship models: a model gateway for LLM access, inference endpoints for real-time and batch scoring, feature storage, vector search, and a common SDK.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead architecture for large-scale AI systems, write the design documents, and drive alignment across Product, and Engineering and Business users on how models get built and shipped at DAT.
  • Cloud Architecture: Architect and run scalable, reliable AI infrastructure on AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, Redpanda, MSK (Kafka), Lambda, and S3, all defined in Pulumi..
  • Evaluation and Quality: Build the offline and online evaluation systems that tell us whether a model or prompt change is an improvement, including regression suites, LLM-as-judge pipelines, A/B and shadow testing, and drift detection.
  • Cost and Performance: Own inference cost and latency as first-class metrics. Right-size GPU and serverless capacity, tune batching, caching, and quantization, and give teams clear visibility into what their workloads cost.
  • Safety and Governance: Implement guardrails, prompt and output logging, PII handling, access controls, and model and dataset lineage so AI systems meet our security and customer data commitments.
  • Best Practices: Drive the adoption of modern software development practices across AI work, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Mentorship: Mentor engineers and data scientists on production ML and distributed systems, and raise the operational bar of every team that builds on the platform.
  • Incident Management: Lead the response and resolution for complex production incidents involving AI services, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative measures.

The Skills and Experience You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant time as a senior or staff engineer owning production infrastructure that other engineering teams depend on.
  • 4+ years building and operating machine learning or AI platforms, with models you've taken from notebook to production traffic and then kept healthy.
  • Strong development language skills ideally using TypeScript/js, Java, or Go, with the software engineering discipline to build libraries other teams adopt willingly.
  • Extensive AWS experience with production systems, ideally including EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, Redpanda, MSK/Kafka, S3, and Secrets Manager, plus infrastructure-as-code with Pulumi, Terraform or similar.
  • Hands-on experience serving models at scale: containerized inference, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and the tradeoffs between real-time, streaming, and batch scoring.
  • Practical experience with LLM systems in production, including retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, prompt and context management, tool-calling or agent frameworks, and managed model APIs such as Amazon Bedrock.
  • Proven experience building evaluation and monitoring for models, not just services: offline eval sets, online metrics, drift and data quality checks, and a clear definition of what "regression" means for a model.
  • Strong background in event-driven and distributed systems using Redpanda, AWS MSK or Kafka
  • Fluency with observability and on-call health, designing dashboards, APM traces, logs, and alerts, defining SLOs, and using these tools to drive down incident frequency and MTTR.
  • Experience establishing and raising engineering standards for a team: PR and testing guidelines, deployment validation checklists, model release criteria, and post-incident review practices.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading cross-team designs in ambiguous problem spaces, writing clear system design documents and operations runbooks, and driving alignment across Engineering, Product, and Operations.
  • Proven mentoring track record, especially helping engineers and data scientists grow in system design, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain trade-offs and system behavior clearly to engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with model fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient training, and a clear point of view on when it beats prompting.
  • Background in marketplace, pricing, forecasting, or document extraction problems.
  • Freight, logistics, or supply chain domain experience.

Why DAT?
DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

title: Roadway Inspector
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Full Time Roadway Inspector for our San Bernardino, California office. Be involved in projects with our Construction Management Group and be a part of a growing organization that meets our client’s objectives and solves their challenges.

The Roadway/Water Inspector provides support to the Resident Engineer on complex construction management projects or programs, by performing construction engineering and inspection activities. This person must be capable of applying diversified knowledge of construction engineering principles and practices and monitor construction for compliance with project documents. Must be able to read and interpret project plans and specification and has working knowledge of current Caltrans and industry construction standards. Elements to be inspected or monitored may include water line installation and relocation, maintenance of traffic, earthwork, drainage, utility relocation, storm water pollution prevention implementation and compliance, construction of roadway sections, pedestrian and bike facilities, structure elements of work, traffic and lighting improvements, landscape work and other similar activities.

Your Impact

  • Collect, compile, and analyze data from the physical work site, surveys, structural plans, blueprints, schematics, data, technical drawings, flow diagrams, material sampling, computer-generated reports, and other matrices for single, multi-phase, or multi-site field inspection activities.
  • Perform inspections on projects of moderate to increased complexity and/or scope, including proposed and existing site conditions, equipment, construction, materials, controls, resources, layout, alignment, and elevation to determine conformance with applicable rules, standards, codes, and construction or operating permits.
  • Follow standard practices to provide technical assistance and guidance that accounts for the proper inspection, construction, and functioning of buildings, highways, roads, bridges, materials, structures, infrastructure, equipment, and/or mechanical systems according to design standard specifications.
  • Act as consultant regarding work progress and problem resolution; may serve as the only inspector on a construction project or assist in overseeing construction inspection activities for projects of a moderate/large scope and complexity within a district.
  • Perform an initial check during the first phase of construction and follow-up inspections throughout the construction project; at completion, performs a final, comprehensive inspection and provides written and oral feedback related to their findings.
  • Verify load calculations, change orders, interpretation of contract plans and specifications; resolving differences in interpretation of plans and specifications.
  • Monitor project phasing plans and contractors' work to ensure quality control and contract compliance; documenting work progress and issues arising throughout scope of project.
  • Work as an individual or as part of a cross-functional team to execute inspection work; occasionally leading tasks and inspection staff for technical or field assignments on project work.
  • Attend pre-construction meetings and answer questions from contractors and other attendees.
  • Calculate payments due to contractors for work completed.
  • Write technical reports summarizing inspection findings and conclusions; generating complete, accurate, and concise documentation using photographs, sketches, calculations, software, spreadsheets, technical drawings, flow diagrams, 2D/3D illustrations, and reports.
  • Assist technical staff, project managers, and contractors with risk identification and assessment, offering input, analysis, escalation, or resolution with construction, mitigation, and improvement activities for more intricate and involved construction or engineering problems.
  • Assist with inspection plan preparation and coordination of any field/site work, reviewing staffing, and equipment utilization data and time/cost estimates.
  • Provide guidance and training to entry-level inspection staff.
  • Engage in contact with client and contractor personnel to schedule and coordinate project inspection.
  • Assist in the analysis, evaluation, and interpretation of data obtained during site inspections, offering input with developing action plans for low to mid-level risk environmental, construction, installation, equipment operations, and/or mitigation activities.
  • Remain current in latest inspection and construction knowledge, techniques, and practices.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant post education experience in discipline with prior construction inspection experience on Caltrans type projects.
  • Essential professional licensure/certification(s).
  • Valid state driver’s license.
  • Advanced knowledge of construction inspection principles, field inspection practices, process, methods and techniques.
  • Advanced knowledge of relevant construction codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
  • Ability to make technical computations and calculations involving the application of construction inspection principles, understanding plans and specifications, and making factual comparisons to the appropriate standards or regulations.
  • Ability to plan and conduct inspections and investigations on various aspects of the construction and installation of equipment, materials, and systems.
  • Capable interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to a technical and non-technical audience.
  • Effective self-leadership with attention to detail, results orientation, and managing multiple priorities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, follow instruction, work independently, and comply with company policies.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, software, technology, math principles, spreadsheets, and tools.
  • Developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from inspection and testing results, data collation, load calculations, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective, economical, and logical solution.
  • Ability to assertively direct others in the field such as subcontractors and junior-level staff to consistently complete tasks safely, efficiently, and accurately according to specifications.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
  • Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in closely related discipline is preferred.
  • Professional Engineering License.
  • Structures construction inspection experience.

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.
