title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About the role

Building a Data Warehouse that consolidates [property/appraisal data — comps, valuations, market data, inspection records, etc.]. We're hiring an AI Engineer to build the intelligent interface on top of it: a system that lets our team and product query that data in natural language and get answers they can trust.

We currently use Claude for appraiser-facing questions, and while it's strong at general reasoning, it hallucinates on domain-specific appraisal questions because it isn't grounded in our data. Your core mission is to fix that — to make our AI answer appraisal questions accurately, with answers traceable back to real data in our warehouse.

This is a hands-on, applied role for someone who understands modern LLM engineering (retrieval, grounding, evaluation) and knows how to connect a model to a live data source without letting it make things up.

What you'll do

•Build and own the interface between our LLM and the Data Warehouse — enabling natural-language and structured querying of appraisal data.

•Design and implement retrieval / RAG pipelines that ground model responses in real warehouse data, so answers are accurate and citable rather than invented.

•Diagnose and reduce hallucination on appraisal-specific questions through better retrieval, prompt engineering, guardrails, and output validation.

•Build evaluation harnesses and test sets (ideally with input from our appraisers) that measure answer accuracy and catch regressions before they reach users.

•Develop the query layer that translates user questions into safe, correct queries against the warehouse (e.g., natural language → SQL, with validation).

•Collaborate with appraisers and domain experts to encode appraisal logic, terminology, and standards into prompts, retrieval, and evaluation criteria.

•Monitor model performance in production and iterate on quality, latency, and cost.

What we're looking for

•5 years of software or ML engineering experience, with recent hands-on work on LLM-powered applications.

•Practical experience building RAG / retrieval-augmented systems — embeddings, vector search, chunking, and grounding strategies.

•Strong understanding of why LLMs hallucinate and proven techniques to reduce it (grounding, prompt design, guardrails, structured output, evaluation).

•Solid ML fundamentals — you understand how models are trained and evaluated, even if this role is more applied than research.

•Experience working with a data warehouse in Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, or Databricks on Azure) and writing efficient SQL.

•Hands-on experience with the Azure AI / data stack — e.g. Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector search), and deploying services on Azure.

•Proficiency in Python and/or C#/.NET, and comfort building APIs / backend services.

•Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems — we run Claude (Anthropic) and Azure OpenAI, so familiarity with either (or open-source models) is valuable.

•Ability to build evals and think rigorously about correctness — not just "does it sound right," but "is it right."

Nice to have

•Experience in a regulated or domain-heavy field where accuracy matters (real estate, finance, insurance, legal, healthcare).

•Familiarity with real estate appraisal or valuation concepts (comps, adjustments, USPAP, market analysis).

•Experience fine-tuning open-source models, or knowing when fine-tuning is (and isn't) the right tool.

•Familiarity with natural-language-to-SQL techniques and their failure modes.

•Experience with orchestration/tooling frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent) — and the judgment to know when to skip them.

•MLOps / observability experience for LLM systems (tracing, monitoring, cost control).

Our environment

•Cloud: Microsoft Azure (we're a Microsoft shop end to end)

•LLM: Claude (Anthropic) and Azure OpenAI — you'll pick the right model for each job

•Data: [Microsoft Fabric / Azure Synapse / Azure SQL] warehouse currently being built

•AI tooling: [Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, etc.]

•Stack: [Python, C#/.NET, your API framework]

title: Laboratory Technician, Entry-Level
description:
Savannah River National Laboratory is seeking an entry‑level Laboratory Technician to perform laboratory testing, sample preparation, and analytical support under appropriate levels of supervision. This role supports the Material Test Laboratory's (MTL) Nuclear Stockpile Stewardship mission for the Nuclear Security Enterprise, while operating within the Savannah River Tritium Enterprise.

  • The selected candidate will be instructed in metallographic techniques and support a variety of work tasks throughout the facility under close supervision utilizing clearly defined standard operating procedures.

  • Work is expected to be performed in a laboratory setting utilizing ventilated hoods and gloveboxes and in a radioactive environment requiring the use of protective clothing and respiratory equipment.
  • Other duties may be assigned by supervision
  • The schedule for this position is 4-10’s (Shift 32), Monday-Thursday.

  • Candidate must have completed ACT WorkKeys Skills Assessment and achieved a minimum score of:

    • 3 in Applied Math
    • 3 in Graphic Literacy
    • 4 in Workplace Documents
  • Test scores for each assessment must be within the last five years and must be uploaded to Oracle at the time of application submission or by the time the posting closes to be considered for this vacancy. Upload the ACT WorkKeys Skills test scores where you would upload a cover letter.
  • Position requires the ability to secure and maintain a Q level security clearance.

title: Sygeplejerske (AFTENVAGT) søges til skønt hus
description:
Er det vigtigt for dig, at sygeplejen til den ældre beboer praktiseres med høj faglighed, relationsdannelse og omsorg ud fra et fagligt overblik?

Brænder du for sygepleje til den multisyge geriatiske beboer?

Er du både fagligt og personligt parat til at være ansvarshavende?

Er det naturligt for dig at samarbejde tværfagligt?

Har du lyst til at være en del af et hus du kan være stolt af, hvor vi siger mere "ja" og "det finder vi ud af" end vi siger "nej" og hvor vi ser åbenhed, smil og en positiv tilgang som en naturlig del af hverdagen?

Så er du måske lige den vi mangler i en aftenvagtsstilling efter 5/2 princippet. (arbejde fast mandag og tirsdag + fredag, lørdag og søndag i ulige uger i 2026 og lige uger fra 2027

Hareskovbos profil:

Hareskovbo er beliggende i skønne omgivelser, tæt ved Bagsværd Sø. Huset består af to afdelinger med tre bo-grupper i hver. Her bor i alt 83 beboere - alle med individuelle behov og ressourcer. Vi er et hus i stadig udvikling. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet i plejen samt et respektfuldt og godt miljø for beboerne.

Vi sætter trivsel, ansvar, dialog samt et højt fagligt niveau hos personalet i højsædet. Hareskovbo er et godt sted at bo, gæste og arbejde, og det er vigtigt, at du aktivt er med til at understøtte dette. Læs evt. mere på

Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed har ved seneste tilsyn vurderet Hareskovbo i kategorien ”Ingen problemer af betydning for patientsikkerheden” og en pårørende har i efteråret 2024 fået optaget et læserbrev i Berlingeren, hvor hun beskriver Hareskovbo som "Danmarks måske bedste pleejehjem." Det nye ældretilsyn har ved tilsyn i foråret 2026 vurderet Hareskovbo således: Plejehjemmet Hareskovbo fremstår samlet set med god kvalitet. Ældretilsynet vurderer, at der ingen væsentlige udfordringer er med kvaliteten af helhedsplejen. Alle markører er opfyldt.

Vi forventer at:

  • Du er dansk autoriseret sygeplejerske - gerne med geriatrisk eller akut erfaring

  • Du forstår at imødekomme mennesker med forskellige behov og Kan varetage komplekse sygeplejefaglige opgaver

  • Du tager naturligt ansvar for at løfte både de sundheds- og socialfaglige opgaver om aftenen og du formår at prioritere og vurdere akutte opgaver

  • Du har en positiv og åben tilgang til arbejdet, og forstår at være rollemodel

  • Du kan lide at arbejde selvstændigt, og har en anerkende tilgang til samarbejdet omkring en professionel indsats til den enkelte beboer

  • Du du som ansvarshavende bærer ledelsens beslutninger videre i aftenvagten samt deltager i udvikling, implementering og forbedring af tiltag ved nye arbejdsgange, retningslinjer og relevant dokumentation

Du kan forvente:

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi er der for hinanden både i huset som helhed og i natteamet, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Engagerede kolleger, der er fagligt dygtige

  • Nærværende og engageret ledelse

  • At blive en del af et dejligt hus, som vi er stolte af, og hvor vi oplever at beboere og pårørende har høj tilfredshed!

Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du kontakte afdelingssygeplejerske Nina Rolin, på tlf. 30762501

Ansøgning modtages udelukkende elektronisk, på kontakt@hareskovbo.dk

title: Fresh Cut Supervisor
description:
PURPOSE: Manages the Fresh Cut operation according to Company standards. Supervises Fresh Cut Department employees assigned. Provides customer service. Ensures product quality, freshness, safety and selection.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Champions Company and Division customer service programs to meet or exceed Division customer service goals. Handles customer relations in a positive manner, including effective resolution of customer complaints. Promotes philosophy of personalized service in the Fresh Cut Department.
  • Supervises, motivates, and trains personnel. Monitors employee performance and recommends personnel actions such as hiring, firing, layoff and disciplinary action. Schedules Fresh Cut Department personnel assigned.
  • Prepare fresh fruits and vegetables and salads for the Fresh Cut Department. Stocks, dates and rotates Fresh Cut Department products to ensure quality, freshness, selection and adequate quantity to meet customer demand. Controls shrink and cost. Prevents the sale of out of code, and product that does not meet standards.
  • Receives, checks and controls inventory to ensure adequate quantity, quality and freshness.
  • Creates effective promotional and seasonal displays.
  • Comply with all food and workplace safety rules and regulations. Ensure proper signing and pricing.
  • Assists customers by making product suggestions and engages in suggestive selling.
  • Ensures safety, cleanliness and sanitation of work area, cooler, equipment and display area.
  • Responsible for performing all job duties and responsibilities safely, accurately and with honesty and integrity.
  • Other necessary and required duties.

SKILLS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires working knowledge of all duties related to the Fresh Cut Department.
  • Requires good communication skills and the ability to maintain composure in dealing with customers and co-workers.
  • Requires knowledge of workplace practices.
  • Requires a good understanding of overall company practices and Fresh Cut Department policies and procedures. Requires the ability to judge and react to business activity.
  • Must have knowledge of product variety, standards, perishability, food safety, food handling and sanitation procedures and department policies and procedures.
  • Frequently reaches, lifts, stacks and maneuvers objects of varying dimensions and weights up to approximately 50 lbs. Bends, stoops and reaches frequently. Pushes and pulls fully loaded hand trucks, six-wheel carts and pallet jacks. Performs repetitious arm movement to prepare, package and display products.
  • Manual dexterity and good eye-hand coordination are necessary.
  • Mental alertness is necessary to ensure safe and accurate completion of work activities. Requires knowledge of basic mathematics and weights and measures. Must have knowledge of produce variety, standards, perishability, food safety, food handling, sanitation, labeling and department policies and procedures.
  • Operates scales, wrappers, compactors and garbage disposals. Utilizes cleaning supplies and equipment. Utilizes knives and safety cutters. Requires use of latex gloves.
  • May be required to work nights, weekends and holidays. Scheduled hours will vary. Good attendance is required.
  • Exposure to potential hazards exists with respect to equipment and work aids necessary to perform job duties.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Hands are frequently exposed to water, ice and cleaning agents.
  • Exposure to 35˚ Fahrenheit while handling products in cold cases and 28˚ Fahrenheit while handling products in cooler.
  • Working conditions consist of a temperature-controlled store environment.

title: CT Technologist (Full-Time)
description:
Overview

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The CT Technologist performs computed tomography procedures and related techniques, producing sectional and three-dimensional images for the interpretation and assists with interventional and therapeutic procedures.

Responsibilities

A day in the life of a CT Technologist at Hackensack Meridian Health includes:

  • Performs complex CT procedures.
  • Evaluates radiographs to ensure that radiographs contain proper identification and are of diagnostic value.
  • Uses consistent and appropriate techniques to gather relevant information from the medical record, significant others and health care providers to prepare protocols for scanning and patient safety. The collection of information is determined by the patient's needs or condition.
  • Determines whether the patient has been appropriately prepared for the procedure.
  • Preps patient for scanning: (i.e. shielding, immobilization devices).
  • Assist providers with CT guided Interventional procedures as required.
  • Perform CT examination and administer contrast following established departmental protocols.
  • Provides accurate explanations and instructions at any appropriate time and at a level the patient can understand. Addresses and documents patient questions and concerns regarding the procedure when appropriate.
  • Performs venipuncture, IV patency, and maintenance procedures according to established guidelines.
  • Monitors the patient's physical condition during the procedure.
  • Reviews images to determine if additional scans will enhance the diagnostic value of the procedure.
  • Performs retrospective reconstruction on raw data.
  • Provides technical assistance and instruction to students, employees, and medical residents.
  • Adheres to the principals of image gently & image wisely.
  • Follow & adheres to infection control guidelines and sterile techniques.
  • Revises scanning parameters to better visualize the pathology in accordance with established protocol.
  • Reviews all diagnostic or therapeutic data for completeness and accuracy.
  • Documents diagnostic, treatment, and patient data in the appropriate record.
  • Archives images to data storage devices according to established guidelines.
  • Assesses equipment to determine acceptable performance based on established guidelines.
  • Performs daily clerical duties, which includes the use of EPIC, PACS, Teletracking System, computer system, patient scheduling, and other computer systems as added by hospital.
  • Greets all patients when they arrive for their exam utilizing AIDET standards.
  • Administers emergency care including performing CPR, if necessary.
  • Responsible for scheduled shifts including holidays and weekends.
  • Overtime as needed to provide continual quality patient care.
  • On call assignments as needed per Department of Radiology policy.
  • Adheres to the policy of Employee ID, Standards of Behavior, Attendance, and Punctuality.
  • Identifies the needs of the patient population served and modifies and delivers care that is specific to those needs (i.e., age, culture, language, hearing and /or visually impaired, etc.). This process includes communicating with the patient, parent, and/or primary caregiver(s) at their level (developmental/age, educational, literacy, etc.).
  • Adheres to the standards identified in the Medical Center's Organizational Competencies.
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
  • Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Graduate of approved school of radiography.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills that may include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • Diagnostic Radiography License.
  • American Registry of Radiologic Technologists Certification.
  • AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification.
  • CT certification must complete within 9 months from date of hire.

Contacts:

  • Regular contact with medical personnel and its visitors.

Working Conditions:

  • Lifts a minimum of 25 lbs., pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs. and stands a minimum of 6 hours a day.

If you feel the above description speaks directly to your strengths and capabilities, then please apply today!

Starting Minimum Rate

Minimum rate of $43.82 Hourly

title: Er du vores nye uvildige Erhvervsrådgiver?
description:
Er du vores nye uvildige Erhvervsrådgiver?

– Bliv en del af Pilea familien

Er du en proaktiv og handlingsorienteret erhvervsrådgiver, der brænder for at skabe relationer og hjælpe ejerledere og virksomheder med finansiel og strategisk sparring? Så er stillingen som erhvervsrådgiver hos Pilea noget for dig.

Som erhvervsrådgiver bliver du en del af et stærkt og dynamisk team, der dagligt arbejder med at udvide vores partnergrundlag og skabe værdifulde relationer med vores samarbejdspartnere.

Velkommen på Pilea holdet

Hos Pilea er vi en 100% uvildig finansiel rådgivningsvirksomhed, der har til formål at hjælpe vores samarbejdspartnere med at realisere deres økonomiske drømme, så de kan leve det liv de drømmer om. Vi stræber efter at være en arbejdsplads, der fremmer både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Du bliver en del af et team på 10 kolleger, hvor vi sparrer fagligt og hjælper hinanden i hverdagen. Vi er et ambitiøst team med dyb forretningsforståelse og bred erfaring. Hos os er der højt til loftet - alle bliver hørt, og vi løfter i flok.

Vores base er Papirfabrikken i Silkeborg, men vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere findes i hele Danmark.

Du planlægger selv din arbejdsdag inden for 37 timer om ugen, der typisk ligger mellem kl. 8 og 16. Du har selv ansvaret for at nå dine mål, løse dine opgaver og holde styr på dine aftaler.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver hos Pilea

Jobbet som uvildig erhvervsrådgiver giver dig mulighed for at planlægge din egen arbejdsdag. Du har ansvaret for at sikre, at dine opgaver bliver løst til tiden, og at du møder kunderne med nærvær og ægte interesse for deres økonomi.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Finansiel og strategisk sparring med ejerledere og virksomheder
  • Markeds- og regnskabsanalyser på tværs af brancher og markeder
  • Finansiel optimering og bankskifte
  • Forhandling og optimering af vilkår
  • Bundlinjeoptimering i bred forstand
  • Strategisk arbejde i bestyrelser eller advisory boards
  • Investerings- og formuerådgivning
  • Rådgivning ved køb og salg af virksomheder herunder generationsskifte
  • Fremskaffelse af investorkapital
  • Ejendomsfinansiering
  • Køb og salg af ejendomme

Sådan får du succes i rollen:

Du har erfaring som erhvervsrådgiver, fx fra en bank, og en stor interesse i at udvikle virksomheder og de mennesker, der driver dem. Derudover:

  • Du er udadvendt og god til at skabe relationer og netværk, både internt og eksternt
  • Du har kendskab til køb og salg af virksomheder og er en dygtig forhandler
  • Du er idérig, finder løsninger og eksekverer på dem
  • Du er en god holdspiller og ved, hvornår du skal trække på dine kolleger
  • Du trives med en afvekslende hverdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver
  • Du har kørekort og egen bil
  • Du arbejder struktureret, tager ejerskab for dine opgaver og trives i en selvstændig rolle, hvor du taler med mange forskellige mennesker i løbet af dagen.

Det tilbyder vi

  • En selvstændig rolle med direkte kontakt til ejerledere og reel indflydelse på, hvordan vi udvikler forretningen
  • Faglig sparring med kolleger, der hver har deres eget ekspertiseområde, fra Family Office og ejendomme til M&A og investering
  • Løn- og pensionsforhold: Efter kvalifikationer
  • Efteruddannelse og faglig udvikling: Efter behov

Lidt mere om os

Pilea Finance & Business er et team af specialister, der hver varetager sit eget ekspertiseområde. Sammen løser vi de fleste opgaver inden for finansiel og strategisk rådgivning. Pilea er godkendt af Finanstilsynet inden for investeringsrådgivning, finansiel rådgivning, forsikringsformidling og boligkreditformidling. Læs mere på pilea.dk

Vi arbejder for ejerledere inden for

  • Erhvervsrådgivning
  • Strategisk og finansiel optimering
  • Ejendomsinvestering og -udvikling
  • Privatrådgivning

Alt sammen 100 % uvildigt

Ansøgning samt frist

Ansøgninger behandles løbende og tiltrædelse er snarest muligt. Vi gennemgår ansøgningerne løbende og besætter stillingen, når vi har fundet det rette match, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om jobbet, så kontakt Daniel Høj, på mail dh@pilea.dk, han kan også fanges på telefon 23 69 09 02 - sms og mail foretrækkes.

title: Electro-Mechanical Technician
description:
Your Job

The Controls Technician is a hands-on technical role responsible for supporting production, process engineering, and integration teams by troubleshooting and optimizing automation equipment, maintaining and programming PLCs, supporting control systems, and ensuring reliable operation of assembly and testing equipment. This role focuses heavily on controls, automation, robotics, electrical troubleshooting, and system integration. The technician will work both independently and collaboratively to ensure peak equipment performance. This position is located in Naperville, IL.


Our Team

Molex is a global team of innovators who design and create solutions for businesses where data, technology and the complex electronic solutions that harness them are being transformed by rapid change. We are part of a team around the globe working to improve life's essential products like food, clothing, water, transportation, medical and technology. The company makes products ranging from interconnect components to collimators to complex fiber optic assemblies used in a wide range of industries. This Molex facility works with custom fiber optic assemblies, bundles, and specialty fibers including gold and aluminum metalized fibers for industrial and medical applications.


What You Will Do

  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain machine control systems including electrical, PLC, HMI, pneumatic, robotic, and vision components.
  • Program, modify, and debug PLC control logic (e.g., Allen-Bradley, Siemens) to address production needs and improve performance.
  • Read, interpret, and update electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control documentation.
  • Configure, calibrate, and maintain sensors, actuators, vision systems, and other control devices.
  • Support robotic cells by programming, adjusting, and troubleshooting robot motion and control systems (e.g., Fanuc).
  • Assist with integration and commissioning of new automated equipment and control upgrades.
  • Identify and implement improvements to control logic, safety circuits, automation sequences, and machine performance.
  • Support small production and test equipment (e.g., EOL test systems, marking/inspections systems) by programming new part numbers and troubleshooting electrical or controls-related issues.
  • Maintain and update automated test programs, including parameter adjustments and troubleshooting.
  • Provide training and guidance to operators and maintenance personnel on basic controls troubleshooting and safe equipment operation.
  • Document changes to PLC programs, wiring, robot paths, and control systems following internal standards.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Associate degree or technical certification in automation, industrial controls, electrical engineering technology, electro-mechanical technology, robotics, or related field.
  • One (1) year or more experience in a manufacturing or industrial automation environment.
  • Experience in PLC programming, troubleshooting, and controls integration.
  • Understanding of industrial electrical systems, schematics, I/O, sensors, and safety circuits.
  • Experience with robotic systems, automated equipment, and computer-controlled machinery.
  • Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship


What Will Put You Ahead

  • Experience with Fanuc robots and machine vision systems.
  • Exposure to HMI development and modification.
  • Experience with automation equipment startup, commissioning, or control system upgrades.
  • Experience using CAD or other electrical design software

For this role, we anticipate paying $31-37 per hour. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.


Who We Are

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

title: Senior Vice President, Digital Workflow, Automation & AI
description:
Senior Vice President, Digital Workflow, Automation & AI

Global | Permanent

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will lead the automation and AI agenda for Private Assets Operations — determining what is worth automating, how it gets deployed, and whether the benefit was real.

  • Identify and prioritise automation, digital workflow and AI opportunities across the Private Assets estate.

  • Determine the right approach for each opportunity — workflow, automation tooling or AI — and make the case for it.

  • Own deployment standards so solutions are reusable and supportable rather than one-off local fixes.

  • Partner with IT and the Transformation Office through build, deployment and support.

  • Define how benefit will be measured before build starts, and report on whether it was realised.

  • Establish the governance and controls around automated and AI-assisted processes, working with Risk and the Control Office.

  • Coordinate with Tactical Operations on automation already deployed, and pick up solutions worth scaling.

  • Lead and mentor focus area resources, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Report on progress, risks and benefits realisation to the relevant leader and senior stakeholders.

About You

You have 12–15 years’ experience in private assets or a comparable financial services environment, with substantial exposure to automation or digital transformation.

  • Proven delivery of automation, digital workflow or AI initiatives that were deployed and adopted, not just piloted.

  • Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes — enough to judge what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

  • Practical understanding of workflow orchestration, exception-based processing and the control implications of automation.

  • Sound commercial judgement on effort versus benefit, and the willingness to stop work that will not pay back.

  • Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

UC Medical Center houses Greater Cincinnati’s only Level I adult trauma center, which includes the right mix of specialist and medical resources available at a moment’s notice for a wide variety of the most complex medical conditions and injuries.

Become part of the only Psychiatric Unit in Southwest Ohio where you can gain exposure to a variety of diagnosis in behavioral health. You will also have the opportunity to see things you won’t see anywhere else and the chance to treat patients that other institutions don’t accept.

The Psychiatric Therapeutic Program Worker (TPW), in collaboration with other members of the healthcare team, is responsible for maintaining a therapeutic milieu and a safe environment for all psychiatric patients on the unit. As a member of the patient care team, the TPW performs selected duties under the direction of the Registered Nurse, to ensure quality patient care.

  • Engages in population appropriate communication.
  • Has knowledge of growth and development milestones and tasks.
  • Gives clear instructions to patients/family regarding treatment.
  • Involves family/guardian in the assessment, initial treatment and continuing care of the patient.
  • Identifies any physical limitations of the patient and deploys intervention when necessary.
  • Recognizes and responds appropriately to patients/families with behavioral health problems.
  • Interprets population related data and plans care appropriately.
  • Identifies and responds appropriately to different needs resulting from, unique psychological needs or those associated with religious / cultural norms. Performs treatments, administers medication or operates equipment safely.
  • Recognizes and responds to signs/symptoms of abuse or neglect.
  • Establish a therapeutic milieu and provide a safe environment for all psychiatric patients. The Psychiatric Therapeutic Program Worker (TPW), in collaboration with other members of the healthcare team, is responsible for maintaining a therapeutic milieu and a safe environment for all psychiatric patients on the unit. As a member of the patient care team, the TPW performs selected duties under the direction of the Registered Nurse, to ensure quality patient care and staff. This includes monitoring the unit for safety at all times, maintaining a quiet and peaceful atmosphere, managing patient's behavior, preparing room for patient's arrival, orienting patients to the unit, checking belongings for hazardous objects or weapons, securing all belongings in designated areas, provide routine bed checks and secure areas.
  • Provide clinical duties as directed by Registered Nurse. These assignments may include but are not limited to: NIPPAS for vital signs and daily weights, phlebotomy, EKG, finger sticks, assistance with feedings, personal hygiene/grooming, ADL's, collecting meal trays and returning to dietary, clean dining area, provide clean linen and dispose of soiled linen, and assist with inventory control and distribution of supplies and equipment in the clinical areas and hallways.
  • Co-lead treatment groups, i.e., Goals Group, Exercise Group, etc. Participate, organize and direct social and therapeutic leisure time activities, i.e., Bingo, card playing, chess and activities in the Recreation Room. Observe individual behaviors and group interactions and report any major change in patient's behavior and/or medical condition to the RN.
  • Initiate basic psychiatric interventions and provide appropriate redirection as needed. Uses age appropriate communication skills. Provide non-punitive limit setting, appropriate modeling and reinforcement as needed to meet the patient's emotional needs. Assist in physical crisis management as needed and/or assigned.
  • Participate in quality improvement activities. Attend staff meetings, in-service sessions, and crisis intervention programs. Performs other duties as delegated or directed by RN, Clinical Manager or Nursing Supervisor.
  • Transport patients to X-ray, EEG, MRI, clinic appointments, etc.

  • Minimum Required: High School diploma/GED. Preferred: Relevant college coursework.
  • STNA certification preferred or college-level coursework in nursing/psychiatry/social work.
  • Minimum Required: Six months direct patient care experience in psychiatric setting or equivalent college-level coursework in nursing/psychology/social work.
  • Preferred: Specialized training in phlebotomy, vitals signs, and assistance with activities of daily living experience.

title: Director, HCS Client Strategy & Product
description:
Director, Client Delivery

Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

Are you an experienced and results-driven professional looking for a challenging leadership role?

About this Role:

The Director, Client Strategy & Product is responsible for connecting client needs, market trends, HCS capabilities, and product strategy to improve the competitiveness, growth, and long-term value of the HCS portfolio.

This role works horizontally across the HCS client portfolio to identify common client needs, product gaps, emerging market requirements, and opportunities for service expansion. The leader serves as the primary bridge between Client Delivery, Product, Technology, Operations, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure client and market insights are translated into actionable product priorities, service improvements, and growth opportunities.

Unlike Client Delivery, which owns individual client relationships and account-level growth, Client Strategy & Product is accountable for identifying portfolio-level opportunities, shaping solutions, influencing product and technology roadmaps, and enabling Client Delivery teams to bring differentiated HCS capabilities to clients.

The successful candidate will bring deep benefits administration domain knowledge, strong commercial and product acumen, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate client and market needs into practical business and product strategies.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain a structured Voice of the Client process that captures client feedback, unmet needs, product requests, market observations, and emerging requirements across the HCS portfolio.
  • Analyze client feedback and account-level opportunities across the portfolio to identify recurring needs, common themes, product gaps, and opportunities that can create value across multiple clients.
  • Partner with Client Delivery leaders to identify potential cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, and service expansion opportunities.
  • Develop portfolio-level growth opportunities and solution concepts that Client Delivery and Sales can bring to appropriate clients.
  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to translate client and market requirements into product strategy, roadmap priorities, enhancements, automation opportunities, and investment recommendations.
  • Establish structured communication and feedback loops between Client Delivery, Product, Technology, Operations, and Sales so that client needs and product developments are consistently understood across HCS.
  • Maintain a portfolio-level view of product utilization and adoption and identify opportunities to increase client adoption of existing HCS capabilities.
  • Evaluate HCS capabilities across clients to identify opportunities for standardization, reuse, and scalable solutions rather than developing unnecessary client-specific solutions.
  • Gather and synthesize market intelligence, competitive insights, advisor feedback, industry trends, and emerging client requirements to inform HCS product and service strategy.
  • Partner with Sales and Client Delivery to strengthen HCS positioning, value propositions, client presentations, and executive-level discussions.
  • Support Client Delivery on strategic client conversations requiring product, market, innovation, or broader HCS portfolio expertise.
  • Develop business cases for product investments, service enhancements, automation, AI capabilities, and other strategic initiatives based on client demand, revenue potential, competitive differentiation, risk, and financial return.
  • Partner with Operations and CoE & Risk to ensure product and service enhancements consider operational feasibility, scalability, regulatory requirements, controls, and delivery impact.
  • Maintain transparency into the HCS product roadmap and ensure Client Delivery leaders understand planned capabilities, timing, priorities, and dependencies relevant to their clients.
  • Establish mechanisms to communicate product developments and new capabilities to Client Delivery and Sales teams so that opportunities can be proactively introduced to existing clients.
  • Measure the business impact of product and portfolio initiatives, including product adoption, revenue opportunities generated, client value, and return on investment.
  • Create a culture of client-driven innovation, collaboration, commercial thinking, transparency, and disciplined prioritization.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • A total of 7+ years of progressive leadership experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and enable existing-client growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, product adoption, and service expansion.
  • Experience generating qualified expansion pipelines and translating client needs into revenue-generating solutions.
  • Strong Voice of the Client expertise, with the ability to synthesize client feedback and market insights into actionable product and service strategies.
  • Experience aligning product roadmaps and investment priorities with client needs, market demand, and business objectives.
  • Proven ability to evaluate product performance, adoption, and investment ROI to drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success identifying opportunities for cross-client standardization, scalability, and reuse of products and services.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Product, Client Delivery, Technology, and other stakeholders to advance strategic priorities.
  • Commercial acumen and a track record of translating product and portfolio initiatives into measurable revenue growth and client value.

Flexible Working

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

  • Remote work: Enjoy the convenience of working from home and maximize your time.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Flex the times you work during the day, allowing you to balance your home life and work.

Working For You

Perks and rewards designed for you:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Our health and welfare benefits can be tailored to fit your needs and start on the first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings: We support you as you invest in your future.
  • Employee Discounts: We offer you access to a vast selection of global, national, and local discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.
  • Training: Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.
  • Great Work Environment: We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

Join Us

At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can:

  • Bring your authentic self to work.
  • Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally
  • Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support.

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best.

Pay Transparency:

Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Organization. In this role as a senior individual contributor, you will define the technical strategy and direction for the reliability and performance of our infrastructure and software systems. You will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, mentor senior engineers, and influence key architectural and business decisions across our technology organization. You will utilize your deep technical expertise to architect and implement highly reliable and scalable infrastructure solutions that empower our technology organization to quickly and safely deliver features to our customers at scale.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Lead the resolution of the most complex, cross-cutting technical challenges and drive them to completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
  • Define the long-term technical roadmap and strategy for core SRE platforms and services
  • Architect, scope, and drive delivery of major engineering initiatives, balancing trade-offs between effort, risk, and long-term business impact
  • Set the standard for clean, efficient, and well-documented code, focusing on core system improvements and features
  • Collaborate effectively across teams, communicating clearly on progress, blockers, and outcomes to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Provide technical mentorship to engineers across the organization and drive organization-wide adoption of best practices for operational excellence, observability, and infrastructure security
  • Demonstrate accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement in all aspects of your work
  • Develop, configure, and maintain underlying platforms for deployed software (AWS accounts and networking, kubernetes clusters, and similar systems), focusing on architectural design and scaling
  • Develop, configure, and maintain observability and monitoring tools (Coralogix, Sentry, etc.), including defining SLOs and SLIs
  • Develop, configure, and maintain software development (CI/CD) tools (github actions runners, ArgoCD, etc)

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management or backend software development experience in a fast-paced, product-driven environment
  • Demonstrated deep technical expertise in one or more of the following languages: Python, Javascript, or Unix Shell
  • Extensive experience with AWS, including architecting, deploying, monitoring, and scaling production workloads across multiple accounts and regions
  • Deep expertise with Terraform, Kubernetes, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and Docker/containerization best practices
  • Proven experience leading technical projects with significant cross-functional impact
  • Comfortable working in an operational environment, including acting as a point of escalation for complex issues outside of the on-call schedule
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, comfortable engaging with technical and executive stakeholders

The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $165,000 - $190,000 annually + bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more.

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper eller social og sundhedsassistent til udekørende i Natgruppen
description:
Social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent til udekørende i Natgruppen



Trives du når andre sover, og vil du bruge din faglighed dér, hvor der virkelig er brug for den? Som udekørende i Natgruppen er du med til at skabe tryghed, omsorg, kvalitet og helhedspleje for Odense kommunes borgere, mens byen sover. Vi søger en social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent, der har lyst til at arbejde selvstændigt – med et stærkt fællesskab i ryggen.



Vi søger nu kompetente og udadvendte social- og sundhedshjælpere eller social og sundhedsassistenter, til vores udekørende Natgruppe. Stillingen er fast på 28 timer ugentligt, hvor der arbejdes fast hver anden uge (56 timer). Ønsker du evt. flere timer vil disse ikke være fast i udekørende.


Om os
Vi har stor fokus på fagligheden og vægter det gode samarbejde højt. Vi går ind for en anerkendende tilgang til vores borgere, samarbejdspartner og til hinanden. Vi vægter ærlighed og ordentlighed højt, og har stor fokus på social kapital.



Natgruppen arbejder by dækkende og ind i kommunens forløb, hele tiden med forløbets fokus og med udgangspunkt i borgerens mål. Natområdet består af forskellige plejeboliger, bosteder indenfor handicap, psykiatri-, og hjerneskadeområdet, samt syge- og hjemmeplejegrupper i Odense. Medarbejderne i Natgruppen betjener hver nat ca. 2.400 borgere. Der er ansat ca. 160 medarbejdere, fordelt på Social-og sundhedsassistenter, pædagoger, sygehjælpere, Social- og sundhedshjælpere og pædagogiske assistenter.



Om dig
Vi ønsker os, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også har gode samarbejdsegenskaber
  • Har kendskab til Nexus, eller har mod på at lære det.
  • Har en rehabiliterende tilgang til borgeren
  • Har et positivt samt medmenneskeligt livssyn
  • Befinder dig godt i en travl hverdag
  • Besidder stor faglighed og en bred viden
  • Brænder for at skabe et trygt og professionelt miljø for borgerne om natten
  • Har kørekort og kan trives med at køre alene i bilen om natten.


Vi tilbyder dig

  • Fast rul med arbejde hver anden uge
  • Faglige udfordringer og udvikling
  • God introduktion, og sidemandsoplæring ved dygtige, engagerede kollegaer
  • En spændende arbejdsplads med mange bolde i luften
  • En gruppe der gerne vil hinanden

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte Louise-Amalie Henriksen eller Camilla Hedegaard på 65 51 39 37.

Det praktiske
Ansøgningsfristen er den 26.10.26. Der indkaldes til samtaler med kort varsel.

Tiltrædelse pr. 01.12.26, eller før efter aftale.

title: Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement
description:
Vice President, Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement

Global | Permanent or 12-month rotational assignment

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will deliver data, reporting and platform change from requirement definition through testing to deployment and adoption.

title: Financial Systems Engineer
description:
About This Role


We're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to build and maintain the integrations and automation that power Apartment List's finance systems. This is a hands-on Individual Contributor role that goes beyond NetSuite administration, focused on removing manual work from the AR team and making sure financial data lands where it belongs.
You'll own Celigo outright, including its existing connections to Salesforce and our internal lease attribution system, as well as the Stripe billing integration currently in development. You will sit inside Revenue and Billing Operations and partner closely with Accounting, AR, and Revenue Systems.

What You'll Do


  • Serve as the technical owner of Celigo, building and maintaining the integrations that connect NetSuite to Stripe, Salesforce, Bill.com, ADP, and Ramp.
  • Own the Stripe to Celigo to NetSuite billing flow supporting our self-serve product, from build through production support.
  • Write and maintain SuiteScript, including scheduled scripts, map and reduce scripts, workflows, custom records, custom fields, and saved searches.
  • Build error handling, alerting, and automated reconciliation checks so integration failures surface before they reach close rather than during it.
  • Automate manual processes currently performed by the Billing and AR teams, and be able to show the before and after.
  • Configure NetSuite to support billing, invoicing, dispute resolution, and cash collection, including fields, forms, workflows, reports, and dashboards.
  • Develop and maintain integrations to customer payment portals such as Coupa, Yardi RentCafe, and AvidXchange.
  • Support sales tax automation tooling and keep tax logic consistent across billing systems.
  • Support finance system configuration in partnership with Accounting across systems such as Bill.com, Ramp, Expensify, FloQast, Egencia and ADP, and alongside the Celigo integrations that connect them.
  • Own the Jira intake queue for finance systems issues and automate recurring causes rather than absorbing them as workload. Manage vendor support cases through to resolution.
  • Manage sandbox provisioning, environment configuration, credentials, and deployment discipline across environments.
  • Support the Company’s external audit to drive timely and accurate delivery of requests to ensure overall success of the audit and ability to meet committed deadlines.

What You Bring


  • 3 to 5 years in finance or business systems, including at least 3 years hands-on with NetSuite beyond administration.
  • Demonstrated experience building custom flows in Celigo integrator.io or a comparable iPaaS.
  • SuiteScript and JavaScript proficiency, with the judgment to know when a problem belongs in script versus in the integration layer.
  • Working experience with REST and SOAP APIs, JSON, and file-based data transfer.
  • Accounting literacy sufficient to translate a request from Finance or Accounting into a system configuration: debits and credits, subledger to GL flow, quote-to-cash, revenue recognition mechanics, and the close cadence. You do not need to perform the accounting. You need to understand what is being asked and why.
  • A track record of replacing a manual process with an automated one, and the ability to describe what changed and how you validated it.
  • Strong written communication, particularly documenting how an integration works and why it was built that way.
  • Comfort using AI tools to move faster on scripting and testing, while still owning the judgment for what is correct and production ready.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools to build something, not just use them. For example a dashboard, internal tool, or process built with Claude or a similar tool.

Nice to Have


  • Salesforce to NetSuite integration experience.
  • Stripe or comparable payments platform experience.
  • SaaS subscription and usage-based billing models, or outcome-based and other high-volume transactional billing models.
  • Sales tax automation tooling such as Anrok or Avalara.
  • Experience replacing or restructuring legacy integrations while keeping the business running.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, MIS, or equivalent practical experience.

Why This Role


  • Full technical ownership of the integration layer feeding Apartment List's finance systems.
  • A clearly scoped remit. You own the systems, not the close, which means your work is building rather than reconciling.
  • Space to use AI development tools such as Claude to build, test and document faster.
  • Work alongside a small, high-performing Revenue and Billing Operations team with direct access to the people whose work you are automating.

Compensation


We carefully consider a variety of factors to determine compensation for each position, including the role, level, and work. The US Total Target Compensation (TTC) for this position is:

  • Zone 1: $121,500–$147,343 TTC (base $109,350-$132,609) + equity
  • Zone 2: $112,400–$136,285 TTC (base $101,160- $122,657) + equity
  • Zone 3: $103,300–$125,227 TTC (base $92,970- $112,704) + equity

title: Transcription Specialist -- Vietnamese
description:
Join us as a Transcription Specialist and contribute to improving AI-driven speech recognition. You will review audio files, transcribe spoken content accurately, and refine transcripts to ensure high-quality data that supports the development of advanced language models.

Project Benefits

Your role in this project is to listen to audio recordings and create accurate written transcripts of what is spoken. These transcripts will help improve AI-powered speech recognition systems.

Your responsibilities may include:

This is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join the CrowdGen Community as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you will receive an email from CrowdGen with instructions to create your account, complete setup requirements, and proceed with participation in the project.

If you’re passionate about precision, language, and AI innovation — we’d love to have you on the team!

title: Assembler

They may also be responsible for maintaining a clean and organized work area and reporting any issues or defects to supervisors. Attention to detail, manual dexterity, and the ability to work as part of a team are important skills for an Assembler. title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
Help build the future of product strategy at NMDP. As a Senior Product Analyst, you’ll dig into our donor and graft-sourcing product portfolios, combining operational, financial, customer, and market insights to guide product investment and lifecycle decisions. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional experts to identify opportunities, track performance, and recommend what to improve, expand, or rethink. If you’re a curious, adaptable self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys turning insights into action, this could be the role for you.

The Senior Product Analyst helps product teams make data-informed, market-aware, user-centered, and financially grounded decisions across cellular therapy, service, software, and platform products. Embedded in the Product organization, this role partners with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX, Operations, Technology, Analytics, Finance, Commercial, and other cross-functional stakeholders to clarify needs, assess opportunities, shape product decisions, support go-to-market readiness, and measure outcomes that improve product performance and advance mission impact.

The Senior Product Analyst brings a product mindset: translating ambiguity into clear options, evaluating customer needs, market opportunity, operational feasibility, financial implications, current-state processes, and product or platform capability fit, and turning evidence into recommendations that improve customer experience, operational effectiveness, financial performance, and measurable business value. This role supports product work from discovery and opportunity assessment through product development, requirements and backlog readiness, launch readiness, adoption measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Specific emphasis will vary by product line; all Senior Product Analysts are expected to bring strong product thinking, analytical judgment, customer orientation, and evidence-based recommendation development. This role is ideal for a senior analyst who wants to use product thinking, data, market insight, and operational understanding to improve products that support the organization’s mission to save lives through cellular therapy.
ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Product Discovery, Market & Opportunity Analysis:
• Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX, Operations, Technology, and other stakeholders to clarify business objectives, customer problems, user needs, operational pain points, desired outcomes, and market opportunities.
• Analyze customer and stakeholder feedback, journey data, operational data, service interactions, utilization patterns, market signals, and business processes to identify growth opportunities, risks, unmet needs, and whitespace for product development.
• Translate broad or ambiguous business questions into structured hypotheses, assumptions, risks, decision points, analytical approaches, and practical measurement options.
• Conduct opportunity sizing, impact assessment, and value analysis to inform product strategy, roadmap trade-offs, prioritization decisions, and product-line investment discussions.
Product Strategy, Financial & Portfolio Decision Support:
• Support financial analysis for product opportunities, including revenue potential, cost drivers, pricing considerations, margin implications, benefit hypotheses, investment trade-offs, and business case inputs.
• Partner with Product, Finance, Commercial, Operations, Analytics, and Technology partners to evaluate product performance, demand signals, revenue growth opportunities, and cross-product or portfolio implications.
• Translate market, financial, operational, and performance insights into recommendations that inform product strategy, product development, roadmap priorities, go-to-market planning, lifecycle decisions, and trade-off decisions.
• Support product foresight by monitoring emerging customer needs, industry trends, regulatory considerations, technology shifts, competitive dynamics, and evolving product opportunities.
Product, Process & Platform Fit Analysis:
• Analyze current-state processes, service interactions, workflows, and product or platform capabilities to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, compliance considerations, manual workarounds, experience gaps, and simplification opportunities.
• Develop future-state recommendations that balance customer and user needs, business outcomes, operational realities, product strategy, service model considerations, and available platform capabilities.
• Evaluate needs against product, process, service, and platform capabilities to determine where workflow changes, configuration, product iteration, or custom development are appropriate.

title: Executive Vice President, Operating Model & Product
description:
Executive Vice President, Operating Model & Product

Global | Permanent

About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About the Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.

The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will own how our service should run and what we commit to clients, with accountability for the design and adoption of the Private Assets operating model.

  • Set the direction for the Private Assets operating model — defining how services should run end to end, and building the case for change with senior stakeholders.

  • Lead the Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions focus area, balancing long-term transformation priorities with near-term business and client demand.

  • Act as the senior Operations voice in client pitches, POCs and strategic direction setting, ensuring what we sell is something we can genuinely run.

  • Own the marquee solution reuse agenda — identifying where a solution built for one client can be applied across the wider book, and driving that rollout.

  • Partner at senior level with Operations, Tactical Operations, Marquee Client teams, the Transformation Office and IT to align change activity and remove duplication.

  • Govern the transformation portfolio, including prioritisation, resourcing, budget, risk, dependencies and executive reporting.

  • Establish plans for new client setup, transitions and complex implementations, coordinating across Operations, Financial Statements, Tax and Investor Relations.

  • Build and develop the team, including the rotational model, and actively participate in recruitment.

  • Maintain alignment with Tactical Operations and Marquee Operations, routing work to the right group and handing back anything better delivered tactically.

  • Represent Strategic Operations at Private Assets and CFS leadership forums.

About You

You have 12–15 years’ experience in fund administration, alternative asset management or a related financial services environment, predominantly in private assets.

  • A demonstrable record of delivering large-scale operating model or product re-engineering initiatives, with change that was genuinely adopted by the business.

  • Deep knowledge of private assets operating models, fund structures and the end-to-end service model.

  • Strong executive stakeholder management, with credibility in front of clients and senior leadership.

  • Commercial judgement — able to assess what we can genuinely deliver and price, and to hold that line in a client conversation.

  • Portfolio and programme governance experience, with proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple focus areas.

  • Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals, including rotational colleagues joining from the business.

  • Skilled in business planning, budgeting and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint).

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; professional accounting designation a plus.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
