title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.

About the Role

As co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.a

Your remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow.

Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works.

What you’ll do

You will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it.

  • Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response.

  • Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops.

  • Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services.

  • Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision.

  • Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface.

  • Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard.

  • Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in.

  • Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship.

  • Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations.

About You

You have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well.

We are looking for depth in five areas:

  • Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped.

  • Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself.

  • LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics.

  • Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them.

  • Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality.

You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • A strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users.

  • Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments.

  • Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH.

  • Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges.

Why Join

With the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create.

The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows.

We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it.

This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Senior Global Campaigns Strategist
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Global Campaigns Strategist.

About the job

As a Sr Global Campaign strategist, you are responsible for owning, developing a major campaign that drives awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design bold campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine.

The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrive in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Set a strategic vision for a large and visible global campaign and execute operations for any campaign motions. We are looking for someone who is very strategic in terms of knowing the audience, how to create content that resonates, tactics to reach that audience, and ideas that are visionary and tactical.
  • Be accountable to company leadership on the effectiveness of your global campaign remit and programs
  • Strong project management skills and ability to use data to guide decision-making and resource allocation. Design and execute strategic end-to-end campaigns that both engage and convert prospective buyers with a focus on specific buyer and vertical segments
  • Partner with product marketing, content strategists, brand strategists, creative designers and other regional campaign teams to create campaign themes and messaging that translate into impactful marketing campaigns. Act as the central point of contact to guide a pod of cross-functional partners
  • Build strong relationships with key cross functional stakeholders across multiple organizations to ensure campaign enablement and engagement
  • A global systems approach. Develop scalable, repeatable campaign playbooks that can be scaled quickly with a large variety of content that works in all regions
  • Track program results, measure program success and report metrics to customer success, sales and marketing stakeholders and executives. Then analyze campaign performance, surface insights and provide recommendations for optimizing results
  • AI-Driven Enablement: We want you to infuse AI frameworks into all aspects of the campaign model. Ideally you would disrupt the norms and evolve the team and programs to be progressive. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality.
  • Budget Management: Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Deep understanding of marketing funnel tactics and metrics by funnel stage
  • Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, sales processes and stakeholders, especially in B2B tech
  • Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative high-growth environment
  • Ability to manage multiple work streams and has presence with the team and leadership
  • Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail
  • 7+ years working as a campaign strategist in B2B or tech
  • Proven experience building and delivering on integrated programs and managing all tools, processes, and assets
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment, set expectations and drive to success
  • Works well with cross-functional teams and executives, to ensure consistent content is delivered across the company
  • A champion for fostering a culture of trust through feedback, communication, and transparency

Desired:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization.
  • Familiarity with localization tactics to ensure our content is accessible and inclusive across multiple countries.
  • Experience with primary research strategies and types of content creation
  • Strategic ability to see opportunities across campaigns and programs where new types of content and programs will thrive.
  • Experience building world-class brands through premium content
  • Experience with a variety of AI, design, analytics, and video tools. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Singapore.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

description:

As the S/4 Program Organizational Change Management Leader, you will lead the organization’s internal communications and change management to ensure employees are informed, engaged and aligned with the strategy for the global multi-year deployment of SAP S/4HANA enterprise resource planning systems here at Honeywell Aerospace. This role is responsible for translating complex initiatives into clear, compelling messages and building communication plans that support organization transformation, culture and employee experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the stakeholder engagement strategy and deployment for the program ensuring the change journey is relevant and tailored to each impacted business area and team.

YOU MUST HAVE

WE VALUE:

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENT

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

BENEFITS

Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.

Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.

Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.

The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.

Your Role

You will support the identification, build and deployment of automation and digital workflow solutions.

  • Map candidate processes in detail and quantify the manual effort involved.

  • Support the design of target workflows, including exception handling and controls.

  • Draft requirements and supporting documentation for review with IT and the Transformation Office.

  • Build and execute test scripts, run UAT cycles and track defects through to resolution.

  • Support deployment into the business, including user guidance and training material.

  • Track usage and benefit after go-live, and flag where a solution is not being used as intended.

  • Maintain project documentation, trackers and status reporting.

About You

You have 4+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, with exposure to automation or process improvement work.

  • Solid technical knowledge of private assets processes and the manual steps within them.

  • Exposure to automation tooling, workflow design or testing, or a clear appetite to develop in that direction.

  • Comfortable challenging why a manual step exists and evidencing a better way.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation.

  • Attention to detail and a proven ability to manage several pieces of work at once.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); exposure to reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; working towards a professional accounting designation an advantage.

What We Expect of the Strategic Operations Team

Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:

  • Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.

  • Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.

  • A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.

  • Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.

  • Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.

  • Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.

  • Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Compliance Risk Management Lead - Vice President
description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As a Compliance Risk Management Lead within Compliance Conduct and Operational Risk (CCOR), you will focus on providing independent oversight of valuations-related regulatory requirements. Your role will involve assessing compliance with applicable valuation and appraisal laws, rules, and regulations, and advising stakeholders on compliance risks and control expectations. You will be responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of Valuations frameworks, policies, procedures, and governance to support alignment with industry practices and regulatory requirements.

Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct risk-based reviews of valuation products delivered to JPMorganChase to assess alignment with applicable regulatory and policy requirements.
  • Assess compliance risks associated with current and proposed processes, including new/changed products, channels, vendors, and operational workflows.
  • Partner with line-of-business, Control, Risk, and Legal stakeholders to support a strong valuation control environment, including issue identification, escalation, and tracking.
  • Support the launch of new products and channels by reviewing requirements, identifying potential compliance risks, and recommending control enhancements.
  • Provide compliance support for ongoing internal and external audits, exams, and monitoring/testing activities (including responding to requests and validating remediation actions).
  • Participate in governance forums to provide compliance input on valuation-related risks, requirements, practices, and key decisions.
  • Evaluate the regulatory implications of emerging issues and support root-cause analysis and remediation planning, as appropriate.
  • Maintain current awareness of regulatory and industry developments affecting valuations and assess potential impacts to policies, procedures, training, and oversight activities.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 10+ years of experience in valuation, appraisal, collateral risk, or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of valuation-related regulatory and industry requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft clear guidance for business and operations partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment, apply a risk-based approach, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Flexibility and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience assessing and supporting remediation of valuation-related control gaps, vulnerabilities, and access-control weaknesses.
  • Prior experience working in audit, controls, Compliance, and/or risk management environments.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Certified Residential Appraiser or Certified General Appraiser credential preferred.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist II/III
description:
Quality Assurance Specialist II/III in Springfield, MO

Build your future at Curia, where our work has the power to save lives

Curia is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with over 30 years of experience partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to provide life-saving treatments to patients. At Curia, we are on a mission to advance our customers’ therapies from curiosity to cure and ultimately to improve patients’ lives.

We proudly offer

• Generous benefit options (eligible first day of employment)
• Paid training, vacation and holidays (vacation accrual begins on first day of employment)
• Career advancement opportunities
• Education reimbursement
• 401K program with matching contributions
• Learning platform
• And more!

The Quality Assurance Specialist II/III serves as an embedded quality partner to manufacturing and laboratory operations, providing on-the-floor oversight and proactive compliance support. This role is focused on identifying and mitigating compliance risks before and during production execution, driving adherence to cGMPs and internal procedures, and ensuring that when deviations occur, corrective actions are appropriate, timely, and thoroughly documented.

This position maintains and supports Curia’s Quality Management System across a broad range of activities, from document authorship, analytical data review, and audit participation to deviation management and client communication. The QA Specialist III applies strong knowledge of cGMP requirements, data integrity principles, and analytical laboratory practices, including chromatography, to evaluate records and data for accuracy, completeness, compliance, and scientific soundness. The QA Specialist III is a self-directed contributor who works collaboratively across departments to keep quality systems inspection-ready and client timelines on track.

Essential Responsibilities
Floor Presence and Compliance
• Provide on-the-floor QA oversight to manufacturing and laboratory operations, proactively identifying compliance risks and coordinating day-to-day quality activities as needed.
• Represent Curia Quality Assurance when issues require immediate corrective action, ensuring actions taken are appropriate and correctly documented to support traceability and investigation substantiation.
• Assist in or lead deviation and investigation processes, including initiation, immediate corrective action, root cause evaluation, and resolution.
• Track and follow up on Deviations, Change Controls, Investigations, and CAPAs to ensure timely closure.
• Actively participate in quality improvement initiatives, including development and implementation.

Quality Systems, Data Review, and Documentation
• Author, revise, review, and approve Quality Management System documents, including SOPs, CAPAs, Deviations, Change Controls, test methods, protocols, validation documentation, certificates of analysis, and equipment qualification documentation.
• Support compilation and maintenance of quality documentation and systems to ensure inspection readiness for domestic and international regulatory bodies (ISO, FDA, QP, EMEA).
• Develop, support, and maintain Quality System metrics for management review.
• Assist in training personnel in cGMPs, data integrity expectations, and Curia’s quality system to ensure real-time compliance.
• Perform or support QA review of analytical data and associated documentation to verify accuracy, completeness, traceability, compliance with approved methods and procedures, and adherence to cGMP and data integrity requirements.
• Review analytical data generated through chromatography and other laboratory techniques, including associated chromatograms, calculations, audit trails, and supporting documentation, as applicable to the assigned area.
• Evaluate analytical data and laboratory documentation for potential data integrity concerns, atypical results, documentation discrepancies, or other compliance risks and ensure appropriate escalation and investigation.

Audits and Client Support
• Participate in and support internal and external audit programs, including planning, conducting audits, weekly walkthroughs, and preparing audit reports.
• Participate in regulatory, client, and external supplier qualification audits.
• With appropriate supervision, respond to or manage client communications regarding manufacturing, testing, analytical data, and documentation issues.
• Support QA team members and internal project teams to ensure client timelines are on schedule, communicating proactively with customer contacts as needed.
• Report personnel performance observations to appropriate management, noting both areas for improvement and individuals exceeding expectations.

Good Manufacturing & Documentation Practices
Quality is something we take pride in together. You’ll perform your work in alignment with cGMP requirements and Curia’s standards to ensure our facilities support the safe and reliable manufacture of products for our customers.
• Perform all documentation in compliance with ALCOA++ principles and site SOPs.
• Adhere to applicable cGMP documents including SOPs, batch records, protocols, change controls, and controlled forms.
• Keep all required cGMP training current and escalate quality concerns along with proposed solutions to the Quality department.
• Apply data integrity principles when reviewing electronic and paper records, including source data, metadata, audit trails, and associated documentation, as applicable.

Qualifications: Required
• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field; alternate fields of study may be considered in combination with significant industry experience
• Minimum 3–6 years (level II) or 6-8 years (level III) of QA, QC, analytical laboratory, or related quality experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or a cGMP FDA-regulated industry
• Experience reviewing analytical laboratory data within a cGMP environment, with demonstrated understanding of data integrity and good documentation practices.
• Working knowledge of chromatography principles and chromatographic data, such as HPLC and/or GC, with the ability to assess analytical records for compliance and data integrity.
• Strong familiarity with regulatory requirements including ICH Q7, Q9, Q10, and/or 21 CFR 210 and 211
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information clearly to management and peers
• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
• Ability to work independently and proactively while collaborating effectively across departments
• Detail-oriented, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office or other relevant software

Preferred
• Experience working with third-party contract manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry
• Experience with chromatography data systems
• Experience reviewing chromatographic data, audit trails, laboratory investigations, OOS/OOT results, or other analytical data for cGMP and data integrity compliance

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.
• Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
• Frequently required to use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds.
• Visual requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this role.
• Regular work in a standard office environment, with frequent entry into the production area of a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.
• Production environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, extreme heat, wet or humid conditions, low levels of toxic or caustic chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions.
• Noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

title: Cyberdivisionen søger Netværkstekniker til overvågning og drift i Karup
description:
Er du IT-supporter, datatekniker eller tilsvarende med interesse for overvågning og drift af netværksinfrastruktur? Så er stillingen som netværkstekniker i Cyberdivisionens Teknisk Drift Vest måske noget for dig.

Vi søger en ny kollega til vores Teknisk Drift Vest i Karup, hvor vi tilbyder et spændende og udfordrende job inden for overvågning og drift af forsvarets IT-systemer.

Om os
Forsvaret både ligner og adskiller sig fra andre offentlige og private arbejdspladser. Vores mission er at arbejde for fred og sikkerhed i både Danmark og verden. Til støtte for dette stiller Forsvaret krav om en IT-infrastruktur af meget høj kvalitet, der er både sikker, effektiv og som tilbyder moderne tjenester baseret på efterprøvede teknologier fra bl.a. Hitachi, HP, Cisco, VMware og Microsoft.

Forsvaret indeholder en af landets største IT-virksomheder og løser en række spændende drifts- og udviklingsopgaver, som skaber fundamentet for kommunikation og IT for Forsvarets ansatte ombord på skibe i Nordatlanten eller på mission i ørkenen – men også i Oksbøl og Hjørring.

Vi skal både være effektive og samtidig levere gode, brugervenlige IT-tjenester til Forsvarets ansatte. Åbenhed, integritet og loyalitet er kodeordene for et godt samarbejde hos os.

Opbygningen af en solid projektorganisation og kommende driftsorganisation pågår lige nu, og du vil blive en del af et højt specialiseret team af medarbejdere, hvoraf nogle er militære og andre civile. Sektionen er en del af Cyberdivisionen under Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse.

Vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø i moderne rammer med en arbejdsuge på gennemsnitligt 37 timer, fleksibel arbejdstid og betalt frokostpause. På vores unikke arbejdsplads har du med andre ord tid til et liv ved siden af, uden du skal give afkald på kompetenceudvikling og relevante udfordringer.

Om stillingen
Du får en varieret hverdag hvor opgaverne består af bl.a. driftsopgaver, projekter, fejlfinding og rådgivning, sikre drift af netværk.

Du kommer primært til at arbejde med netværksadministration/infrastruktur, hvor du kommer til at indgå i den daglige drift og vedligeholdelse af vores forskellige netværk. Herunder skal du lave kontrol og fejlsøgning, samt oprettelse og nedlæggelse af netværk til vores lokationer.

Du bliver en del af et team, som står for drift og overvågning af netværksmiljøer og infrastruktur i eksisterende og nye miljøer samt implementering af disse.

Dine arbejdsområder vil være inden for:

  • Administration af Cisco udstyr.
  • Administration af Sonicwall, Unifi og andre produkter inden for netværksudstyr.
  • Proaktiv overvågning og fejlretning via overvågningsværktøjerne Zabbix, Cisco og PRTG
  • Implementeringsopgaver og dokumentation af nye systemer.

Hos os og ikke mindst Forsvaret er det dine evner, dit engagement og din motivation, der hjælper os med at forbedre hverdagen i Forsvaret af Danmark og for vores udsendte soldater i hele verden. Til gengæld tilbyder vi dig muligheden for at indgå i et team af usædvanligt dygtige og engagerede IT-specialister, og en lang række af muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

Om dig
Vi søger en netværkstekniker med relevant baggrund, som eksempelvis datatekniker eller lign. Alternativt en IT-medarbejder med flere års erfaring med administration og drift af netværksinfrastruktur. Du behersker desuden dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale på et fagteknisk niveau.

Vi forventer, du har:

  • Grundlæggende netværksforståelse (firewalls, switches, VPN, DNS, DHCP).
  • Generel forståelse for IT-sikkerhed og compliance.
  • Gode problemløsnings- og analytiske evner.
  • Evnen til at arbejde ansvarligt og struktureret.

Vi forestiller os, at du ud over din læretid, har 3-5 års erfaring og gerne fra en tilsvarende stilling.

Du er samarbejdsorienteret, og du brænder for at udvikle dit speciale og for at lære nye ting. Du har et godt humør og formår at kommunikere teknisk komplekse informationer til såvel tekniske som ikke-tekniske samarbejdspartnere og kolleger.

Du arbejder engageret, struktureret og er kvalitetsbevidst, og tager ansvar for både dine og sektionens opgaver. Du trives i et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er fokus på stabil drift af systemer, men hvor ændringer også kan ske hurtigt.

Som person er du positiv af natur og ser løsninger frem for udfordringer. Du har et ønske om at dygtiggøre dig, og du deler villigt din tekniske viden med dine kolleger.

Du skal være indstillet på, at stillingen kan ændre sig til at skulle indgå i en 24/7-driftsorganisation med vagtordning døgnet rundt. Det vil du få mulighed for at spørge mere ind til ved en eventuel samtale.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) i staten.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Karup.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chefsergent John Sloth Rasmussen, driftsleder for IT Operationscenter Vest i Cyberdivisionen, på telefon 50 88 93 25.

Har du spørgsmål til løn og ansættelsesvilkår, er du velkommen til at kontakte Forsvarsministeriets Personalestyrelse, HR-konsulent Mathilde Schmidt-Lange på telefon 32 66 58 18.

Ansøgningsfristen er mandag den 26. oktober 2026. Vi afholder løbende samtaler.

Ansættelse er 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket i opslaget. Vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag kun kan vedhæftes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

OM FORSVARSMINISTERIETS MATERIEL- OG INDKØBSSTYRELSE
Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er Danmarks centrale myndighed for forsvarets og beredskabets materiel, it og cybersikkerhed i fred, krise og krig. Vi arbejder for at sikre, at det samlede forsvar er udstyret, opdateret og operativt — i en tid, hvor kravene til hastighed og kampkraft aldrig har været større. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og it for Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Det er vores it-medarbejdere, der dagligt er med til at afværge de cyberangreb, koncernen udsættes for. Vi er en mangfoldig organisation med ca. 2.500 medarbejdere — civile og militære — fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget.

title: Photographer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Multi-Property Photographer & Videographer is responsible for creating high-quality visual content across four properties: Amman Marriott Hotel, Dead Sea Marriott Resort & Spa, Petra Marriott Hotel, and Sheraton Amman Al Nabil Hotel.

The role is primarily focused on professional photography, videography, video production and editing, capturing the hotels’ rooms, restaurants and bars, culinary experiences, events, people, facilities, offers and guest experiences in a visually compelling and brand-appropriate way.

The position requires a hands-on creative professional who can independently plan and execute photo and video shoots, operate professional camera and lighting equipment, direct subjects when required, and transform captured material into polished photographs, videos, reels, stories and other digital assets.

The Photographer & Videographer will work closely with the Multi Property Marketing Communications team and hotel operational teams to translate marketing priorities, promotions and brand stories into engaging visual content. The individual will also maintain organized visual asset libraries and ensure all produced content complies with Marriott Hotels & Resorts and Sheraton brand standards.

A strong understanding of social media content formats and current visual trends is important; however, this is primarily a photography and videography production role rather than a traditional marketing or social media executive position.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in photography, videography and visual content production.
  • Demonstrated experience producing photography and video for hospitality, food & beverage, lifestyle, events, travel or similar industries is preferred.
  • Strong experience in video shooting, editing, colour correction, photo retouching and post-production.
  • Previous experience producing short-form digital and social media content, including Reels and Stories.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment and managing several shoots and projects simultaneously.
  • Understanding of brand guidelines and the ability to consistently produce content within an established visual identity.
  • Fluent written and verbal English is required.
  • Strong photography and videography portfolio/showreel is required.

Professional Attributes, Skills & Experience

  • Strong technical knowledge of professional photography and videography equipment, including cameras, lenses, lighting, stabilizers/gimbals and audio equipment.
  • Strong understanding of composition, lighting, framing, exposure, colour and visual storytelling.
  • Advanced photography and video editing skills.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Lightroom and Photoshop.
  • Knowledge of After Effects or similar motion graphics software is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with social-first editing tools such as CapCut, InShot and native Instagram/Facebook editing tools.
  • Ability to shoot and edit content in different formats and aspect ratios for digital and social media platforms.
  • Strong understanding of short-form video production, including Reels, Stories and vertical video.
  • Ability to independently conceptualize, plan and execute photo and video shoots.
  • Ability to direct models, team members, chefs and other subjects during shoots when required.
  • Strong eye for detail, visual consistency and brand presentation.
  • Ability to identify visually appealing moments and proactively create content opportunities within the hotels.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to maintain structured photo and video asset libraries.
  • Ability to manage multiple shoots, deadlines and priorities across four properties.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends and holidays when required for events or specific shoots.
  • Must be able to work on-site across the hotels as a full-time team member.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Produce high-quality photography and videography content across Amman Marriott Hotel, Dead Sea Marriott Resort & Spa, Petra Marriott Hotel and Sheraton Amman Al Nabil Hotel.
  • Regularly photograph hotel rooms, suites, restaurants, bars, food and beverage offerings, facilities, amenities, experiences, associates and other hotel features.
  • Produce video content showcasing hotel experiences, promotions, culinary offerings, destinations, events and brand storytelling.
  • Create and edit Reels, Stories, short-form videos and other social-first video content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.
  • Plan and execute photography and video shoots based on the Marketing Communications team's monthly priorities and content requirements.
  • Work with the Marketing Communications team to develop concepts, shot lists, storyboards and creative approaches for planned shoots.
  • Set up and operate professional cameras, lenses, lighting, stabilizers, microphones and other production equipment.
  • Direct models, hotel associates, chefs and other participants during shoots to achieve the required visual outcome.
  • Capture and produce content during hotel events, activations, launches, promotions and special occasions.
  • Edit photographs, including colour correction, retouching, cropping and preparation for different digital formats.
  • Edit video footage, including selection, sequencing, colour correction, audio, transitions, subtitles and other post-production requirements.
  • Adapt photography and video assets into different dimensions, durations and formats required across digital platforms.
  • Maintain consistently high visual standards and ensure all produced assets comply with Marriott Hotels & Resorts, Sheraton and property-specific brand standards.
  • Develop and maintain monthly visual asset banks for each hotel to ensure the Marketing Communications team has a continuous supply of fresh content.
  • Proactively identify opportunities within the hotels for new visual content rather than relying solely on scheduled shoots.
  • Monitor photography, video and social media content trends and recommend new creative approaches that are relevant to the hotels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Communications, Food & Beverage, Rooms, Spa, Events and other operational teams to coordinate content production.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders before shoots to ensure venues, products, associates and other required elements are properly prepared.
  • Support larger professional and brand photography/video productions by assisting with shot planning, location preparation and coordination.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

License or Certification: None

title: IS Technician II
description:
Thompson Industrial is looking for Hydroblaster/ Field Technicians, This Technician will be responsible for the safe & proper execution of Thompson Industrial jobs across all services lines to work at a customer location and to join their safety conscious team! This team member is responsible for two or more crews by planning, leading, organizing, and coordinating the daily operations of the service line crew. This includes responsibility for the proper operation of equipment, driving operational efficiencies at the work site, and ensuring accurate documentation related to the job is completed in a timely fashion. Ensures compliance with all Company policies/procedures and maintains/improves good customer relations by providing quality, timely industrial cleaning services. Technicians serve as representative of Thompson Industrial in creating a continuous working relationship with clients/customers.

Why work for Thompson Industrial?

  • Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!

  • Competitive wages

  • Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment

  • Group 401K with company matching component

  • Own part of Clean Harbors with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (U.S. Only)

  • Generous paid time off, company paid training and tuition reimbursement

  • Positive and safe work environments

  • Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as safety representative responsible for safety policies & procedures of both the company & the customer, including hands-on information regarding operations, safety, equipment, emergency response & administrative functions.
  • Hands-on operation, when required, of manual and automated hydro-blasting equipment.
  • Operation of special equipment, such as ultra-high-pressure pumps.
  • Operate equipment by energizing the pumping equipment and/or any specialized hydro-blasting and/or chemical cleaning equipment, vacuum trucks & cutting equipment being used on the job.
  • May be required to examine surface cleaning to ensure conformance to company & customer specifications.
  • Perform routine maintenance on company equipment being used on the job.
  • In the case of personnel in a supervisor capacity: Interface with customer representatives regarding job setup and scope, ensure performance & customer requirements are met or exceeded, and company policies & procedures are implemented at the job site. Report to the branch manager or the designee and implement procedures to obtain results specified by the branch manager.

Physical demands:

  • See, read, distinguish, & understand signs in the work area.
  • Hear and distinguish emergency signals while on duty.
  • Execute a 180-degree rotary motion of the cervical spine to allow complete movement of the head & neck.
  • Must be able to extend arms above your head.
  • Frequently bend at waist stoop, squat, kneel, reach & crawl.
  • Tolerate being wet from head to toe for an unlimited amount of time.
  • Climb ladders & work from scaffolding & stationary platforms up to heights of 200 ft.
  • Tolerate and function in confined spaces of a minimum of 5 ft inside diameter.
  • Hold the back thrust of 50lbs on a straight 66” pipe for a minimum of 1 hour.
  • Must be capable of working up to 16 hours per shift.
  • Must be physically capable of using both negative pressure and air supplied respirators.
  • Must be able to wear protective clothing and/or equipment. This includes, but is not limited to, Nomex coveralls, a back belt, slickers, rubber boots, a fresh air breathing mask, an escape pack, and a hard hat.
  • Work under extreme climate conditions (excessive high heat index of 95 degree Fahrenheit, 98% humidity; and sub-zero weather conditions) relative to geographical location.
  • Exposure to dust (chemical & environmental), fumes (chemical & fluids). Exhaust & highly pressurized fluids. (A respirator will be provided when required.)
  • Noise levels exceed 85 dBA (hearing protection is provided and required.)
  • Lift & maintain a minimum of 40lbs.

What does it take to work for Thompson Industrial?

  • Specific vocational preparation including classroom safety training, on-the-job training & essential experience gained on other jobs.
  • Language proficiency: understands English at a level to comprehend safety training & respond to instructions in emergency situations.
  • Valid driver’s license and other requirements of the company’s driving policy are required when driving a company vehicle or using a personal vehicle on company business.
  • Must be knowledgeable in the operation of emergency equipment, such as fire extinguishers.
  • Provide Federal Transportation Workers Identification Credential (TWIC).

About Thompson Industrial:

Thompson Industrial, powered by Clean Harbors, is the premier industrial cleaning and environmental services company in North America supporting the upstream, downstream, and utility sectors. Thompson Industrial offers an exceptional three-pronged safety system, innovative career development platform, committed customer service, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology and automation. We are committed to safety, people, growth, service, and performance. We provide the safest, most efficient operational experience for our customers and the most comprehensive training and career development for our employees.

40-years of sustainability in action. At Clean Harbors, our mission is to create a safer, cleaner environment through the treatment, recycling, and disposal of hazardous materials. Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

Join our safety focused team today! To learn more about our company, and to apply online for this exciting opportunity, visit us at .

Clean Harbors is an equal opportunity employer.

Clean Harbors is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact ect@cleanharbors.com or 1-844-922-5547.

Clean Harbors is a Military & Veteran friendly company.

title: Maintenance Tech
description:
This is a broad classification in which incumbents are responsible for operating heavy equipment in the repair and maintenance of public works infrastructure and assisting in training new employees. This job is a safety sensitive position that will require a pre-employment drug test and subsequent random drug and alcohol testing.

This position is eligible for the Employee Referral Program.

  • Operates various complex vehicles and equipment and performs associated labor duties in the construction and maintenance of public roadways, airfields, sewer, water, and/or storm water lines or haul waste sludge to and from facilities.
  • Maintains proper traffic control at work sites to ensure safety for both the work crew and the motoring public.
  • Performs daily inventory checks on service trucks and obtains proper tools and/or equipment to perform job task.
  • Transports materials and heavy equipment to various work sites.
  • Inspects roads, airfields, bridges and right-of-way to ensure safe and efficient conditions exist.
  • Performs minor repairs and preventative maintenance on tools and equipment.
  • Cleans and repairs manholes as necessary to remove debris, obstacles and to prevent infiltration and installs and maintains sewer lines.
  • Provides landscaping maintenance to include: grooming, clearing of branches, and maintaining grass and brush, shrubs and flowers.
  • Improves erosion and drainage problems.
  • Repairs pipes, and maintains roads and ditches, airfields, water mains and fire hydrants.
  • Performs other duties of a similar nature or level

Training and Experience (positions in this class require): Completion of coursework up through the eighth grade and one year of related maintenance experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job such as those listed above

Licensing Requirements (positions in this class require):

  • Valid Driver's License from state of residency
  • Some positions require: Road Flagging Certificate; Trench and Excavation Certificate; Confined Space Certificate; Commercial Driver's License; Work Zone Traffic Safety Certification

Knowledge of:

  • Equipment safety precautions and procedures
  • Mechanical principles
  • Landscaping methods and procedures
  • Traffic safety and control procedures
  • Grading techniques
  • Sign fabrication principles
  • Plumbing and carpentry principles
  • Erosion control measures and principles
  • Road maintenance and repair procedures
  • Emergency repair techniques

Skill in:

  • Utilizing hand tools
  • Performing preventative maintenance
  • Using two-way radio and other communication equipment
  • Operating heavy equipment
  • Reading blueprints
  • Communication, interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisor, the general public, etc. sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction

Physical Requirements: Positions in this class require: climbing, stooping, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions. Heavy Work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of forces constantly to move objects. Incumbents may be subjected to moving mechanical parts, electrical currents, vibrations, fumes, odors, dusts, gases, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures.

This position may require: 24-hour on call assignment, overtime, or working weekends, holidays, 10-hour, 12-hour, and rotating shifts.

title: Projektleder til driftsafdeling
description:
ZOO er på en strategirejse, der kræver at vi udvider vores bemanding i vores driftsafdeling og vi søger derfor en Projektleder.

Vi har behov for at gennemføre og følge op på flere projekter inden for både små og store bygge-, anlægs- og vedligeholdelsesprojekter.

Du bliver en del af en større driftsafdeling (35 ansatte) med reference til Ejendoms- & driftschefen. Du vil indgå i et stærkt team af erfarne og dygtige kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, hvor I ligeledes indgår i en meget kompleks organisation.

Du skal medvirke til at omsætte idéer og behov til konkrete projektplaner herunder interessenter, ressourcer og budgetstyring. I rollen skal du både have overblikket, men også kunne indgå hands-on i løsning af nogle af opgaverne og sikre en høj kvalitet og service i de enkelte projekter.

Som projektleder er du relationel stærk og er vant til at samle mange fagligheder på tværs af en organisation og sammen med eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du forstår at involvere, skabe samarbejde, følge op og kommunikere klart og tydeligt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Sikre gennemførelse af anlæg-, vedligeholdelses- og byggeprojekter fra A-Z
  • Udarbejde projektplaner, kommunikations- og implementeringsplaner
  • Gennemføre projekt/byggemøder med både interne kolleger og eksterne partnere
  • Indhente tilbud og lave oplæg til ledelsen
  • Styring af projektbudgetter og rapportering til direktionen
  • Samarbejde og kommunikere med interne som eksterne samarbejdspartnere, herunder entreprenører, rådgivere samt håndværkere
  • Medvirke til at kortlægge og dokumentere at alle ZOO’s bygninger, ledningsnet og rørføring mv. er korrekt opført
  • Dialog med myndigheder og sikring af tilladelser og godkendelser
  • Overholdelse af arbejdsmiljøloven og sikkerhedsregler på bygge- og renoveringsopgaver
  • Ad hoc support til Ejendoms- og driftschefen i det daglige, herunder at repræsentere afdelingen i tværgående koordinerende arbejdsgrupper

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har 5-7 års dokumenteret projektledererfaring fra lignende organisationer eller bygge- og anlægsvirksomheder
  • Har en faglig relevant uddannelse som ingeniør, bygningskonstruktør, eller tilsvarende teknisk baggrund herunder også en projektlederuddannelse
  • Erfaring med projektledelsesværktøjer og kendskab til AutoCAD og Byggeweb
  • Kan mestrer mange bolde og er stærk til at prioritere og nå deadlines
  • Er en dygtig kommunikator både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Naturligt involverer, informerer og følger op
  • Er kendt for at være den gode samarbejdspartner, der tager ansvar, når tingene strammer til
  • Leverer løsninger, resultater og kvalitet på et højt niveau
  • Har et stort overblik, men har også sans for at nå i mål med detaljerne
  • Trives med mange interessenter og stor variation i opgaverne
  • Bidrager positivt til teamet og ikke mindst afdelingen
  • Er positiv og har en konstruktiv tilgang til opgaver

Vi tilbyder

En spændende stilling, hvor du får en alsidig og udfordrende rolle i en af Danmarks mest traditionsrige og mest besøgte kulturinstitutioner. ZOO er en særlig unik arbejdsplads, hvor mange fagligheder er samlet og ikke en dag er ens. Et sted hvor dyr, naturbevarelse, formidling og forretning mødes – og hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på ZOO.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling og aflønning sker efter kvalifikationer og erfaring. Hertil pensionsordning og sundhedssikring samt personalekort til ZOO.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så ansøg via linket her på siden. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at tage fat i Ejendoms- og driftschef, Helge Diness Christensen på hc@zoo.dk eller HR Konsulent Dorthe Greve på dg@zoo.dk.

Motiveret ansøgning samt cv sendes via link hurtigst muligt og senest søndag den 1. november 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist:

1. november 2026

Om Zoologisk Have:

Zoologisk Have København er en selvejende institution, en af Europas ældste zoologiske haver og et af Danmarks mest besøgte attraktioner med mere end 1.300.000 årlige gæster. Gennem oplevelser og formidling ønsker vi at øge vores gæsters interesse og forståelse for naturen og dens mangfoldighed, så de får lyst til at passe bedre på den.

Vi er sat i verden for at fremme naturbevarelse og for at passe på verdens dyr – både dem, der bor i Haven på Frederiksberg, og de truede arter ude i verden. Vi samarbejder lokalt, nationalt og internationalt og er aktive på tværs af seks kontinenter, hvor vi bidrager til at sikre truede arters fremtid gennem forskning, avlsprogrammer og partnerskaber.

Vi er den eneste zoologiske have i Danmark med alle ressourcer in-house – herunder dyrlæger, biologer, forskere og naturbevarelsesteams. Det forpligter os til at tage ansvar og handle. Med vores egne teams har vi gennem flere årtier været engageret i naturens brændpunkter, hvor dyrelivet har mest brug for os – hvad enten det er på en mark på Lolland eller i en nationalpark i Afrika.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
The Software Engineer I serves as a core member of the Oceaneering Technologies (OTECH) group. Engineers are expected to learn OTECH processes and best engineering practices; and apply the knowledge towards growing a software engineering skill set. This role is key in implementing the bulk of the engineering work under the supervision of a software program lead.

OTECH produces and maintains unique underwater systems – typically for US Navy and other US Government Department of Defense customers. Our projects are all one-of-a-kind. Projects range from quick burn to lifecycle management of fielded systems. The ideal candidate for this position would have a zest for being thrown into new situations and have a knack for asking questions when guidance is needed, while capable of functioning independently when given clear instructions.

  • Learn and apply the software development lifecycle.
  • Write software at the CSU level.
  • Write software that adheres to the defined software architecture.
  • Actively interface with the software lead and team.
  • Communicate independently and effectively with non-software teammates for issue resolution.
  • Creation and maintenance of project CDRL’s. This includes requirements management, software documentation, unit testing, software safety testing, and software qualification testing.
  • Support software testing on the factory floor, offsite, and offshore.
  • Understand user requirements, concept of operations documents, and system requirements specifications.
  • Prepare reports and present results to fellow team members.
  • Schedules can be demanding throughout the year and occasional work outside normal working hours should be anticipated.

Essential Qualifications

  • BS Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field. Commensurate experience will be considered.
  • A strong interest in robotics and/or underwater robotics.
  • Experience with the following programming languages: C, C++, C# and/or Java.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a United States Government Department of Defense Security Clearance (active clearances preferred, but not prerequisite).
  • Must be a US citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with microprocessors and single-board computer (SBC) based control systems.
  • Experience analyzing communication protocols including: UDP and multicast, TCP, serial protocols, SPI, I2C, CAN, etc.
  • Experience with Python or other scripting languages.
  • Experience with Linux OS and bare metal firmware.
  • Experience with React, ROS, Qt, or Unity.
  • Solid written and oral communications skills, including ability to effectively document, convey, and present engineering concepts and products to team members and customers.

Additional

  • Additional duties as assigned.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Employee benefits vary by role, however, may include Health and Wellness, Mental Health, Retirement Savings, Life and Disability, Paid Maternity and Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, Tuition Reimbursement, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Compensation $74,000.00 - $112,000.00
